title.zh: 卷20 本紀二十 文宗本紀
title.raw: 卷20 本紀二十 文宗本紀

sentences.zh: 文宗協天翊運執中垂謨懋德振武聖孝淵恭端仁寬敏顯皇帝，諱奕詝，宣宗第四子也，母孝全成皇后鈕祜祿氏，道光十一年六月初九日生。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong, entitled Xietian Yiyun Zhizhong Chui Mo Maode Zhenwu Shengxiao Yuan Gong Duanren Kuanmin Xian, taboo name Yizhu, was the fourth son of the Xuanzong Emperor. His mother was Empress Xiaoquancheng of the Niuhulu clan. He was born on the ninth day of the sixth month in the eleventh year of Daoguang.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong Emperor Yizhu, fourth son of Daoguang, was born on the sixth month's ninth day, Daoguang 11; his mother was Empress Xiaoquancheng Niuhulu.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，用立儲家法，書名緘藏。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, using the household succession method for establishing an heir, his name was written, sealed, and stored away.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 his name was sealed in the heir-selection vault.

sentences.zh: 三十年正月丁未，宣宗不豫，宣召大臣示硃筆，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, first month, day dingwei, the Xuanzong Emperor was ill; he summoned ministers and showed them the vermillion brush, establishing him as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In month 1, dingwei, Daoguang 30, a dying Daoguang named Yizhu crown prince before his ministers.

sentences.zh: 宣宗崩，己未，上即位，頒詔覃恩，以明年為咸豐元年。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor died; on day jiwei the Emperor ascended the throne, issued an amnesty edict, and designated the next year as the first year of Xianfeng.
translations.idiomatic: After Daoguang died, on jiwei Yizhu took the throne, granted amnesty, and made the next year Xianfeng 1.

sentences.zh: 尊皇貴妃為孝慈皇貴妃。

translations.literal: The Imperial Noble Consort was honored as Imperial Noble Consort Xiaoci.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial noble consort was raised to Imperial Noble Consort Xiaoci.

sentences.zh: 追封兄貝勒奕緯、奕綱、奕繹為郡王。

translations.literal: Elder brothers the princes Yiwei, Yigang, and Yishi were posthumously ennobled as commandery princes.
translations.idiomatic: Brothers Yiwei, Yigang, and Yishi were posthumously made commandery princes.

sentences.zh: 封弟奕訢恭親王，奕枻醇郡王，奕硉鍾郡王，奕譓孚郡王。

translations.literal: Younger brother Yi Xin was made Prince Gong; Yi Yi Prince Chun of the commandery; Yi Xu Prince Zhong of the commandery; and Yi Hui Prince Fu of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Xin became Prince Gong; Yi Yi, Yi Xu, and Yi Hui became commandery princes Chun, Zhong, and Fu.

sentences.zh: 定縞素百日，素服二十七月。

translations.literal: Plain white mourning for one hundred days was fixed, and plain dress for twenty-seven months.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning was set at one hundred days of white and twenty-seven months of plain dress.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，命左都御史柏葰、內務府大臣基溥營建昌西陵，為孝和皇后山陵。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuchen: Left Censor-in-Chief Bai Zai and Household Administration Minister Ji Pu were ordered to build at the Western Tombs the mountain tomb for Empress Xiaohe.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, wuchen, Bai Zai and Ji Pu were told to build Empress Xiaohe's tomb at the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 初宣宗遺詔，毋庸升配、升祔。

translations.literal: Initially in the Xuanzong Emperor's testamentary edict, no elevation to joint worship or enshrinement was to be done.
translations.idiomatic: Daoguang's will had barred elevating his spirit tablet for joint worship.

sentences.zh: 交廷臣議。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the court ministers for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The court was asked to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 議上。

translations.literal: Their deliberation was submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Their report went up.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「先帝謙讓，所不敢從。

translations.literal: Edict: "The late Emperor was modest; we dare not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: "The late Emperor was humble; we will not do as he refused.

sentences.zh: 曲體先懷，宜定限制。

translations.literal: Honoring the late Emperor's intent, limits should be fixed.
translations.idiomatic: To honor his wish, limits should be set.

sentences.zh: 即以三祖五宗為斷，嗣後不復舉行。

translations.literal: Take the three ancestors and five forebears as the cutoff; hereafter this rite will not be performed again.
translations.idiomatic: Use three ancestors and five forebears as the line; never do this again.

sentences.zh: 」湖南土匪李沅發作亂。

translations.literal: " Hunan bandit Li Yuanfa rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan bandit Li Yuanfa rebelled.

sentences.zh: 詔：「惠親王系朕之叔，免叩拜禮，示敬長親親。

translations.literal: Edict: "Prince Qing is the Emperor's uncle; exempt him from the kowtow rite, showing respect for elders in kinship.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: "Prince Qing is the Emperor's uncle; spare him kowtow to honor kin elders.

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，敕沿海整頓水師，認真巡緝。

translations.literal: " On day gengchen, order the coast to reorganize the naval forces and patrol diligently.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, coastal forces were ordered to drill the navy and patrol hard.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大理寺卿倭仁應詔陳言，上嘉其直諫。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Grand Court of Revision Director Wo Ren answered the summons with a memorial; the Emperor praised his forthright remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Wo Ren's summoned memorial won praise for blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳朔，保昌卒，以柏葰為兵部尚書，花沙納為左都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day guisi new moon: Baochang died; Bai Zai was made Minister of War, and Hua Shana Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, guisi new moon, Baochang died; Bai Zai took War and Hua Shana the censorate.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，通政使羅惇衍應詔陳言，上優詔答之。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Supervising Secretary Luo Dunyi answered the summons with a memorial; the Emperor replied with an excellent edict.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Luo Dunyi's summoned memorial drew a warm edict reply.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，左副都御史文瑞疏陳四事，並錄進乾隆元年故大學士孫嘉淦三習一弊疏，禮部侍郎曾國籓疏陳用人三事，均嘉納之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief Wen Rui memorialized on four matters, and also submitted for the record former Grand Secretary Sun Jiageng's "Three Lessons, One Abuse" memorial of Qianlong 1; Vice Minister of Rites Zeng Guofan memorialized on three matters of personnel employment—all were graciously accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Wen Rui urged four reforms and filed Sun Jiageng's Qianlong "Three Lessons, One Abuse" memorial; Zeng Guofan urged three personnel reforms—all were accepted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，濬江蘇白茅河，移建海口石徬於老徬橋。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Jiangsu's Baimao River was dredged, and the stone dike at the river mouth was moved from Laoqiao.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Jiangsu dredged the Baimao River and moved the mouth dike from Laoqiao.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，禮親王全齡薨，子世鐸襲。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Prince of Li Quanling died; his son Shiduo inherited.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Prince of Li Quanling died and Shiduo succeeded.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，俄羅斯請於塔爾巴哈台通商，允之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yichou: Russia requested trade at Tarbaghatai; it was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, yichou, Russia was allowed to trade at Tarbaghatai.

sentences.zh: 己巳，內閣學士車克慎疏陳敬天繼志、用人行政凡十條，優詔答之。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Grand Secretariat Academician Che Kezhen memorialized on revering Heaven and continuing the late Emperor's aims, employing men and administering affairs—ten items in all; an excellent edict replied.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Che Kezhen's ten-point memorial on Heaven, succession, and governance drew a warm edict.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，戶部疏陳整頓財政，臚陳各弊，得旨：實力革除。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Ministry of Revenue memorialized on reorganizing finances, setting forth various abuses; received decree: eradicate them in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Revenue exposed fiscal abuses and was told to root them out.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，英吉利國船至江蘇海口遞公文，卻之。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, English ships reached Jiangsu's sea mouth bearing documents; they were refused.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, British ships at Jiangsu's mouth with papers were turned away.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，船至天津。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, ships reached Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the ships reached Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，起碇南旋。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingshen: weighed anchor and sailed south.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingshen, the ships weighed anchor and sailed south.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔曰：「州縣親民之官，責任綦重。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, edict: "Prefects and magistrates are officials close to the people; their responsibility is exceedingly heavy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, edict: "County magistrates live closest to the people; their burden is immense.

sentences.zh: 近年登進冒濫，流品猥雜，多倚胥吏而朘閭閻，民生何賴焉。

translations.literal: In recent years promotion has been reckless and ranks mixed; many rely on clerks and squeeze the neighborhoods—on what can the people's livelihood depend?
translations.idiomatic: Promotions have been sloppy and clerks bleed the towns—what hope is there for commoners?

sentences.zh: 督撫大吏其加意考察，薦進廉平，鋤斥貪茸，庶民困漸蘇，以副朕望。

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors should examine with added care, recommend the upright and fair, root out the greedy and incompetent, so the people's hardships may gradually ease—to fulfill Our hope.
translations.idiomatic: Governors must scrutinize officials, promote the honest, purge the corrupt, and ease popular hardship as We expect.

sentences.zh: 」獲湖南逆首李沅發，解京誅之。

translations.literal: " Li Yuanfa, Hunan rebel leader, was captured, sent to the capital, and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan rebel chief Li Yuanfa was captured, sent to Beijing, and executed.

sentences.zh: 詔鄭祖琛「廣西會匪四起，應時捕剿，疏報勿得諱飾。

translations.literal: Edict to Zheng Zuchen: "In Guangxi society bandits rise on all sides; suppress them promptly; in memorials do not conceal or embellish.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zuchen was told: "Guangxi secret-society bandits are everywhere—strike at once and report honestly.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，改山東登州鎮為水師總兵，兼轄陸路。

translations.literal: " On day xinhai, Shandong's Dengzhou garrison was changed to naval commander-in-chief, also commanding overland troops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Shandong's Dengzhou post became a naval commander also over land forces.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔東南兩河勘籌民堰。

translations.literal: On day guichou, edict for the Southeast's two rivers to survey and plan civilian dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the southeast's two rivers were ordered to survey folk dikes.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以固慶為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Gu Qing was made Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Gu Qing became Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，永定河溢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai: the Yongding River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, guihai, the Yongding River burst.

sentences.zh: 大學士潘世恩致仕，食全俸。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Pan Shi'en retired; he was given full salary.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Pan Shi'en retired on full pay.

sentences.zh: 以祁俊藻為大學士，杜受田協辦大學士，孫瑞珍為戶部尚書，王廣廕為兵部尚書，季芝昌為左都御史。

translations.literal: Qi Junzao was made grand secretary; Du Shoutian associate grand secretary; Sun Ruizhen Minister of Revenue; Wang Guangyin Minister of War; and Ji Zhichang Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Junzao became grand secretary; Du Shoutian associate; Sun Ruizhen Revenue; Wang Guangyin War; Ji Zhichang censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，除甘肅民、番升科畸零地銀。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Gansu Han and fan tax-assessed irregular fragmented land silver was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Gansu tax on odd Han and fan plots was remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，敕督撫舉劾屬員，臚列事實，勿以空言。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, governors-general and governors were ordered to memorialize recommending and impeaching subordinates, listing facts, not empty words.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, governors were told to praise or impeach subordinates with facts, not rhetoric.

sentences.zh: 是月，廣東花縣人洪秀全在廣西桂平縣金田起事。

translations.literal: That month, Hong Xiuquan of Huaxian, Guangdong, rose in revolt at Jintian, Guiping county, Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hong Xiuquan of Guangdong's Huaxian rebelled at Jintian in Guangxi's Guiping.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，敕沿海督撫籌防海口。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinmao: order coastal governors-general and governors to plan defense of sea mouths.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, xinmao, coastal governors were told to fortify every port.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，尚書文慶坐延請妖人薛執中治病，免。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Minister Wen Qing was dismissed for having the sorcerer Xue Zhizhong treat illness.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Wen Qing was dismissed for hiring Xue Zhizhong to heal by sorcery.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，洪秀全竄修仁、荔浦，敕鄭祖琛剿之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingmao: Hong Xiuquan fled to Xiuren and Lipu; Zheng Zuchen was ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, dingmao, Hong Xiuquan fled to Xiuren and Lipu and Zheng Zuchen was told to crush him.

sentences.zh: 調向榮為廣西提督剿賊。

translations.literal: Xiang Rong was transferred to be Guangxi commander to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Rong was made Guangxi commander to fight the rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔曰：「各省糾眾滋事，重案層見疊出，該地方官所司何事？

translations.literal: On day jiashen, edict: "In the provinces crowds gather to make trouble; serious cases pile up layer on layer—what are local officials in charge of?
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, edict: "Uprisings stack up province by province—what are local officials doing?

sentences.zh: 即如河南捻匪結黨成群，甚至擾及鄰省，橫行劫掠，自應合力捕治，淨絕根株。

translations.literal: Even Henan Nian bandits form cliques and even disturb neighboring provinces, robbing openly—they should be jointly captured and the roots utterly cut.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Nian bands even raid neighbors—they must be hunted down to the root.

sentences.zh: 若封疆大吏玩縱於前，復諱飾於後，以致釀成鉅患，朕必將該督撫從重治罪。

translations.literal: If frontier governors play down beforehand and conceal afterward, causing great calamity, the Emperor will punish those governors-general and governors severely.
translations.idiomatic: Governors who indulge then cover up and breed disaster will be punished without mercy.

sentences.zh: 凜之！

translations.literal: Take heed!
translations.idiomatic: Take heed!
So ordered.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，以廣西賊勢蔓延，調湖南、雲南、貴州兵各二千赴剿，並勸諭紳民舉辦團練。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingshen: because Guangxi bandit power had spread, order Hunan, Yunnan, and Guizhou troops two thousand each to suppress them, and urge gentry and people to organize militia.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, bingshen, with Guangxi rebels spreading, 2,000 troops each from Hunan, Yunnan, and Guizhou were sent and gentry told to raise militia.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命林則徐為欽差大臣，剿賊廣西。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Lin Zexu was ordered to be Imperial Commissioner to suppress bandits in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Lin Zexu became Imperial Commissioner for Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以廣東遊匪滋事，命徐廣縉剿之。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, because Guangdong roving bandits made trouble, Xu Guangjin was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Xu Guangjin was sent to crush Guangdong roving bandits.

sentences.zh: 丙午，大行梓宮發引。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the late Emperor's coffin set out on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Daoguang's coffin left the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，暫安宣宗成皇帝於隆恩殿。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Cheng Emperor Xuanzong was temporarily enshrined at Long'en Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Daoguang was temporarily enshrined at Long'en Hall.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，以彌縫釀患，奪鄭祖琛職，林則徐署廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renwu: for covering up and brewing disaster, Zheng Zuchen was stripped of office; Lin Zexu acted as Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, renwu, Zheng Zuchen was dismissed for concealment and Lin Zexu acted as Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，永定河漫口合龍。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Yongding River breach closed and joined.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Yongding breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔曰：「大學士穆彰阿柔佞竊位，傾排異己，沮格戎機，罔恤國是，即行褫職。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, edict: "Grand Secretary Muzhang'a is fawning and usurps position, drives out those unlike himself, obstructs military affairs, and cares not for the state—strip his office immediately.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, edict: "Muzhang'a is a sycophant who blocks the war effort—remove him at once.

sentences.zh: 協辦大學士耆英無恥無能，降員外郎。

translations.literal: Associate Grand Secretary Qiying is shameless and incapable—demote him to junior seventh-rank official.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Grand Secretary Qiying is worthless—demote him to junior seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 頒示中外。

translations.literal: Proclaim throughout within and without.
translations.idiomatic: Publish this inside and outside the court.

sentences.zh: 」以賽尚阿協辦大學士。

translations.literal: " Saishang'a was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Saishang'a became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，以奕山為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuxu: Yi Shan was made Yili general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, wuxu, Yi Shan became Yili general.

sentences.zh: 庚子，欽差大臣林則徐道卒，以周天爵署廣西巡撫，命前兩江總督李星沅為欽差大臣，赴廣西剿賊。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu died on the road; Zhou Tianjue acted as Guangxi governor; former Liang-Jiang Governor-General Li Xingyuan was made Imperial Commissioner to proceed to Guangxi to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Lin Zexu died en route; Zhou Tianjue acted at Guangxi and ex-governor Li Xingyuan was made commissioner to fight rebels.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，敕各省籓庫積存雜款，撥充軍需，暫緩開捐。

translations.literal: On day yisi, order provincial treasuries' accumulated miscellaneous balances applied to military needs; temporarily defer opening contributions-for-office sales.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, provincial hoards were tapped for war funds and sale of offices was paused.

sentences.zh: 劉韻珂免，以裕泰為閩浙總督，程矞採為湖廣總督，吳文鎔為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Liu Yunke was dismissed; Yu Tai was made Min-Zhe governor-general, Cheng Yusong Hubei-Hunan governor-general, and Wu Wenrong Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yunke was removed; Yu Tai took Min-Zhe, Cheng Yusong Hubei-Hunan, and Wu Wenrong Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 獲廣西匪首鍾亞春，誅之。

translations.literal: Guangxi bandit leader Zhong Yachun was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi rebel chief Zhong Yachun was caught and executed.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，孝德皇后冊諡禮成，追封后父富泰為三等公。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jisi: Empress Xiaode's posthumous title rites were completed; the empress's father Futai was posthumously ennobled as third-rank duke.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jisi, Empress Xiaode's posthumous rites finished and her father Futai was made a third-rank duke.

sentences.zh: 敕奕山酌定俄羅斯通商條例以聞。

translations.literal: Yi Shan was ordered to frame Russian trade regulations and report.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Shan was told to draft Russian trade rules and report.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕江蘇四府漕糧暫行海運。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, order Jiangsu's four prefectures' grain tax temporarily transported by sea.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, grain tax from four Jiangsu prefectures was ordered moved by sea.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，向榮剿賊橫州，敗之。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Xiang Rong suppressed bandits at Hengzhou and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Xiang Rong beat rebels at Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，恤廣西陣亡副將伊克坦布等世職。

translations.literal: On day jimao, favor the families of Guangxi battle-dead Vice Commander Yiketanbu and others with hereditary posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, families of Yiketanbu and other Guangxi dead received hereditary ranks.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, lateral enshrinement at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the temple received a lateral enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、浙江、湖南等省六十七州縣災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted in varying degrees for sixty-seven prefectures and counties in Zhili, Zhejiang, Hunan, and other provinces.
translations.idiomatic: That year sixty-seven disaster-hit districts in Zhili, Zhejiang, Hunan, and elsewhere had taxes cut.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年辛亥春正月戊子朔，御太和殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: Xianfeng 1, year xinhai, spring, first month, day wuzi new moon: the Emperor held court at the Hall of Supreme Harmony to receive congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Xianfeng 1, month 1, wuzi new moon, the Emperor received New Year homage at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 詔直省查明道光三十年以前正耗錢糧實欠在民者，開單請旨。

translations.literal: Edict: direct provinces to ascertain grain tax and surcharges actually owed by the people before Daoguang 30, draw up lists, and request imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were told to list real tax arrears before Daoguang 30 and seek imperial relief.

sentences.zh: 命賽尚阿為大學士。

translations.literal: Saishang'a was ordered to be grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Saishang'a became grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上謁慕陵，行周年大祭禮。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor visited Muling and performed the first-anniversary great sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor mourned at Muling with the first-year great rite.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，還京。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔翰、詹諸臣分撰講義進呈。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, edict: Hanlin and Secretariat academicians each to draft lecture texts and submit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Hanlin and Secretariat scholars were told to draft lectures for the throne.

sentences.zh: 給事中蘇廷魁疏請推誠任賢，慎始圖終。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Su Tingkui memorialized to employ men with full sincerity and be careful at the start to plan the end.
translations.idiomatic: Su Tingkui urged sincere appointments and steady long-term planning.

sentences.zh: 上嘉納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor graciously accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor accepted the advice.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，詔免直省民欠錢糧巳入奏銷者，及於江蘇民欠漕糧，悉予蠲免。

translations.literal: Second month, day yichou: edict remitting direct provinces' grain tax arrears already entered in memorial clearance, and Jiangsu people's grain transport arrears—all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, yichou, cleared provincial tax arrears and Jiangsu transport debts were all forgiven.

sentences.zh: 杜受田疏陳整軍威、募精勇、勸鄉團、察地形四事，發軍前大臣。

translations.literal: Du Shoutian memorialized on four matters: restore military prestige, recruit elite troops, encourage local militia, and inspect terrain—sent to commanders at the front.
translations.idiomatic: Du Shoutian urged restoring discipline, recruiting elites, rallying militia, and studying terrain—memorial sent to field commanders.

sentences.zh: 庚午，李星沅奏剿賊金田獲勝。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Li Xingyuan reported suppressing bandits at Jintian with victory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Li Xingyuan reported victory at Jintian.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔曰：「今年節過春分，寒威未解。

translations.literal: On day jimao, edict: "This year the season has passed the spring equinox yet cold has not lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, edict: "Spring is past the equinox yet the cold will not break.

sentences.zh: 朕返躬內省，未能上感天和。

translations.literal: The Emperor reflects inward and has not moved Heaven to harmony.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor blames himself for failing to move Heaven.

sentences.zh: 因思去冬禮部匯題烈婦一本，內閣票擬雙簽，遂用不必旌表之簽發下。

translations.literal: Recalling that last winter the Ministry of Rites submitted a roster of chaste women, the Grand Secretariat drafted double endorsement, and used the slip "need not confer distinction," which was sent down.
translations.idiomatic: He recalled last winter's chaste-women list that the Grand Secretariat had double-stamped and marked "no commendation."

sentences.zh: 該烈婦等捨生取義，足激薄俗而重綱常，所有烈婦彭氏等三十七口，准其一體旌表，以慰貞魂。

translations.literal: These chaste women gave up life for righteousness, enough to stir a base custom and weighten the constant bonds—all chaste women including Peng and thirty-seven persons are approved for joint distinction, to comfort their chaste souls.
translations.idiomatic: Those women died for virtue; Peng and thirty-seven others would all be honored together to soothe their spirits.

sentences.zh: 」命廣州副都統烏蘭泰帶所制軍械赴廣西剿賊。

translations.literal: " Ulan Tai, Guangzhou vice commander, was ordered to take his manufactured arms to Guangxi to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Ulan Tai was told to bring Guangzhou arms to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，命大學士賽尚阿佩欽差大臣關防，馳往湖南辦理防堵，都統巴清德、副都統達洪阿隨往。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen: order Grand Secretary Saishang'a to wear the Imperial Commissioner seal and hasten to Hunan to handle blocking defense; Commander Batuqingde and Vice Commander Da Hong'a to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, bingshen, Saishang'a was sent to Hunan as commissioner with Batuqingde and Da Hong'a.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上御紫光閣閱射。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor held an archery review at Ziguang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor reviewed archery at Ziguang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，御拱辰殿步射，閱大臣、侍衛射。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, at Gongchen Hall the Emperor held foot archery and reviewed ministers' and guards' shooting.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, at Gongchen Hall he reviewed foot archery for ministers and guards.

sentences.zh: 己酉，河南巡撫潘鐸奏拿獲捻匪姚經年二百餘名。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Henan Governor Pan Duo reported capturing over two hundred Nian bandits led by Yao Jingnian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Pan Duo reported over 200 Nian rebels led by Yao Jingnian captured.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，調廣東、湖南、四川兵赴廣西助剿。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, order Guangdong, Hunan, and Sichuan troops to Guangxi to assist suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, troops from Guangdong, Hunan, and Sichuan were sent to aid Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 壬子，發內帑銀一百萬兩備廣西軍儲，發四川倉穀碾運湖南。

translations.literal: On day renzi, issue inner treasury silver one million taels for Guangxi military stores; issue Sichuan granary grain milled and transported to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, one million taels from the inner treasury went to Guangxi and Sichuan grain was milled for Hunan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，命賽尚阿馳赴廣西接辦軍務。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuwu: order Saishang'a to hasten to Guangxi to take over military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, wuwu, Saishang'a was rushed to Guangxi to command the war.

sentences.zh: 己未，命戶部左侍郎舒興阿為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Vice Minister of Revenue Shuxing'a was appointed Grand Council member.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Shuxing'a became a Grand Council member.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上御乾清門聽政。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor held court at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor heard affairs at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 恤廣西中伏陣亡副將齊清阿等世職。

translations.literal: Hereditary ranks were granted for Vice Commander Qi Qing'a and others who died in Guangxi's midsummer battle.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Qing'a and other Guangxi midsummer dead received hereditary ranks.

sentences.zh: 詔以李星沅等毫無成算，中賊奸計，切責之。

translations.literal: An edict severely rebuked Li Xingyuan and others for having no plan and falling into the rebels' wiles.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xingyuan and others were sharply rebuked for no plan and falling for rebel tricks.

sentences.zh: 以鄭祖琛養癰貽患，遣戍伊犁。

translations.literal: Zheng Zuchen was banished to Yili for fostering trouble like a festering sore.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zuchen was sent to Yili exile for nursing trouble into disaster.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，周天爵奏洪秀全等眾皆散處，山險路熟，伺間衝突，即敗不足以大創。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Zhou Tianjue reported that Hong Xiuquan and his followers were scattered, knew the mountain passes, and would strike when they could; even defeats would not greatly cripple them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Zhou Tianjue said Hong Xiuquan's men were scattered but knew the hills and would raid when they could, so small defeats would not break them.

sentences.zh: 此時兵力不足，專飭防守。

translations.literal: Forces were insufficient; defense only was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were too few; only defense was ordered.

sentences.zh: 須兵有餘力，乃可連營偪剿。

translations.literal: Only with surplus troops could camp lines press in for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Joint camp pressure required spare troops.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「務當嚴防，勿令竄逸。

translations.literal: Edict received: "You must guard strictly and not let them flee.
translations.idiomatic: The edict said: guard strictly and do not let them escape.

sentences.zh: 」賽尚阿師行，賜遏必隆刀，命天津鎮總兵長瑞、涼州鎮總兵長壽從征。

translations.literal: " As Saishang'a's army set out, an Ebilun saber was granted; Tianjin Brigade Commander Chang Rui and Liangzhou Brigade Commander Chang Shou were ordered to campaign.
translations.idiomatic: As Saishang'a marched, he received an Ebilun saber and Chang Rui and Chang Shou were ordered to campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚午，免直隸道光三十年民欠錢糧。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Zhili's unpaid grain and money levies of Daoguang 30 were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Zhili's Daoguang 30 arrears in grain and money were remitted.

sentences.zh: 周天爵奏劾右江鎮總兵惠慶、右江道慶吉剿賊不力，均奪職。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianjue impeached Youjiang Brigade Commander Hui Qing and Youjiang Circuit Intendant Qing Ji for slack suppression; both were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tianjue impeached Hui Qing and Qing Ji for poor suppression and both lost office.

sentences.zh: 丙子，李星沅奏剿滅上林墟會匪。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Li Xingyuan reported the Shanglin market secret-society bandits destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Li Xingyuan reported the Shanglin market bandits wiped out.

sentences.zh: 癸未，李星沅卒。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Li Xingyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Li Xingyuan died.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭泰奏，四月初三日，抵武宣軍營。

translations.literal: Wulantai reported that on the third day of the fourth month he reached the Wuxuan army camp.
translations.idiomatic: Wulantai reported reaching the Wuxuan camp on the third of the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 查詢賊勢，類皆烏合。

translations.literal: On inquiry, rebel strength was mostly loose rabble.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel forces were mostly loose mobs.

sentences.zh: 惟武宣東鄉會匪有眾萬餘，蓄髮易服，有偽王、偽官名目，實廣西腹心之患。

translations.literal: But the Wuxuan Dongxiang secret-society had over ten thousand men, cut their hair and changed dress, with bogus kings and officials—a core menace in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: But Wuxuan Dongxiang had ten thousand men with hair cut and rebel titles—a core Guangxi threat.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「賊情狡獪，務當持重。

translations.literal: Edict received: "The rebels are cunning; you must act with caution.
translations.idiomatic: The edict said the rebels were cunning and required caution.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict ended."

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，周天爵奏，武宣東鄉逸賊竄入象州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuzi: Zhou Tianjue reported that Dongxiang fugitives from Wuxuan had fled into Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, wuzi, Zhou Tianjue said Wuxuan Dongxiang fugitives entered Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔切責之，各予薄譴。

translations.literal: An edict sharply rebuked them and each received a light censure.
translations.idiomatic: They were sharply rebuked and lightly censured.

sentences.zh: 詔湖南提督余萬清協同堵剿。

translations.literal: Hunan Provincial Military Commander Yu Wanqing was ordered to join in blocking and suppressing them.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Wanqing was ordered to help block and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，卓秉恬奏請行堅壁清野之法，下賽尚阿及督撫知之。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Zhuo Bingtian memorialized to implement the policy of strengthening walls and clearing the countryside; Saishang'a and the governors-general and governors were informed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Zhuo Bingtian urged strengthened walls and cleared countryside and Saishang'a and provincial chiefs were told.

sentences.zh: 甲午，周天爵奏剿平泗城股匪，陳亞等投誠，追賊入合浦。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Zhou Tianjue reported pacifying the Sicheng bandit band; Chen Ya and others surrendered and pursuit drove the rebels into Hepu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Zhou Tianjue pacified Sicheng bandits; Chen Ya surrendered and pursuit drove rebels into Hepu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，烏蘭泰奏，四月十七日，馳至象州，堵截逸賊。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Wulantai reported that on the seventeenth day of the fourth month he hurried to Xiangzhou and blocked the fugitive rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Wulantai said he reached Xiangzhou on the seventeenth of the fourth month and blocked fugitives.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，陝甘總督琦善以剿辦番族，率意妄殺，奪職逮問。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Qishan was stripped of office and arrested for arbitrary killing while suppressing tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Qishan lost office and was arrested for reckless killing in tribal suppression.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以季芝昌為閩浙總督，以戶部尚書裕誠協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Ji Zhichang was made Min-Zhe governor-general; Minister of Revenue Yucheng was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Ji Zhichang took Min-Zhe and Yucheng became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔停中外一切工程。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, an edict halted all domestic and foreign construction projects.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, all domestic and foreign works were halted.

sentences.zh: 命工部右侍郎彭蘊章為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Works Peng Yunzhang was appointed Grand Council member.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yunzhang became a Grand Council member.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上詣大高殿祈雨。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，賽尚阿報抵長沙。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: Saishang'a reported reaching Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, dingsi, Saishang'a reported reaching Changsha.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「象州之賊，宜重兵合圍。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The rebels at Xiangzhou should be heavily encircled.
translations.idiomatic: The edict said Xiangzhou rebels needed heavy encirclement.

sentences.zh: 分竄南寧、太平之賊，應分兵追剿。

translations.literal: Rebels split toward Nanning and Taiping should be pursued with divided forces.
translations.idiomatic: Split bands toward Nanning and Taiping should be pursued separately.

sentences.zh: 其尚審度地勢人材，聯絡布置。

translations.literal: You should still weigh terrain and talent and coordinate deployment.
translations.idiomatic: Terrain, talent, and coordinated deployment were still required.

sentences.zh: 糧台尤關緊要，並宜分置，以利轉輸。

translations.literal: Grain depots are especially critical and should be placed separately to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: Grain depots were critical and should be split to aid supply.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，烏蘭泰奏，五月初十日，賊陷貴州兵營，當日奪回。

translations.literal: " On day bingyin, Wulantai reported that on the tenth day of the fifth month rebels took the Guizhou army camp and it was recovered the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Wulantai said rebels took the Guizhou camp on the tenth of the fifth month and it was retaken that day.

sentences.zh: 其南山屯集之賊，亦經迎擊南竄。

translations.literal: Rebels massed on South Mountain were also met and driven south.
translations.idiomatic: South Mountain rebels were also met and driven south.

sentences.zh: 陣亡官十五員，兵二百餘名，附單請恤。

translations.literal: Fifteen officers and over two hundred soldiers died in battle; a list requested condolence grants.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen officers and over two hundred soldiers died; condolence was requested.

sentences.zh: 首先敗退之貴州參將佟攀梅等褫職。

translations.literal: Guizhou Deputy Commander Tong Panmei and others who fled first were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Panmei and other first fugitives from Guizhou lost office.

sentences.zh: 辛未，撥江海關稅銀十五萬兩，解備湖北過境兵差。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, 150,000 taels of Jiang-Hai Customs revenue were allocated for Hubei transit troops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, 150,000 taels of customs silver were set aside for Hubei transit troops.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賽尚阿奏，六月初四日，馳抵桂林，通籌全局。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Saishang'a reported that on the fourth day of the sixth month he hurried to Guilin to plan the whole campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Saishang'a reached Guilin on the fourth of the sixth month to plan the campaign.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其均合機宜。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his measures as all fitting the moment.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised his measures as timely.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，河南南陽捻匪四齣滋擾，詔所司捕之。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Nanyang Nian bandits in Henan raided in four directions; local officials were ordered to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Nanyang Nian bandits raided widely in Henan and officials were ordered to seize them.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，西寧番匪搶掠，敕薩迎阿遣將剿捕。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Xining tribal bandits plundered; Sa Ying'a was ordered to send generals to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Xining tribes plundered and Sa Ying'a was ordered to send troops.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙戌，賽尚阿奏，賊由象州回竄東鄉，派兵堵剿。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingxu: Saishang'a reported rebels had fled from Xiangzhou back to Dongxiang and troops were sent to block them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, bingxu, Saishang'a said rebels fled from Xiangzhou to Dongxiang and blocking troops were sent.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，御史焦友瀛疏言吏治因循，宜綜覈名實。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Censor Jiao Youying memorialized that officialdom was slack and name and fact should be jointly verified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Jiao Youying said officials were slack and merit should match reality.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「如果牧令得人，何至姦宄潛聚，釀成巨患？

translations.literal: Edict received: "If prefects and magistrates were well chosen, how could villains gather secretly and breed a great disaster?
translations.idiomatic: The edict asked how villains could gather if local officials were sound.

sentences.zh: 嗣後有似此者，惟督撫是問。

translations.literal: Hereafter when such cases occur, only the governors-general and governors will be held accountable.
translations.idiomatic: Later such cases would hold only governors-general and governors accountable.

sentences.zh: 」庚子，賽尚阿奏，進剿新墟賊匪，七戰皆捷。

translations.literal: " On day gengzi, Saishang'a reported advancing against the Xin'xu bandits with seven victories in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Saishang'a advanced on Xin'xu bandits with seven straight victories.

sentences.zh: 賞還烏蘭泰、秦定三花翎。

translations.literal: Wulantai and Qin Dingsan had their peacock feathers restored.
translations.idiomatic: Wulantai and Qin Dingsan regained their peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 命湖廣、四川督撫嚴查會匪、教匪。

translations.literal: Huguang and Sichuan governors-general and governors were ordered to investigate secret-society and sect rebels strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang and Sichuan chiefs were ordered to investigate secret societies and sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁未，敕南河歲修工程，以三百萬為率。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the annual Yellow River conservancy works were ordered to take three million taels as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, annual Yellow River works were set at three million taels.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賽尚阿奏：「查明軍將功過，烏蘭泰先勝後敗，由於猛追中伏，賊人壅流設伏，後軍死流湍者百餘。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Saishang'a reported: "Merit and fault among commanders were investigated. Wulantai won first and lost later because in hot pursuit he fell into an ambush; the rebels dammed the stream and lay in wait, and over a hundred rear troops drowned in the rapids.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Saishang'a reported Wulantai's later defeat came from pursuit into a stream ambush where over a hundred rear troops drowned.

sentences.zh: 向榮初到桂時，連獲勝仗，每勝賞兵銀人各一兩。

translations.literal: When Xiang Rong first reached Guangxi he won successive victories and each victory brought one tael reward silver per soldier.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Rong's early Guangxi victories brought one tael per soldier.

sentences.zh: 李星沅既至，減為三錢。

translations.literal: After Li Xingyuan arrived it was cut to three mace.
translations.idiomatic: After Li Xingyuan came, rewards fell to three mace.

sentences.zh: 眾兵譁然，誓不出戰。

translations.literal: The troops clamored and swore not to fight.
translations.idiomatic: The troops clamored and refused battle.

sentences.zh: 現巳分別汰除，務知持重。

translations.literal: The unruly have now been weeded out separately; you must still act with caution.
translations.idiomatic: The worst were now removed; caution was still required.

sentences.zh: 」安徽巡撫蔣文慶奏，壽州匪犯程六麻與合肥捻匪高四八作亂。

translations.literal: " Anhui Governor Jiang Wenqing reported that Shouzhou bandit Cheng Liuma and Hefei Nian bandit Gao Siba had risen in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Wenqing reported Shouzhou's Cheng Liuma and Hefei Nian Gao Siba in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，調鮑起豹為湖南提督，榮玉材為雲南提督，重綸為貴州提督。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Bao Qibao was transferred to Hunan provincial military commander; Rong Yucai to Yunnan provincial military commander; Chonglun to Guizhou provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Bao Qibao took Hunan, Rong Yucai Yunnan, and Chonglun Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，賽尚阿奏，進剿新墟賊巢，奪占豬綌峽、雙髻山。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yimao: Saishang'a reported advancing on the Xin'xu rebel nest and seizing Zhu'xie Gorge and Shuangji Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, yimao, Saishang'a took the Xin'xu nest and Zhu'xie Gorge and Shuangji Mountain.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: Edict received with praise.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised the report.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，山東巡撫陳慶偕奏，登州水師船被賊扌虜，副將落水。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Shandong Governor Chen Qingxie reported that Dengzhou naval ships were captured by bandits and the deputy commander fell into the water.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Chen Qingxie said Dengzhou naval ships were taken and the deputy commander fell overboard.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「速往追剿。

translations.literal: Edict received: "Hurry to pursue and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: The edict ordered swift pursuit.

sentences.zh: 」並敕奕興、訥爾經額嚴防海口。

translations.literal: " Yixing and Ne'erjing'e were also ordered to guard the sea mouths strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing and Ne'erjing'e were also ordered to guard the sea mouths.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書惠豐卒。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Huifeng died.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Huifeng died.

sentences.zh: 閏八月甲申朔，新墟眾首洪秀全陷永安州，踞之，僭號太平天國。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day jiashen, first day: rebel chief Hong Xiuquan took Yong'an prefecture, held it, and styled his state the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: On intercalary month 8, jiashen, Hong Xiuquan took Yong'an and proclaimed the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

sentences.zh: 陸建瀛奏請禁天主教。

translations.literal: Lu Jianying memorialized to ban Catholicism.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jianying asked to ban Catholicism.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「與外夷交涉，當慎之於始。

translations.literal: Edict received: "In dealing with foreigners, caution is needed from the start.
translations.idiomatic: The edict said foreign dealings required caution from the start.

sentences.zh: 原約所有者，仍應循守舊章。

translations.literal: What the original treaties provide should still be followed under the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Original treaty terms should still follow old regulations.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，程矞采奏，陽山賊匪竄撲宜章、乳源，飭總兵孫應照往剿。

translations.literal: " On day wuzi, Cheng Yucai reported Yangshan bandits had raided Yizhang and Ruyuan; Brigade Commander Sun Yingzhao was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Cheng Yucai said Yangshan bandits hit Yizhang and Ruyuan and Sun Yingzhao was sent against them.

sentences.zh: 予廣西殉難巡檢馮元吉世職，建祠，其子澍溥附祀。

translations.literal: Guangxi martyr Subprefect Feng Yuanji received a hereditary rank, a shrine, and his son Shupu was granted attached sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Martyr Feng Yuanji of Guangxi received hereditary rank, a shrine, and son Shupu attached sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 甲午，南河豐北三堡河決。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Yellow River burst at Fengbei Third Bastion on the South River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Yellow River broke at Fengbei Third Bastion.

sentences.zh: 庚子，定考試軍機章京例。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, regulations were fixed for examining Grand Council clerks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Grand Council clerk examinations were regulated.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賽尚阿奏新墟賊翻山竄出，陷永安州。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Saishang'a reported Xin'xu rebels had crossed the mountains and taken Yong'an prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Saishang'a said Xin'xu rebels broke out and took Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 詔切責之，下部議處。

translations.literal: An edict sharply rebuked him and referred the case to the ministries for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: He was sharply rebuked and referred to the ministries.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命河北鎮總兵董光甲、鄖陽鎮總兵邵鶴齡馳赴廣西剿賊。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Hebei Brigade Commander Dong Guangjia and Yunyang Brigade Commander Shao Heling were ordered to hurry to Guangxi to suppress rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Dong Guangjia and Shao Heling were rushed to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，常大淳奏盜船在石浦肆劫，知府羅鏞擊走之。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Chang Dachun reported pirate ships plundered at Shipu and Prefect Luo Yong drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Chang Dachun said pirates raided Shipu and Luo Yong drove them off.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以舒興阿為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Shuxing'a was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Shuxing'a became Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，賽尚阿奏巴清德、向榮託病諉卸，進兵遲延。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengwu: Saishang'a reported Ba Qingde and Xiang Rong pleaded illness to shirk duty and delayed advancing.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, gengwu, Saishang'a said Ba Qingde and Xiang Rong feigned illness and delayed advance.

sentences.zh: 得旨，均奪職自效。

translations.literal: Edict received: both were stripped of office to redeem themselves by service.
translations.idiomatic: Both lost office and had to redeem themselves in the field.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔議河海並運漕米章程。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, an edict ordered discussion of joint river and sea grain transport regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, joint river-sea grain transport rules were ordered discussed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，敕建定海陣亡總兵葛雲飛、鄭國鴻專祠。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuxu: dedicated shrines were ordered built for fallen Dinghai Brigade Commander Ge Yunfei and Zheng Guohong.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, wuxu, shrines were ordered for Ge Yunfei and Zheng Guohong of Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，葉名琛奏，剿辦英德賊匪淨盡。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jimao: Ye Mingchen reported Yingde bandits fully suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jimao, Ye Mingchen reported Yingde bandits cleared.

sentences.zh: 加太子少保。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He became Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，賽尚阿奏，向榮進扎龍眼塘。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingyou: Saishang'a reported Xiang Rong had advanced and encamped at Longyantang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, dingyou, Saishang'a said Xiang Rong encamped at Longyantang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，陸建瀛奏，海盜布興有繳械投誠，撥營安插。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Lu Jianying reported pirate Bu Xingyou had surrendered arms and was assigned to a camp.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Lu Jianying said Bu Xingyou surrendered arms and was placed in camp.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the joint winter sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the winter temple sacrifice was held.

sentences.zh: 是歲，普免道光三十年以前民欠錢糧。

translations.literal: That year, grain and money levies owed before Daoguang 30 were broadly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year, arrears before Daoguang 30 were broadly remitted.

sentences.zh: 又免直隸六十一州縣民欠旗租，浙江五十一州縣帶徵銀米。

translations.literal: Banner rent arrears in sixty-one Zhili prefectures and counties and supplementary grain and silver in fifty-one Zhejiang prefectures and counties were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili banner rent and Zhejiang supplementary levies were also remitted.

sentences.zh: 又免奉天十五廳州縣，吉林四城，黑龍江一城，湖南七廳州縣災賦。

translations.literal: Disaster levies were also remitted in fifteen Fengtian districts, four Jilin cities, one Heilongjiang city, and seven Hunan districts.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster levies were remitted in Fengtian, Jilin, Heilongjiang, and Hunan districts.

sentences.zh: 又免浙江、福建鹽場欠課。

translations.literal: Salt-field arrears in Zhejiang and Fujian were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang and Fujian salt-field arrears were also remitted.

sentences.zh: 又免廣西被賊八十六州縣額賦。

translations.literal: Quota levies in eighty-six Guangxi prefectures and counties ravaged by rebels were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Quota levies in eighty-six rebel-hit Guangxi districts were also remitted.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年壬子春正月壬子朔，封奕劻貝子，奉慶親王永璘祀。

translations.literal: In the second year, day renzi, spring, first month, day renzi, first day: Prince Yikuang was enfeoffed as a beile and sacrifices were offered to Prince Qing Yonglin.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2, month 1, renzi, Yikuang was made beile and Yonglin received sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以裕誠為大學士，訥爾經額協辦大學士，禧恩為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Yucheng was made grand secretary; Ne'erjing'e associate grand secretary; Xi'en Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Yucheng became grand secretary, Ne'erjing'e associate, and Xi'en took Revenue.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賽尚阿奏，距永安州城三里安營督戰。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Saishang'a reported encamping three li from Yong'an city to direct operations.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Saishang'a camped three li from Yong'an to direct battle.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命侍郎全慶、副都統隆慶冊封朝鮮國王妃。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Vice Ministers Quanqing and Vice Banner Commander Longqing were ordered to invest Korea's queen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Quanqing and Longqing were sent to invest Korea's queen.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，陳慶偕病免，以李僡為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: Chen Qingxie left office on illness; Li Huan was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, dinghai, Chen Qingxie retired ill and Li Huan took Shandong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上詣西陵。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor proceeded to the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor went to the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，大葬宣宗成皇帝於慕陵。

translations.literal: Third month, day renzi: the late Emperor Xuanzong was buried at Muling.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, renzi, Emperor Xuanzong was buried at Muling.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上還京，恭奉宣宗成皇帝，孝穆、孝慎、孝全三皇后神牌升祔太廟，頒詔覃恩。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor returned to the capital, respectfully escorting the spirit tablets of the Chengzu Emperor Xuanzong and Empresses Xiaomu, Xiaoshen, and Xiaoquan to joint enshrinement in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and issued an edict proclaiming grace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Emperor returned to Beijing, enshrined Xuanzong and three empresses in the Ancestral Temple, and proclaimed grace.

sentences.zh: 庚申，鄒鳴鶴奏永安踞匪全數東竄，烏蘭泰追賊不利，總兵長瑞、長壽、董光甲、邵鶴齡均死之。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Zou Minghe memorialized that the entrenched bandits at Yong'an had all fled east; Wulantai's pursuit went badly, and Brigade Generals Chang Rui, Chang Shou, Dong Guangjia, and Shao Heling all died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Zou Minghe reported Yong'an bandits had fled east; Wulantai's pursuit failed and four brigade generals died.

sentences.zh: 得旨，賽尚阿等下部議處，敕程矞采派兵在湖南防堵，恤長瑞等四總兵世職，建祠。

translations.literal: By imperial rescript, Saishang'a and others were referred to the ministries for deliberation on punishment; Cheng Yucai was ordered to dispatch troops to block in Hunan; hereditary offices were granted to the four brigade generals including Chang Rui, and temples were established.
translations.idiomatic: By rescript, Saishang'a faced board review, Cheng Yucai was sent to block Hunan, the four generals received hereditary rank, and temples were built.

sentences.zh: 廣州副都統烏蘭泰卒于軍，贈都統，照陣亡例賜恤。

translations.literal: Guangzhou Vice Commander-in-Chief Wulantai died in the army; he was posthumously made Commander-in-Chief and given condolence per the killed-in-action precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Wulantai, Guangzhou vice commander, died in camp; he was posthumously made commander-in-chief with battle-death condolence.

sentences.zh: 丙子，恤廣西死事副將阿爾精阿等世職。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, hereditary offices were granted to Guangxi Deputy Brigadier A'erjing'a and others who died in service.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, hereditary rank was granted to A'erjing'a and other Guangxi deputies who died in service.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，內閣學士勝保疏言：「游觀之所，煥然一新。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Grand Secretariat academician Shengbao memorialized: "The sightseeing grounds have been made entirely new.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Shengbao memorialized: "The sightseeing grounds are entirely new.

sentences.zh: 小民竊議，有累主德。

translations.literal: The common people whisper that this tarnishes the ruler's virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Common people whisper that this harms the ruler's virtue.

sentences.zh: 」上優容之。

translations.literal: The Emperor received it leniently.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor received it leniently.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，常雩，祀天於圜丘，恭奉宣宗成皇帝配享。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day renwu: routine rain prayer; Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound; the Chengzu Emperor Xuanzong was respectfully associated in the offering.
translations.idiomatic: In summer month 4, renwu, rain was prayed at the Circular Mound with Xuanzong associated.

sentences.zh: 甲申，府尹王慶雲疏陳河東鹽務，永禁簽商，可募鉅款。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, metropolitan governor Wang Qingyun memorialized on Hedong salt affairs: permanently banning contract merchants could raise huge sums.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wang Qingyun said banning contract salt merchants could raise huge revenue.

sentences.zh: 下部議行。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: It was referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上謁慕陵，行釋服禮。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor visited Mu Mausoleum and performed the mourning-end rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Emperor visited Mu Mausoleum and ended mourning.

sentences.zh: 命徐廣縉為欽差大臣，接辦廣西軍務。

translations.literal: Xu Guangjin was appointed Imperial Commissioner to take over Guangxi military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Guangjin became Imperial Commissioner for Guangxi military affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，程矞采奏郴州匪徒劉代偉作亂，參將積拉明捕誅之。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Cheng Yucai reported that bandit Liu Daiwei had raised trouble at Chenzhou; Battalion Commander Jilaming captured and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Cheng Yucai reported Liu Daiwei's Chenzhou revolt; Jilaming captured and killed him.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，常大淳奏，鹽梟拒捕，戕斃副將張蕙、知縣德成，經提督善祿、知府畢承昭派兵攻擊，斬擒百餘，餘匪逃散。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Chang Dachun reported that salt smugglers had resisted arrest and killed Deputy Brigadier Zhang Hui and Magistrate Decheng; after Brigade Commander Shanlu and Prefect Bi Chengzhao sent troops to attack, over a hundred were killed or captured and the rest scattered.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Chang Dachun reported salt smugglers killed Zhang Hui and Decheng; Shanlu and Bi Chengzhao killed or captured over a hundred and the rest fled.

sentences.zh: 予張蕙、德成世職。

translations.literal: Hereditary offices were granted to Zhang Hui and Decheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hui and Decheng received hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 太僕寺少卿徐繼畬疏陳釋服之後，宜防三漸：一、土木之漸，一、宴安之漸，一、壅蔽之漸。

translations.literal: Junior Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud Xu Jiyu memorialized that after mourning one should guard against three gradual declines: construction excess, ease and comfort, and blocked counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jiyu warned that after mourning one should guard against construction, comfort, and blocked counsel.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「置諸座右，時時省覽。

translations.literal: By imperial rescript: "Place this at your right hand and review it constantly.
translations.idiomatic: Rescript: "Place this at your right hand and review it constantly.

sentences.zh: 」己亥，減乾隆朝所增名糧兵六萬六千餘名。

translations.literal: " On day jihai, the Qianlong-era added nominal-ration soldiers of over sixty-six thousand were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: " On jihai, over sixty-six thousand Qianlong-era added ration soldiers were cut.

sentences.zh: 庚子，程矞采奏，洪秀全撲全州，進撲永州，分股竄永福、義寧，檄提督鮑起豹、劉長清分御之，並咨照賽尚阿一同堵御。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Cheng Yucai reported that Hong Xiuquan had assaulted Quanzhou and was advancing on Yongzhou, with detachments raiding Yongfu and Yining; he ordered Brigade Generals Bao Qibao and Liu Changqing to defend separately and notified Saishang'a to block together.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Cheng Yucai reported Hong Xiuquan took Quanzhou, advanced on Yongzhou, and raided Yongfu and Yining; Bao Qibao and Liu Changqing were ordered to defend and Saishang'a to block.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，特登額免，以桂良為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Tedeng'e was dismissed and Gui Liang was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Tedeng'e was dismissed and Gui Liang became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賜章鋆等二百三十九人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yisi, two hundred thirty-nine men including Zhang Jun were granted metropolitan graduate degrees with differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Zhang Jun and two hundred thirty-eight others received jinshi degrees with differing ranks.

sentences.zh: 琦善遣戍吉林。

translations.literal: Qishan was banished to Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan was banished to Jilin.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鄒鳴鶴以留兵守城，不令追賊，奪職。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Zou Minghe was stripped of office for keeping troops to guard the city and not allowing pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zou Minghe lost office for holding troops in the city and not pursuing.

sentences.zh: 以勞崇光為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Lao Chongguang was made Guangxi Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Lao Chongguang became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命截留漕米六十萬石，分運江蘇、山東備賑。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, six hundred thousand piculs of tribute grain were ordered held back and split for transport to Jiangsu and Shandong for relief stores.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, six hundred thousand piculs of tribute grain were held for Jiangsu and Shandong relief.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，布彥泰奏，庫存回布四十萬匹，請變通折征，允之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinhai: Buyantai reported four hundred thousand bolts of stored Muslim cloth and requested flexible conversion collection; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, xinhai, Buyantai sought flexible tax conversion on four hundred thousand bolts of stored cloth; approved.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，夏至，祭地於方澤，恭奉宣宗成皇帝配享。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, summer solstice; Earth was sacrificed to at the Square Mound; the Chengzu Emperor Xuanzong was respectfully associated in the offering.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, at the solstice Earth was sacrificed at the Square Mound with Xuanzong associated.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賊陷湖南道州。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, bandits took Daozhou in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, bandits took Hunan's Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 賽尚阿留守桂林，檄江忠源、張國樑移兵湖南。

translations.literal: Saishang'a remained at Guilin and ordered Jiang Zhongyuan and Zhang Guoliang to move troops to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Saishang'a stayed at Guilin and ordered Jiang Zhongyuan and Zhang Guoliang into Hunan.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，查辦山東賑務。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiashen: Shandong relief affairs were investigated.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, jiashen, Shandong relief was investigated.

sentences.zh: 杜受田、怡良疏言漕船入東，先行起卸，以資散放。

translations.literal: Du Shoutian and Yiliang memorialized that when grain boats entered Shandong they should unload early to fund distribution.
translations.idiomatic: Du Shoutian and Yiliang said grain boats entering Shandong should unload early for distribution.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命賽尚阿赴湖南督辦軍務，徐廣縉接辦廣西軍務。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Saishang'a was ordered to Hunan to supervise military affairs; Xu Guangjin took over Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Saishang'a went to Hunan and Xu Guangjin took Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，策立皇后鈕祜祿氏。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Empress Niohuru was formally installed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Empress Niohuru was installed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，僧格林沁奏劾御前大臣鄭親王端華修改大考侍講學士保清試卷，阻止不聽，驕矜亢愎，難與共事。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Sengge Rinchen impeached Imperial Presence Minister Prince Zheng Duanhua for altering Examination Reader Ba Qing's examination papers and refusing to desist when stopped—arrogant and obstinate, hard to work with.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Sengge Rinchen impeached Duanhua for altering Ba Qing's exam papers and refusing to stop—arrogant and unworkable.

sentences.zh: 詔端華退出御前大臣，保清褫職。

translations.literal: An edict removed Duanhua from the Imperial Presence ministers; Ba Qing was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Duanhua left the Imperial Presence ministers and Ba Qing was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以慧成為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Huicheng was made Hedong River Conservancy Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Huicheng became Hedong river conservancy governor-general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，廣東羅鏡凌十八股匪剿平，上嘉獎之。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jiwei: the eighteen factions of bandits at Luojing Ling in Guangdong were pacified; the Emperor commended it.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn month 7, jiwei, eighteen Luojing Ling bandit factions in Guangdong were pacified and commended.

sentences.zh: 烏什辦事大臣春熙奏，回匪鐵完庫里霍卓竄擾烏什，官兵擊退。

translations.literal: Wushi commissioner Chunxi reported that Muslim bandit Tiewankuli Huozhuo had raided Wushi; government troops beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: Chunxi reported Tiewankuli Huozhuo raiding Wushi; troops beat them back.

sentences.zh: 詔參贊詳查以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the counselor-deliberator to investigate fully and report.
translations.idiomatic: The counselor-deliberator was told to investigate and report.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔軍務未竣，需材孔亟，其有知兵之人，所在保舉錄用。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, an edict said that with military affairs unfinished and talent urgently needed, men knowing warfare were to be recommended everywhere for employment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, edict: recommend men who know warfare everywhere for service.

sentences.zh: 詔直省修整城垣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the provinces to repair city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were ordered to repair city walls.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，協辦大學士杜受田卒。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Associate Grand Secretary Du Shoutian died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Associate Grand Secretary Du Shoutian died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，羅繞典奏，行抵長沙，聞知賊由道州竄出江華、永明、桂陽、嘉禾，誠恐衡郡有失，省垣亦應預防。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Luo Zhaodian reported reaching Changsha and hearing that bandits from Daozhou had fled through Jianghua, Yongming, Guiyang, and Jiahe; he feared Hengzhou might fall and that the provincial capital should also be guarded in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Luo Zhaodian reached Changsha, heard bandits from Daozhou had fled through four counties, and feared for Hengzhou and the capital.

sentences.zh: 得旨，即妥籌辦理。

translations.literal: By imperial rescript: arrange this promptly and properly.
translations.idiomatic: Rescript: arrange this promptly and properly.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，給事中袁甲三劾定郡王載銓、尚書恆春、侍郎書元，迭查有跡，各予譴責，其題詠載銓息肩圖各員，並下部議處。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Censor Yuan Jiasan impeached Prince Ding Zaiquan, Minister Hengchun, and Vice Minister Shu Yuan; repeated investigation found grounds, and each was censured; those who wrote poems on Zaiquan's "Shoulders at Rest" were also referred to the ministries for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yuan Jiasan impeached Zaiquan, Hengchun, and Shu Yuan; all were censured and poem-writers on Zaiquan's picture faced board review.

sentences.zh: 庚午，奕山、布彥泰奏，回匪倭里罕糾約布魯特突入卡倫，官兵擊卻之。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Yishan and Buyantai reported that Muslim leader Wali Khan had mustered Buruts to rush the border posts; government troops repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Yishan and Buyantai reported Wali Khan and Buruts rushing posts; troops repelled them.

sentences.zh: 壬申，洪秀全攻陷郴州。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Hong Xiuquan took Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Hong Xiuquan took Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，常大淳奏岳州宜籌防堵，詔徐廣縉撥兵前往。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Chang Dachun memorialized that Yuezhou should be blocked in advance; an edict ordered Xu Guangjin to send troops there.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Chang Dachun said Yuezhou should be blocked; Xu Guangjin was told to send troops.

sentences.zh: 以麟魁為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Lin Kui was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Kui became Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯朔，向榮以稱病規避奪職，遣戍新疆，尋留軍自效。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day jiamao: Xiang Rong was stripped of office for feigning illness to avoid duty and banished to Xinjiang; soon he was kept with the army to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jiamao new moon, Xiang Rong lost office for feigning illness, was banished to Xinjiang, then kept with the army.

sentences.zh: 以福興為廣西提督。

translations.literal: Fuxing was made Guangxi Brigade Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Fuxing became Guangxi brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 癸未，初舉經筵。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the classics lecture was first held.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the classics lecture began.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔湖廣督撫：「湖南之洞庭湖、湖北之大江，均有捕魚小船及經商大船數千百隻，亟宜收集，免為賊用。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, an edict to Huguang governors said: "Dongting Lake in Hunan and the great river in Hubei have hundreds or thousands of fishing and trading boats—they must be gathered quickly lest the bandits use them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Huguang governors were told: "Gather fishing and trading boats on Dongting and the great river lest bandits use them.

sentences.zh: 其各船水手習於風濤，堪充水勇，其即留心招集。

translations.literal: Their sailors, skilled on wind and waves, could serve as water fighters; recruit them attentively."
translations.idiomatic: Recruit their wind-tested sailors as water fighters."

sentences.zh: 」己丑，羅繞典、駱秉章奏，賊匪陷安仁、攸縣，進圖省城。

translations.literal: " On day jichou, Luo Zhaodian and Luo Bingzhang reported that bandits had taken Anren and Youxian and were advancing on the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: " On jichou, Luo Zhaodian and Luo Bingzhang reported bandits took Anren and Youxian and advanced on the capital.

sentences.zh: 敕賽尚阿速解省圍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Saishang'a to raise the siege on the capital quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Saishang'a was told to lift the capital siege quickly.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命廷臣會籌軍儲。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, court ministers were ordered to meet and plan military funds.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, ministers were ordered to plan military funds.

sentences.zh: 調常大淳為山西巡撫，以羅繞典為湖北巡撫，張芾署江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Chang Dachun was transferred to Shanxi Governor; Luo Zhaodian was made Hubei Governor; Zhang Fei acted as Jiangxi Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Dachun went to Shanxi, Luo Zhaodian to Hubei, and Zhang Fei acted in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命暫免四川、江西商販運往湖北米稅。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, grain taxes on Sichuan and Jiangxi merchants shipping rice to Hubei were temporarily waived.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, rice taxes on Sichuan and Jiangxi grain shipped to Hubei were waived.

sentences.zh: 調福建、浙江兵一千名赴江西防堵。

translations.literal: A thousand Fujian and Zhejiang troops were transferred to block in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand Fujian and Zhejiang troops went to block Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，詔賽尚阿視師無功，貽誤封疆，褫職逮問，籍其家。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiyou: an edict said Saishang'a had commanded without success and harmed the frontier; he was stripped of office, arrested for trial, and his property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, jiyou, Saishang'a failed in command, was stripped, arrested, and his property seized.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以載銓為步軍統領，以訥爾經額為大學士，禧恩協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Zaiquan was made Metropolitan Barracks Commander; Ne'erjing'e was made Grand Secretary; Xi'en was made Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zaiquan took the barracks, Ne'erjing'e became Grand Secretary, and Xi'en associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，獲西寧番賊阿里克公住，斬之。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Xining Tibetan bandit Aligongzhu was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Xining bandit Aligongzhu was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 命駱秉章暫留湖南會辦。

translations.literal: Luo Bingzhang was ordered to stay temporarily in Hunan to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Bingzhang was ordered to stay in Hunan to assist.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上謁東陵。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs.

sentences.zh: 恤湖南陣亡總兵福誠等世職。

translations.literal: Hereditary offices were granted to Hunan brigade generals including Fucheng who died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary rank was granted to Fucheng and other Hunan generals killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 己未，常大淳奏賊將北竄，防禦兵單。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Chang Dachun reported that the bandits would flee north and that defenses were thin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Chang Dachun said bandits would flee north and troops were few.

sentences.zh: 命徐廣縉撥兵赴岳州助防。

translations.literal: Xu Guangjin was ordered to send troops to Yuezhou to help defend.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Guangjin was ordered to send troops to Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上還京。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，上臨贈大學士杜受田第賜奠，加其父杜堮禮部尚書銜。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day xinsi: the Emperor visited late Grand Secretary Du Shoutian's residence to offer condolences and added his father Du Zeng the title of Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In winter month 10, xinsi, the Emperor condoled at Du Shoutian's house and gave his father Du Zeng a Rites minister title.

sentences.zh: 甲申，黃宗漢奏請浙江新漕改由海運，從之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Huang Zonghan requested that Zhejiang's new tribute grain go by sea transport; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Huang Zonghan's request for Zhejiang sea transport of new tribute grain was approved.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，季芝昌免，以吳文鎔為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Ji Zhichang was dismissed and Wu Wenrong was made Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Ji Zhichang was dismissed and Wu Wenrong became Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day dingwei: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, dingwei new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賊陷岳州。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, bandits took Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, bandits took Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，起琦善署河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Qishan was recalled to act as Henan Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Qishan was recalled to act as Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔徐廣縉分兵防守武昌、漢陽、荊州，陸建瀛、蔣文慶各就地勢扼要嚴防。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, an edict ordered Xu Guangjin to split forces to defend Wuchang, Hanyang, and Jingzhou; Lu Jianying and Jiang Wenqing were each to hold key points strictly according to terrain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Xu Guangjin was to defend Wuchang, Hanyang, and Jingzhou; Lu Jianying and Jiang Wenqing were to hold key terrain.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以賊近湖北，敕琦善嚴防河南邊境，詔張芾嚴防沿江要隘。

translations.literal: On day guihai, as bandits neared Hubei, Qishan was ordered to guard Henan's border strictly; Zhang Fei was ordered to guard critical points along the river.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, with bandits near Hubei, Qishan guarded Henan and Zhang Fei the river passes.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以文慶為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Wenqing was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Wenqing became Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賊陷漢陽，命陸建瀛馳赴上游防堵。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, bandits took Hanyang; Lu Jianying was ordered to hurry upstream to block.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, bandits took Hanyang; Lu Jianying was sent upstream to block.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，復向榮提督銜。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Xiang Rong's brigade commander title was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Xiang Rong's brigade commander title was restored.

sentences.zh: 詔在籍侍郎曾國籓督辦團練。

translations.literal: An edict ordered retired Vice Minister Zeng Guofan to supervise local militia training.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was ordered to supervise home-province militia.

sentences.zh: 調福珠洪阿為江南提督。

translations.literal: Fuzhuhonga was transferred to Jiangnan Brigade Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhuhonga was transferred to Jiangnan brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，敕各省紳士在籍辦理團練。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingchou: an edict ordered gentry in their home provinces to organize militia.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, dingchou, gentry were ordered to organize home-province militia.

sentences.zh: 命四品京堂勝保從軍河南。

translations.literal: Fourth-rank capital official Shengbao was ordered to join the army in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Shengbao was ordered to join the Henan army.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賊陷武昌，巡撫常大淳死之。

translations.literal: On day guisi, bandits took Wuchang; Governor Chang Dachun died there.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, bandits took Wuchang and Governor Chang Dachun died.

sentences.zh: 上切責督軍大臣不籌全局，擁兵自衛，逮徐廣縉治罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor sharply rebuked military supervisors for not planning the whole field and hoarding troops for self-defense; Xu Guangjin was arrested for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked commanders for narrow planning and hoarding troops; Xu Guangjin was arrested.

sentences.zh: 以向榮為欽差大臣，督辦軍務，張亮基署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Xiang Rong was made Imperial Commissioner to supervise military affairs; Zhang Liangji acted as Huguang Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Rong became Imperial Commissioner and Zhang Liangji acted as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以葉名琛為兩廣總督，柏貴為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Ye Mingchen was made Liangguang Governor-General and Bai Gui was made Guangdong Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Mingchen became Liangguang governor-general and Bai Gui Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，向榮奏賊連陷武、漢，搭有浮橋，必須多備砲船，將橋焚毀，方可進剿。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Xiang Rong reported that bandits had taken Wuhan in succession, built a pontoon bridge, and that many gunboats must be prepared to burn the bridge before advance pursuit could proceed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Xiang Rong said bandits held Wuhan with a pontoon bridge and gunboats were needed to burn it before pursuit.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「刑部郎中盧應翔所帶砲船，曾在長沙擊賊，即迅赴軍前。

translations.literal: By imperial rescript: "The gunboats brought by Punishments Bureau Director Lu Yingxiang fought bandits at Changsha—send them swiftly to the front."
translations.idiomatic: Rescript: "Send Lu Yingxiang's gunboats, which fought at Changsha, swiftly to the front."

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，吉林、黑龍江徵兵到京。

translations.literal: " On day jiachen, conscripts from Jilin and Heilongjiang reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiachen, Jilin and Heilongjiang conscripts reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「每起間二日起行，帶兵官嚴守紀律，不得多索車輛，騷擾驛站。

translations.literal: By imperial rescript: "Each batch is to start two days apart; commanders must keep discipline and must not demand extra carts or harass relay posts."
translations.idiomatic: Rescript: "Each batch starts two days apart; commanders must keep discipline and not harass relay posts."

sentences.zh: 」祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: Joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Joint seasonal sacrifice was held at the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸四十二州縣、山西一府災賦，浙江四十八州縣緩徵銀米各有差。

translations.literal: That year, disaster taxes were remitted for forty-two Zhili districts and one Shanxi prefecture; Zhejiang's forty-eight districts had silver and grain collection deferred by degree.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster taxes were remitted in forty-two Zhili districts and one Shanxi prefecture; forty-eight Zhejiang districts had collection deferred.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Siam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年癸丑春正月丁未，調青州副都統常青兵移防豫、楚。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day dingwei: Qingzhou Vice Commander Changqing's troops were shifted to guard Henan and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, month 1, dingwei, Changqing's Qingzhou troops shifted to Henan and Huguang.
