sentences.zh: 戊申，張亮基奏，賊目蕭朝貴實在長沙城外轟斃，起獲屍身，驗明梟剉。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Zhang Liangji reported that bandit chief Xiao Chaogui had truly been blasted dead outside Changsha; the corpse was recovered, verified, and exposed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhang Liangji reported Xiao Chaogui was blasted dead outside Changsha; the corpse was verified and exposed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，蔣文慶奏城薄兵單，移調東西梁山兵勇來城防禦。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Jiang Wenqing reported thin walls and few troops; militia from east and west Liangshan were moved to defend the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Jiang Wenqing said walls were thin and troops few; Liangshan militia were moved to the city.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，向榮奏，武昌踞賊抬砲上船，意欲逃竄。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Xiang Rong reported that the entrenched bandits at Wuchang were loading cannon onto boats, intending to flee.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Xiang Rong said Wuchang bandits were loading cannon on boats to flee.

sentences.zh: 陸應穀奏，偵得賊匪開年有東竄安慶、江寧之信。

translations.literal: Lu Yinggu reported that intelligence showed the rebels planned at the new year to drive east toward Anqing and Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yinggu reported rebel plans to strike east at Anqing and Jiangning in the new year.

sentences.zh: 敕向榮多方偵備，迎擊兜剿。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xiang Rong to spy on many fronts, meet attacks, and round up suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Rong was ordered to scout widely, intercept, and suppress.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，敕步軍統領、前鋒統領整備軍實，盤詰姦宄。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Foot and Vanguard commanders-in-chief were ordered to ready forces and root out traitors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Foot and Vanguard commanders were told to ready troops and hunt traitors.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賊陷九江，陸建瀛退守江寧。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, rebels took Jiujiang; Lu Jianying fell back to defend Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, rebels took Jiujiang and Lu Jianying withdrew to Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 賽尚阿論斬，革其子崇綺等官職。

translations.literal: Saishanga was sentenced to decapitation; his son Chongqi and others were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Saishanga was condemned to death and Chongqi and others lost office.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命工部左侍郎呂賢基回安徽辦防，加周天爵侍郎銜，會辦防務。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Vice Minister of Works Lü Xianji was sent back to Anhui to organize defense; Zhou Tianjue was given vice-minister rank to assist in defense.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Lü Xianji returned to Anhui for defense and Zhou Tianjue joined with vice-minister rank.

sentences.zh: 壬申，陸建瀛褫職逮問，以祥厚為欽差大臣。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Lu Jianying was stripped of office and arrested; Xianghou was made Imperial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Lu Jianying was dismissed and arrested and Xianghou became Imperial Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以山西、陝西、四川三省紳民捐輸軍饟，加鄉試中額、生員學額。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, because gentry in Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Sichuan donated army funds, added quotas were granted for the provincial examination and student places.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Sichuan donors won added exam and student quotas.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賊陷安慶，蔣文慶死之，命周天爵署安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, rebels took Anqing; Jiang Wenqing died; Zhou Tianjue was ordered to act as Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, rebels took Anqing, Jiang Wenqing died, and Zhou Tianjue acted as Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 予江西陣亡總兵恩長世職。

translations.literal: Hereditary office was granted to Jiangxi fallen Regional Commander Enchang.
translations.idiomatic: Fallen Jiangxi commander Enchang received a hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子朔，詔：「京師八旗營兵十五萬之多，該管大臣勤加訓練。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingzi (new moon), an edict: "The capital's Eight Banner garrison exceeds 150,000; supervising ministers must train them diligently.
translations.idiomatic: Month 2, bingzi new moon: "Over 150,000 capital banner troops must be drilled by their commanders.

sentences.zh: 」贈恤湖北殉難學政馮培元加侍郎，諡文介，布政使梁星源諡敏肅，按察使瑞元諡端節，及知府以下官各予世職、建專祠，提督雙福、總兵官王錦繡附常大淳祠。

translations.literal: " Posthumous honors were granted to Hubei martyrs: Educational Intendant Feng Peiyuan was promoted to vice minister with posthumous name Wenjie; Provincial Administration Commissioner Liang Xingyuan posthumous Minsu; Surveillance Commissioner Ruiyuan posthumous Duanjie; prefects and below received hereditary posts and dedicated shrines; Regional Commander Shuangfu and Commander Wang Jinxiu were enshrined with Chang Dachun.
translations.idiomatic: " Hubei martyrs were honored: Feng Peiyuan as Wenjie, Liang Xingyuan as Minsu, Ruiyuan as Duanjie; lower officials won hereditary posts and shrines; Shuangfu and Wang Jinxiu joined Chang Dachun's shrine.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，釋奠先師孔子。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the sacrifice was offered to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Confucius was honored at the temple sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 遣少卿雷以諴、侍講學士晉康往南河，少詹事王履謙赴東河，會辦防務。

translations.literal: Junior Vice President Lei Yiqian and Reader Jin Kang were sent to the Southern River; Junior Mentor Wang Lüqian to the Eastern River, all to assist in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Lei Yiqian and Jin Kang went to the Southern River and Wang Lüqian to the Eastern River to organize defense.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上臨雍講學，加衍聖公孔繁灝太子太保。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Emperor lectured at the Imperial Academy and the Duke of Yansheng Kong Fanhao was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Emperor lectured at the Academy and Kong Fanhao became Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敕文臣三品以上養廉以四成、武臣二品以上以二成充軍饟。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, civil officials of third rank and above were ordered to give forty percent of their integrity stipends and military officials of second rank and above twenty percent for army funds.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, civil officials gave forty percent and military officials twenty percent of integrity stipends for the army.

sentences.zh: 戶部請辦商捐、戶輸，上不許。

translations.literal: The Board of Revenue proposed merchant donations and household levies; the Emperor did not permit them.
translations.idiomatic: The Revenue Board proposed merchant and household levies; the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賊陷江寧，將軍祥厚、提督福珠洪阿等死之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, rebels took Jiangning; General Xianghou, Regional Commander Fuzhu Hong'a, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, rebels took Jiangning; Xianghou, Fuzhu Hong'a, and others died.

sentences.zh: 以怡良為兩江總督，命慧成馳赴江南防剿。

translations.literal: Yiliang was made governor-general of the Two Jiangs; Huicheng was ordered to hurry south to defend and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: Yiliang became Two Jiangs governor-general and Huicheng was sent south to fight.

sentences.zh: 調托明阿為江寧將軍，文斌為綏遠城將軍，瑞昌為杭州將軍，鄧紹良為江南提督。

translations.literal: Tuoming'a was transferred to Jiangning general; Wenbin to Suiyuan general; Ruichang to Hangzhou general; Deng Shaoliang to Jiangnan regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoming'a took Jiangning, Wenbin Suiyuan, Ruichang Hangzhou, and Deng Shaoliang Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命琦善會防淮揚。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Qishan was ordered to join defense on the Huai and Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Qishan was sent to defend the Huai-Yangzi line.

sentences.zh: 敕湖北行鹽暫用川鹽二千引。

translations.literal: An edict allowed Hubei temporarily to use two thousand piculs of Sichuan salt.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei was allowed two thousand piculs of Sichuan salt for the time being.

sentences.zh: 敕李僡查拿山東兗、沂、曹三府捻匪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Yun to hunt down Nian bandits in Shandong's Yan, Yi, and Cao prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yun was ordered to suppress Nian bandits in Yan, Yi, and Cao.

sentences.zh: 命內閣學士勝保幫辦江北防務。

translations.literal: Cabinet Academician Sheng Bao was ordered to assist in northern Jiang defense.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao was ordered to help organize northern Jiang defense.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，賊陷鎮江、揚州。

translations.literal: Third month, day yisi, rebels took Zhenjiang and Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, yisi, rebels took Zhenjiang and Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，孝和睿皇后升祔太廟。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Empress Xiaohuirui was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Empress Xiaohuirui entered the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上耕耤田。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Emperor performed the plowing rite.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命湖北按察使江忠源幫辦江南軍務。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Hubei Surveillance Commissioner Jiang Zhongyuan was ordered to assist in Jiangnan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Jiang Zhongyuan was ordered to help in Jiangnan operations.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，敕侍郎奕經統密雲兵赴山東會防。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Vice Minister Yijing was ordered to lead Miyun troops to Shandong for joint defense.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Yijing led Miyun troops to Shandong for joint defense.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，敕各省團練格殺土匪勿論。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, an edict: in every province militia might kill bandits on the spot without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, provinces were told militia could kill bandits without trial.

sentences.zh: 以駱秉章復為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Luo Bingzhang was restored as Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Bingzhang returned as Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 敕江寧布政使陳啟邁在徐州設立糧台。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jiangning Provincial Administration Commissioner Chen Qimai to set up a grain depot at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Qimai was told to establish a grain depot at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，向榮擊賊於江寧，敗之。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Xiang Rong attacked rebels at Jiangning and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Xiang Rong beat rebels at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 以施得高為福建水師提督。

translations.literal: Shi Degao was made Fujian naval regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Degao became Fujian naval regional commander.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以廬州為安徽省會。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Luzhou was made capital of Anhui Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Luzhou became the Anhui provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 周天爵剿賊妥速，琦善進攻連獲勝仗，均嘉賚之。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianjue's suppression was prompt and Qishan's attacks won repeated victories; both were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tianjue and Qishan were praised for swift suppression and victories.

sentences.zh: 敕直隸、奉天備防海口。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhili and Fengtian to prepare defense at sea mouths.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili and Fengtian were ordered to guard the sea approaches.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，向榮奏迭勝城賊，進據鍾山。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Xiang Rong reported successive victories over city rebels and advance to Bell Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Xiang Rong reported victories and occupation of Bell Mountain.

sentences.zh: 上優獎之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised him highly.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor gave him high praise.

sentences.zh: 命奕經、托明阿赴清江防剿。

translations.literal: Yijing and Tuoming'a were ordered to Qingjiang for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing and Tuoming'a were sent to Qingjiang to fight.

sentences.zh: 命瑞昌統盛京兵赴淮、徐會防，恩華統吉林兵駐防直隸。

translations.literal: Ruichang was ordered to lead Mukden troops to Huai and Xu for joint defense; Enhua to lead Jilin troops garrisoning Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Ruichang took Mukden troops to Huai-Xu and Enhua garrisoned Zhili with Jilin troops.

sentences.zh: 辛未，敕廣東招募紅單船，遴將帶赴江南剿賊。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, an edict ordered Guangdong to recruit red-banner ships and select officers to take them south against rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Guangdong was told to recruit red-banner ships for Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 以福濟為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Fu Ji was made grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ji became grain transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，日見黑暈。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: the sun showed a black halo.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, gengchen, a black halo appeared around the sun.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賊陷浦口、滁州。

translations.literal: On day jichou, rebels took Pukou and Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, rebels took Pukou and Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命琦善統制江北諸軍。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Qishan was ordered to command all armies north of the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Qishan took overall command north of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 逮治楊文定。

translations.literal: Yang Wending was arrested and tried.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wending was arrested.

sentences.zh: 庫倫喀爾喀蒙古哲布尊丹巴喇嘛進馬三千匹，及西林盟長進馬，均溫諭止之。

translations.literal: The Jebtsundamba Lama of Khalkha Mongolia at Urga presented three thousand horses, and a league chief of Xilin presented horses; warm edicts declined both.
translations.idiomatic: Urga's Jebtsundamba and a Xilin chief offered horses; both gifts were declined.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賜孫如僅等二百二十二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Sun Rujin and 221 others were granted jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Sun Rujin and 221 others received jinshi ranks.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賊陷鳳陽。

translations.literal: On day guimao, rebels took Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, rebels took Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 安徽捻匪竄擾蒙城。

translations.literal: Anhui Nian bandits raided Mengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Nian bandits raided Mengcheng in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，始制銀鈔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wushen: silver banknotes were first issued.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, wushen, silver notes were first issued.

sentences.zh: 壬子，王懿德奏海澄會匪陷同安、安谿、廈門，嚴飭之。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Wang Yide reported that Haicheng secret-society rebels had taken Tong'an, Anxi, and Xiamen; they were sternly ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wang Yide reported Haicheng rebels had taken Tong'an, Anxi, and Xiamen and was ordered to act.

sentences.zh: 周天爵奏收復鳳陽。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianjue reported recovery of Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tianjue reported Fengyang recovered.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，李嘉端奏金陵賊船上竄。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Li Jiaduan reported rebel boats on the Jinling river driving upstream.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Li Jiaduan reported Jinling rebel boats moving upstream.

sentences.zh: 得旨，此與向榮疏報不同，令確切查探。

translations.literal: Receiving the rescript: this differed from Xiang Rong's memorial; they were ordered to investigate exactly.
translations.idiomatic: The throne noted a conflict with Xiang Rong's report and ordered a thorough inquiry.

sentences.zh: 駱秉章奏，江西上猶縣匪首劉洪義聚眾在桂東滋擾，毗連廣東、湖南。

translations.literal: Luo Bingzhang reported that bandit chief Liu Hongyi of Shangyou County, Jiangxi, had gathered a crowd and was harassing Guizhou, adjoining Guangdong and Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Bingzhang reported Liu Hongyi of Jiangxi Shangyou raiding toward Guangdong and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 得旨，三省會剿。

translations.literal: Receiving the rescript: the three provinces were to suppress jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The three provinces were ordered to suppress together.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，陸應穀奏亳州失守，賊撲汴梁。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Lu Yinggu reported Bozhou lost and rebels pressing on Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Lu Yinggu reported Bozhou fallen and rebels nearing Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 敕江忠源馳赴河南剿賊。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jiang Zhongyuan to hurry to Henan to suppress rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhongyuan was ordered to rush to Henan against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 王懿德奏漳州鎮、道被賊戕害，永安、沙縣先後失守。

translations.literal: Wang Yide reported that the Zhenzhou commander and intendant had been killed by rebels and Yong'an and Shaxian had fallen in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yide reported Zhenzhou officials killed and Yong'an and Shaxian lost.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命勝保統兵馳赴河南。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Sheng Bao was ordered to lead troops urgently to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Sheng Bao was rushed to Henan with troops.

sentences.zh: 戊午，釋賽尚阿、徐廣縉於獄，從軍自效，楊殿邦、但明倫均留清江浦辦防。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Saishanga and Xu Guangjin were released from prison to redeem themselves in the army; Yang Dianbang and Dan Minglun remained at Qingjiangpu for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Saishanga and Xu Guangjin were freed to serve; Yang Dianbang and Dan Minglun stayed at Qingjiangpu.

sentences.zh: 周天爵奏鳳陽逸匪竄擾而西，即日赴援。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianjue reported escaped Fengyang bandits raiding westward and that he set out the same day to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tianjue reported Fengyang fugitives raiding west and went to relieve at once.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「周天爵素稱勇敢，所保臧紆青練勇可當一面，獨不能與賊決一死戰耶？

translations.literal: Receiving the rescript: "Zhou Tianjue is known as brave and recommended Zang Shuying's trained militia as fit to hold a front alone—can he alone not fight the rebels to the death?
translations.idiomatic: The throne asked whether the brave Zhou Tianjue, who praised Zang Shuying's militia, would not fight to the death.

sentences.zh: 」陸應穀、恩華奏竄賊由曹河搶渡，犯及山東。

translations.literal: " Lu Yinggu and Enhua reported raiding rebels had forced a crossing on the Cao River and invaded Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yinggu and Enhua reported rebels had crossed the Cao River into Shandong.

sentences.zh: 得旨，調陝西兵應援，仍令固守潼關門戶。

translations.literal: Receiving the rescript, Shaanxi troops were shifted to aid while still holding the Tong Pass gateway firm.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi troops were sent to help but told to keep Tong Pass secure.

sentences.zh: 賊陷歸德。

translations.literal: Rebels took Guide.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels took Guide.

sentences.zh: 己未，賊復陷安慶。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, rebels again took Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, rebels retook Anqing.

sentences.zh: 詔江忠源防守九江。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jiang Zhongyuan to defend Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhongyuan was ordered to hold Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 徵蒙古兵及其所進馬五千匹集於熱河。

translations.literal: Mongol troops and the five thousand horses they presented were summoned to assemble at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol troops and five thousand tribute horses were gathered at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔以賊匪北竄，勸諭北地紳民練團自衛，如能殺賊出力，並與論功。

translations.literal: On day renxu, an edict: as rebels drove north, northern gentry and people were urged to train militia for self-defense; those who killed rebels with merit would be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, northern communities were urged to train militia and win merit for killing rebels.

sentences.zh: 命僧格林沁、花紗納、達洪阿、穆廕督辦京城巡防。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen, Huashana, Dahonga, and Muyin were ordered to supervise capital patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen, Huashana, Dahonga, and Muyin took charge of Beijing patrols.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以許乃普為刑部尚書，翁心存為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Xu Naipu was made Minister of Punishments and Weng Xincun Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Xu Naipu took Punishments and Weng Xincun Works.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以河南兵民固守省城，優詔嘉勉。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, because Henan soldiers and people had held the provincial city firm, an edict of warm praise was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Henan's defense of the provincial city was warmly praised.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命訥爾經額防守河北。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Ne'erjing'e was ordered to defend north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Ne'erjing'e was sent to defend the north bank.

sentences.zh: 桂良赴保定辦理防守。

translations.literal: Gui Liang went to Baoding to organize defense.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang went to Baoding for defense.

sentences.zh: 己巳，開封解嚴，賊南竄中牟、硃仙鎮，敕托明阿等追之。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Kaifeng's alarm was lifted; rebels drove south through Zhongmou and Zhuxian Town; Tuoming'a and others were ordered to pursue.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Kaifeng was relieved; rebels fled south and Tuoming'a was told to pursue.

sentences.zh: 辛未，始鑄當十大錢。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, ten-cash coins were first cast.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, ten-cash coins were first minted.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，福建紳商克復漳州，優詔嘉之，查明給獎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: Fujian gentry and merchants recovered Zhangzhou; an edict of warm praise ordered investigation and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, yihai, Fujian gentry recovered Zhangzhou and were told to be rewarded after inquiry.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，河南賊犯汜水，分股渡河陷溫縣。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Henan rebels attacked Sishui and a detachment crossed the river and took Wen County.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Henan rebels hit Sishui and a column took Wen County.

sentences.zh: 托明阿擊之，復汜水。

translations.literal: Tuoming'a attacked them and recovered Sishui.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoming'a beat them and retook Sishui.

sentences.zh: 己卯，金陵賊船上陷南康，進圍南昌。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Jinling rebel boats downstream took Nankang and pressed on Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Jinling rebel boats took Nankang and besieged Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，溫縣紳勇敗賊，復其城，復會官軍敗賊於武陟。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Wen County gentry and militia defeated rebels and recovered the city; together with government troops they defeated rebels at Wuzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Wen gentry recovered their city and with the army beat rebels at Wuzhi.

sentences.zh: 命納爾經額為欽差大臣，督辦河南、河北軍務，恩華、托明阿副之。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e was made Imperial Commissioner to supervise military affairs in Henan and Hebei, with Enhua and Tuoming'a as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e became Imperial Commissioner for Henan and Hebei; Enhua and Tuoming'a assisted.

sentences.zh: 黃河再決豐北。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst again north of Feng.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River broke again north of Feng.

sentences.zh: 甲申，雲南東川回匪作亂。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Hui rebels rose in Dongchuan, Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Dongchuan Hui rebels rose in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 福建台灣土匪作亂。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Taiwan, Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian Taiwan bandits rose.

sentences.zh: 戊子，美國使人求入覲，詔止之。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, an American envoy asked to be received in audience; an edict forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, an American audience was requested and refused.

sentences.zh: 河南賊圍懷慶。

translations.literal: Henan rebels besieged Huaiqing.
translations.idiomatic: Henan rebels besieged Huaiqing.

sentences.zh: 官軍解許州圍，賊走羅山。

translations.literal: Government troops relieved the siege of Xuzhou; rebels fled to Luoshan.
translations.idiomatic: The army relieved Xuzhou and rebels fled to Luoshan.

sentences.zh: 福建官軍收復永安、沙縣。

translations.literal: Fujian government troops recovered Yong'an and Shaxian.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian troops recovered Yong'an and Shaxian.

sentences.zh: 托明阿等敗賊於懷慶。

translations.literal: Tuoming'a and others defeated rebels at Huaiqing.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoming'a and others beat rebels at Huaiqing.

sentences.zh: 乙未，鎮江官軍失利，奪提督鄧紹良職，以和春署江南提督。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, government troops were defeated at Zhenjiang; Regional Commander Deng Shaoliang was stripped of office and Hechun acted as Jiangnan regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Zhenjiang troops were beaten; Deng Shaoliang was dismissed and Hechun acted in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，優恤揚州攻城傷亡總兵雙來世職銀兩。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, generous relief was granted in silver and hereditary office to fallen Regional Commander Shuang Lai of the Yangzhou assault.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Shuang Lai of Yangzhou received posthumous silver and a hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 廣西全州土匪作亂。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Quanzhou, Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi Quanzhou bandits rose.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰朔，廣西土匪陷興安、靈川，分撲桂林，官軍敗之，復靈川、興安。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiachen (new moon): Guangxi bandits took Xing'an and Lingchuan and divided to strike Guilin; government troops defeated them and recovered Lingchuan and Xing'an.
translations.idiomatic: Month 7, jiachen new moon: Guangxi bandits took Xing'an and Lingchuan; troops beat them back.

sentences.zh: 丙午，敕慧成回清江浦防剿。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Huicheng was ordered back to Qingjiangpu for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Huicheng returned to Qingjiangpu to fight.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命勝保幫辦河南軍務。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Sheng Bao was ordered to assist in Henan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Sheng Bao was ordered to help in Henan.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，敕東南河臣收撤渡船，防賊偷渡。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, southeastern river officials were ordered to withdraw ferry boats to prevent rebel crossings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, southeast river officials were told to pull ferries to block rebel crossings.

sentences.zh: 恤江西陣亡總兵馬濟美世職。

translations.literal: Posthumous hereditary office was granted to Ma Jimei, regional commander killed in battle in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Jimei, the Jiangxi commander killed in action, received a posthumous hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔江西、湖廣新漕折價解京。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, an edict ordered that new grain tribute from Jiangxi and Huguang be converted to cash for delivery to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Jiangxi and Huguang new tribute grain was ordered cashed in for Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賊竄湖北、安徽。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, rebels fled into Hubei and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the rebels slipped into Hubei and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 敕怡良於上海設關收稅。

translations.literal: Yi Liang was ordered to establish a customs office at Shanghai to collect taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Liang was told to open a Shanghai customs house for tax collection.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，恤提督福珠洪阿世職。

translations.literal: On day guihai, hereditary office was granted to Grand Coordinator Fuzhu Hong'e.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Fuzhu Hong'e received a posthumous hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔紳士辦團御賊捐軀者，一體恩恤。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, an edict granted the same gracious posthumous benefits to gentry who organized militia against rebels and died in service.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, militia leaders who died fighting rebels were promised equal posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，福建官軍復尤谿。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Fujian government troops recovered Youxi.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Fujian forces retook Youxi.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，官軍解懷慶圍，賊竄山西。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingzi: government troops lifted the Huaiqing siege, and rebels fled into Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, bingzi, Huaiqing was relieved and the rebels fled to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，調吳文鎔為湖廣總督，裕瑞為四川總督，樂斌為成都將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Wu Wenrong was made Huguang governor-general, Yusui Sichuan governor-general, and Yuebin Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wu Wenrong took Huguang, Yusui Sichuan, and Yuebin Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賊陷垣曲。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, rebels took Yuanqu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Yuanqu fell to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 癸未，李僡卒，以張亮基為山東巡撫，駱秉章授湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guimwei, Li Han died; Zhang Liangji was made Shandong governor, and Luo Bingzhang was appointed Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guimwei, Li Han died; Zhang Liangji became Shandong governor and Luo Bingzhang Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 甲申，江西賊陷饒州郡城，吉安土匪遙應之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Jiangxi rebels took Raozhou prefectural city, and Ji'an local bandits responded from afar.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Raozhou fell in Jiangxi as Ji'an bandits rose in support.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賊陷絳縣、曲沃，進圍平陽。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, rebels took Jiangxian and Quwo and advanced to besiege Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Jiangxian and Quwo fell and Pingyang was besieged.

sentences.zh: 哈芬免，以恆春為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Hafen was dismissed, and Hengchun was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Hafen was removed and Hengchun made Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賊陷平陽，勝保兵至，敗之，復平陽。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, rebels took Pingyang; Sheng Bao's troops arrived, defeated them, and recovered Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Pingyang fell but Sheng Bao retook it after defeating the rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊由洪洞東竄。

translations.literal: Rebels fled east through Hongtong.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled east via Hongtong.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命勝保為欽差大臣，賜神雀刀，恩華、托明阿副之。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Sheng Bao was made Imperial Commissioner and given the Divine Sparrow Knife; Enghua and Tuoming'a assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Sheng Bao became Imperial Commissioner with the Divine Sparrow Knife, assisted by Enghua and Tuoming'a.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，托明阿敗賊於陳留。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Tuoming'a defeated rebels at Chenliu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Tuoming'a beat the rebels at Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯朔，再敗之潞城、黎城，賊竄直隸，入臨洺關。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day guimao: they were defeated again at Lucheng and Licheng; rebels fled into Zhili and entered Linming Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon in month 9, Lucheng and Licheng were retaken; the rebels fled into Zhili through Linming Pass.

sentences.zh: 奪訥爾經額職逮問，以桂良為直隸總督。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e was stripped of office and arrested for inquiry; Gui Liang was made Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e was dismissed and arrested; Gui Liang became Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賊陷柏鄉。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, rebels took Baixiang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Baixiang fell.

sentences.zh: 江西南昌圍解，賊復竄踞安慶。

translations.literal: The siege of Nanchang in Jiangxi was lifted, but rebels again occupied Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: Nanchang was relieved, yet the rebels reoccupied Anqing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，調魁麟為禮部尚書，花沙納為工部尚書，以勝保為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Kuilin was made Minister of Rites, Huashana Minister of Works, and Sheng Bao Han Banner commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Kuilin took Rites, Huashana Works, and Sheng Bao the Han Banner command.

sentences.zh: 江蘇土匪陷青浦、寶山，官軍復之。

translations.literal: Jiangsu local bandits took Qingpu and Baoshan; government troops recovered them.
translations.idiomatic: Qingpu and Baoshan fell to Jiangsu bandits but were retaken.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命截留漕糧備山東災賑。

translations.literal: On day wushen, grain transport was ordered detained for Shandong disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, transport grain was held back for Shandong famine relief.

sentences.zh: 以軍務方急，緩修豐北河工。

translations.literal: Because military affairs were urgent, work on the Fengbei River project was deferred.
translations.idiomatic: Fengbei River works were postponed amid urgent campaigning.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命惠親王為奉命大將軍，賜銳捷刀，科爾沁郡王僧格林沁為參贊大臣，賜訥庫尼素刀，恭親王奕訢、定郡王載銓、內大臣壁昌會辦巡防。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Prince Hui was made Commander-in-Chief on Imperial Orders and given the Ruijie Knife; Kobdo Prince Sengge Rinchen was made staff commissioner and given the Nekuni Knife; Prince Gong Yixin, Prince Ding Zaiquan, and inner court minister Bichang were ordered to assist in patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Prince Hui became commander-in-chief with the Ruijie Knife, Sengge Rinchen staff commissioner with the Nekuni Knife, and Yixin, Zaiquan, and Bichang joined patrol defense.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賊由趙卅，城陷深卅。

translations.literal: On day yimao, rebels passed Zhao Prefecture and took Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the rebels swept through Zhao and seized Shen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 命於河間、涿卅、通州設防。

translations.literal: Troops were ordered posted at Hejian, Zhuo Prefecture, and Tongzhou for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Defenses were set at Hejian, Zhuo Prefecture, and Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，李嘉端罷，以江忠源為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Li Jiaduan was dismissed, and Jiang Zhongyuan was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Li Jiaduan was removed and Jiang Zhongyuan made Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，僧格林沁復深州。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Sengge Rinchen recovered Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Sengge Rinchen retook Shen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，陸應穀罷，以英桂為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Lu Yinggu was dismissed, and Ying Gui was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Lu Yinggu was replaced by Ying Gui as Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 己巳，周天爵卒于軍。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Zhou Tianjue died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Zhou Tianjue died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賊陷獻縣、交河、滄州，進撲天津，知縣謝子澄督帶練勇迎擊，死之，所部敗賊三十里。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, rebels took Xian county, Jiaohe, and Cangzhou and pressed on Tianjin; Magistrate Xie Zicheng led militia in a counterattack and died, yet his force routed the rebels thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Xian, Jiaohe, and Cangzhou fell and Tianjin was threatened; Xie Zicheng died leading militia but drove the rebels back thirty li.

sentences.zh: 特贈謝子澄布政使，並建祠，優獎練勇。

translations.literal: Xie Zicheng was specially posthumously made provincial administrator and given a shrine; the militia were generously rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Zicheng was posthumously made provincial administrator with a shrine, and his militia were richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 警聞，京師戒嚴，僧格林沁駐軍於武清。

translations.literal: Alarmed, the capital went on alert; Sengge Rinchen encamped at Wuqing.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing went on alert; Sengge Rinchen camped at Wuqing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，命曾國籓督帶練勇赴湖北剿賊。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiaxu: Zeng Guofan was ordered to lead militia to Hubei to suppress rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, jiaxu, Zeng Guofan was sent to Hubei with militia against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賊陷黃州，漢黃德道徐豐玉死之，連陷漢陽，進圍武昌。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, rebels took Huangzhou; Han-Huang-De Circuit Intendant Xu Fengyu died, and they then took Hanyang and besieged Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Huangzhou fell and Xu Fengyu was killed; Hanyang followed and Wuchang was besieged.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賊踞獨流鎮，勝保督軍至，連擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, rebels held Duliuzhen; Sheng Bao arrived in command and repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the rebels held Duliuzhen until Sheng Bao arrived and beat them repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命恭親王奕訢在軍機處行走，解麟魁軍機大臣，以瑞麟、穆廕為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Prince Gong Yixin was ordered to serve on the Grand Council; Lin Kui was removed as Grand Councilor, and Ruilin and Muyin were made Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Yixin joined the Grand Council; Lin Kui left it and Ruilin and Muyin entered.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，加給事中袁甲三三品卿銜，剿辦安徽捻匪。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Censor Yuan Jiasan was given third-rank counselor rank to suppress Anhui Nian bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Yuan Jiasan received third-rank rank to fight Anhui Nian rebels.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，武昌解嚴，江忠源赴皖。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Wuchang alarm was lifted, and Jiang Zhongyuan went to Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Wuchang stood down and Jiang Zhongyuan marched to Anhui.

sentences.zh: 命署臬司唐樹義江面剿賊。

translations.literal: Acting provincial judge Tang Shuyi was ordered to suppress rebels on the river.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shuyi, acting judge, was assigned river operations against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賊陷桐城。

translations.literal: On day guisi, rebels took Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Tongcheng fell.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，豫征山西、陝西、四川三省糧賦，尋止之。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, grain levies were ordered from Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Sichuan for Henan, but the order was soon withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, three provinces were told to send grain to Henan, then the levy was canceled.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅朔，以王慶雲為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day renyin: Wang Qingyun was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon in month 11, Wang Qingyun became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，福建官軍克復廈門。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Fujian government troops recovered Xiamen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Fujian forces retook Xiamen.

sentences.zh: 安徽賊陷舒城，辦團大臣侍郎呂賢基死之。

translations.literal: Anhui rebels took Shucheng, and militia organizer and Vice Minister Lv Xianji died.
translations.idiomatic: Shucheng fell in Anhui and Lv Xianji, the militia organizer, was killed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賊陷儀徵。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, rebels took Yizheng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Yizheng fell.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命侍郎曾國籓督帶水師剿賊安徽。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Vice Minister Zeng Guofan was ordered to lead a river force to suppress rebels in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zeng Guofan was told to take a river flotilla against Anhui rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，勝保剿賊獨流，不利，陣歿副都統佟鑒，贈將軍賜恤。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Sheng Bao attacked rebels at Duliuzhen without success; Vice Commander-in-Chief Tong Jian died in battle and was posthumously made general with funeral honors.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Sheng Bao failed at Duliuzhen; Tong Jian fell and was posthumously made general.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，揚州賊潰圍出，官軍復其城，琦善、慧成等均褫職從軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiaxu: Yangzhou rebels broke out of siege; government troops recovered the city, and Qi Shan, Huicheng, and others were stripped of office and sent to the army.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiaxu, Yangzhou rebels broke out but the city was retaken; Qi Shan and Huicheng lost office and joined the ranks.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔以黃州賊宗麕集，飭吳文鎔出省剿賊。

translations.literal: On day yihai, an edict, because Huangzhou rebels were massing, ordered Wu Wenrong to leave the province to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Wu Wenrong was ordered out of province as Huangzhou rebels gathered.

sentences.zh: 戊子，琦善復儀徵。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Qi Shan recovered Yizheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Qi Shan retook Yizheng.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賊陷廬州，江忠源死之。

translations.literal: On day jichou, rebels took Luzhou, and Jiang Zhongyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Luzhou fell and Jiang Zhongyuan was killed.

sentences.zh: 以福濟為安徽巡撫，邵燦為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Fu Ji was made Anhui governor, and Shao Can grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ji took Anhui and Shao Can the grain-transport post.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以侍郎杜翰為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Vice Minister Du Han was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Du Han joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 翁心存罷，以趙光為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Weng Xincun was dismissed, and Zhao Guang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Xincun left office and Zhao Guang became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 己亥，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day jihai, joint seasonal sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the court performed joint seasonal sacrifice at the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免奉天、直隸、山東、山西、浙江、湖北、湖南、廣西、雲南、甘肅等省三百四十四廳州縣衛災賦。

translations.literal: That year, disaster levies were remitted in 344 districts of Fengtian, Zhili, Shandong, Shanxi, Zhejiang, Hubei, Hunan, Guangxi, Yunnan, and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: That year, disaster taxes were waived in 344 districts across ten provinces.

sentences.zh: 又免甘肅中衛地震銀糧、草束各有差。

translations.literal: Gansu Zhongwei earthquake silver, grain, and fodder were also remitted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongwei earthquake dues in Gansu were also partly remitted.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球、暹羅、越南、緬甸、南掌入貢。

translations.literal: Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, Vietnam, Burma, and Lan Xang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute came from Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, Vietnam, Burma, and Lan Xang.

sentences.zh: 四年甲寅春正月辛丑朔，蒙古各盟長親王、郡王迭次報效軍需銀兩，溫旨嘉獎，均卻還之。

translations.literal: Fourth year, jiayin, spring, first month, new moon on day xinchou: Mongol league chiefs, princes, and commandery princes repeatedly offered military-supply silver, received warm commendation, and all gifts were declined.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 4, month 1, xinchou new moon, Mongol princes offered campaign silver, were praised, and all gifts were refused.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，撥內庫銀三十萬兩解赴勝保軍營。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, three hundred thousand taels from the inner treasury were sent to Sheng Bao's camp.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, 300,000 taels from the palace treasury went to Sheng Bao.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，官軍克獨流鎮，踞匪回竄。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, government troops took Duliuzhen and the entrenched bandits fled back.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Duliuzhen was recovered and the rebels withdrew.

sentences.zh: 壬子，張芾罷，以陳啟邁為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Zhang Fei was dismissed, and Chen Qimai was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Zhang Fei was removed and Chen Qimai made Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 王履謙疏陳河南吏治廢弛，軍需浮冒，河工糜費。

translations.literal: Wang Lvqian memorialized that Henan administration was lax, military supplies inflated, and river works wasteful.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lvqian reported lax Henan governance, inflated army costs, and wasted river funds.

sentences.zh: 下英桂查覆。

translations.literal: Ying Gui was ordered to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: The court told Ying Gui to investigate.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，浙江海運漕米改由劉河口放洋，命江蘇派員設局。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Zhejiang sea-transport tribute grain was ordered to sail from Liuhekou; Jiangsu officials were told to set up an office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Zhejiang tribute grain was rerouted from Liuhekou with a Jiangsu dispatch office.

sentences.zh: 己未，命福濟經理淮北鹽務。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Fu Ji was ordered to manage Huaibei salt affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Fu Ji was assigned Huaibei salt administration.

sentences.zh: 以王懿德為閩浙總督，呂佺孫為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Wang Yide was made Min-Zhe governor-general, and Lv Qiansun Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yide took Min-Zhe and Lv Qiansun Fujian.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，袁甲三疏請事關籌饟，由軍機處徑交所司，勿發內閣，從之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Yuan Jiasan memorialized that supply matters should go directly from the Grand Council to the responsible office without passing the Grand Secretariat; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Yuan Jiasan won direct Grand Council routing for supply papers, bypassing the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命廣東購辦夷砲運赴武昌。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Guangdong was ordered to purchase foreign cannon for transport to Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Guangdong was told to buy foreign guns for Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賊踞束城村，嚴詔僧格林沁、勝保迅速剿擒。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, rebels held Dongcheng village, and Sengge Rinchen and Sheng Bao were sternly ordered to capture them quickly.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, rebels held Dongcheng village and both generals were urged to crush them at once.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，湖北進攻黃州兵潰，總督吳文鎔，署按察使、前布政使唐樹義死之。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Hubei troops attacking Huangzhou were routed; Governor-General Wu Wenrong and Acting Provincial Judge and former Provincial Administrator Tang Shuyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, the Huangzhou assault collapsed; Wu Wenrong and Tang Shuyi were killed.

sentences.zh: 戶部議覆四川學政何紹基捐廉疏上違式用駢文，上責祁俊藻曰：「當閱何紹基疏時，卿亦議其迂拘，何為尤而效之？

translations.literal: The Board of Revenue replied that Sichuan educational commissioner He Shaoji's integrity-donation memorial violated form by using parallel prose; the Emperor rebuked Qi Junzao: "When you reviewed He Shaoji's memorial you also called it pedantic—why imitate it?
translations.idiomatic: Revenue boards faulted He Shaoji's donation memorial for parallel prose; the Emperor scolded Qi Junzao for copying what he had called pedantic.

sentences.zh: 大學士管部，乃不能動司官稿一字乎！

translations.literal: As a grand secretary heading a ministry, could you not change one word of an official draft!
translations.idiomatic: As ministry head, could a grand secretary not revise one clerkly line!

sentences.zh: 」賊竄獻縣東城庄，僧格林沁、勝保合軍擊之。

translations.literal: " Rebels fled to Dongchengzhuang east of Xian county; Sengge Rinchen and Sheng Bao joined forces to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's rebuke ended; rebels fled to Xian's Dongchengzhuang and the two generals struck together.

sentences.zh: 賊竄陷阜城，分股竄山東。

translations.literal: Rebels fled, took Fucheng, and split into bands that fled into Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: They took Fucheng and sent detachments into Shandong.

sentences.zh: 己巳，江蘇六合縣紳團力保危城，詔嘉之，免一年錢糧。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Liuhe county gentry and militia held a desperate city; an edict praised them and remitted one year's taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Liuhe's gentry-militia defense won praise and a one-year tax waiver.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, dingchou, the Emperor held the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 己卯，許乃普罷直南書房，降內閣學士。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Xu Naipu was removed from the Southern Study and demoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Xu Naipu left the Southern Study for a secretariat post.

sentences.zh: 以硃鳳標為刑部尚書，周祖培為左都御史。

translations.literal: Zhu Fengbiao was made Minister of Punishments, and Zhou Zupei Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Fengbiao took Punishments and Zhou Zupei the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 起翁心存為吏部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Weng Xincun was recalled as Left Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Xincun returned as Personnel vice minister.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以台涌為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Tai Yong was made Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Tai Yong became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬午，曾國籓奏統帶水陸師萬七千人，自衡州起程馳赴湖北。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Zeng Guofan reported commanding seventeen thousand land and river troops setting out from Hengzhou for Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zeng Guofan marched seventeen thousand troops from Hengzhou toward Hubei.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，奕興罷，以英隆為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Yixing was dismissed, and Yinglong was made Shengjing general.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Yixing was removed and Yinglong made Shengjing general.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓疏請前巡撫楊健之孫楊江捐銀二萬兩，准楊健入祀鄉賢祠。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan memorialized that former governor Yang Jian's grandson Yang Jiang donated twenty thousand taels and asked that Yang Jian be entered in the local worthies' shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan asked shrine honors for Yang Jian after his grandson Yang Jiang gave 20,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「楊健系休致之員，鄉賢鉅典，非可以捐納得之。

translations.literal: The rescript read: "Yang Jian was a retired official; the local worthies' great rite cannot be obtained by purchase.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied: "Yang Jian was retired; worthies' shrine honors are not for sale.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓不應遽為陳請，下部議處。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan should not have memorialized so hastily; refer the matter to the ministries for disciplinary action."
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan erred in asking; send the case for ministry discipline."

sentences.zh: 」軍興以來，饟空事棘，而帝於名器猶慎之如此。

translations.literal: Since the military uprising, funds had been empty and affairs critical, yet the Emperor was still this careful with honors.
translations.idiomatic: Amid empty coffers and urgent war, the Emperor still guarded honors so strictly.

sentences.zh: 予殉難安徽布政使劉裕珍世職，諡勤壯。

translations.literal: Hereditary office was granted to Liu Yuzhen, Anhui provincial administrator who died for the dynasty, with posthumous title Qinzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuzhen, the Anhui administrator killed in service, received hereditary office and the posthumous name Qinzhuang.

sentences.zh: 癸未，前協辦大學士湯金釗、兵部尚書特登額重宴鹿鳴，加宮銜，賜御書匾額。

translations.literal: On day guimwei, former Associate Grand Secretary Tang Jin'zhao and Minister of War Tedeng'e were again banqueted at the Deer-Ming feast, given higher court rank, and bestowed imperial calligraphy plaques.
translations.idiomatic: On guimwei, Tang Jin'zhao and Tedeng'e received a second Deer-Ming feast, higher rank, and imperial plaques.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，張亮基奏獲戕害大員之賊目王小涌，摘心遙祭。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Zhang Liangji reported capturing rebel chieftain Wang Xiaoyong, who had killed high officials, and offering his heart in distant sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhang Liangji captured Wang Xiaoyong, killer of senior officers, and sacrificed his heart.

sentences.zh: 得旨，即傳知佟鑒、謝子澄家屬告祭。

translations.literal: The rescript ordered that Tong Jian's and Xie Zicheng's families be informed for mourning sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The throne told Tong Jian's and Xie Zicheng's kin to perform mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 命托明阿幫辦僧格林沁軍務。

translations.literal: Tuoming'a was ordered to assist Sengge Rinchen in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoming'a was assigned to Sengge Rinchen's staff.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以青麟為湖北巡撫，崇綸丁憂，仍同守城。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Qinglin was made Hubei governor; Chonglun was in mourning but still helped defend the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Qinglin became Hubei governor while mourning Chonglun stayed to defend the walls.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，張亮基奏捻賊渡河由豐縣竄入單縣，官兵迎擊獲勝，復陷金鄉。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Zhang Liangji reported Nian bandits crossing the river from Feng county into Shan county; government troops met them in victory, but Jinxing again fell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Zhang Liangji beat Nian rebels entering Shan from Feng but Jinxing fell again.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子朔，張亮基奏賊陷鉅野、鄆城。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day gengzi: Zhang Liangji reported rebels had taken Juye and Yancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon in month 3, Juye and Yancheng fell, Zhang Liangji reported.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命載齡帶兵一千駐防河間，桂齡、台祿帶馬步兵千五百駐防德州。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Zai Ling was ordered to garrison Hejian with one thousand troops, and Gui Ling and Tailu to garrison Dezhou with fifteen hundred horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Zai Ling took 1,000 men to Hejian and Gui Ling and Tailu 1,500 to Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 駱秉章奏賊陷岳州，曾國籓回省防堵，留候補道胡林翼楚南剿賊。

translations.literal: Luo Bingzhang memorialized that bandits had taken Yuezhou; Zeng Guofan returned to the province to defend and block, leaving candidate circuit intendant Hu Linyi to suppress bandits in southern Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Bingzhang reported Yuezhou lost; Zeng Guofan went home to defend while Hu Linyi stayed to fight in southern Hunan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賊陷陽穀，知縣文穎蒞任五日，死之，優恤建祠。

translations.literal: On day renyin, bandits took Yanggu; magistrate Wen Ying, in office five days, died; he received preferential condolence and a shrine was built.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Yanggu fell; Wen Ying, magistrate for five days, was killed and honored with a shrine.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賊由陽穀、冠縣竄至清河之小灘，又分竄至臨清之李官莊。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, bandits fled from Yanggu and Guan county to Xiao Tan in Qinghe and also split off to Liguangzhuang in Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, rebels from Yanggu and Guan reached Qinghe's Xiao Tan and a detachment reached Linqing's Liguangzhuang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命勝保迎擊山東竄賊，布政使崇恩奏帶兵扼守臨清州。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Sengbao was ordered to meet and attack the fleeing bandits in Shandong; provincial administration commissioner Chong'en reported leading troops to hold Linqing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Sengbao was sent against Shandong raiders and Chong'en reported holding Linqing.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上耕耤田。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賊陷臨清。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, bandits took Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Linqing fell.

sentences.zh: 越十日，官軍復之，潰匪南竄，勝保追擊。

translations.literal: Ten days later government troops recovered it; the routed bandits fled south and Sengbao pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Ten days later the city was retaken; routed rebels fled south and Sengbao pursued.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓奏剿賊岳州失利，回守長沙。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan memorialized that the campaign at Yuezhou had failed and he had returned to hold Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan reported defeat at Yuezhou and withdrew to Changsha.

sentences.zh: 下部議處。

translations.literal: The matter was referred down for deliberation and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries were ordered to deliberate punishment.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，順承郡王春山薨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: Prince of Shuncheng Chunshan died.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, gengchen, Prince Chunshan of Shuncheng died.

sentences.zh: 阜城賊竄連鎮，僧格林沁追擊圍之。

translations.literal: Fucheng bandits fled to Lianzhen; Senggelinqin pursued and besieged them.
translations.idiomatic: Fucheng rebels fled to Lianzhen and Senggelinqin besieged them.

sentences.zh: 壬午，勝保奏馬隊追剿臨清潰匪，全數殄滅。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Sengbao memorialized that cavalry in pursuit had annihilated the Linqing routed bandits entirely.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Sengbao reported the Linqing fugitives were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎，加太子少保，德勒克色楞、善祿黃馬褂。

translations.literal: He received an edict of praise, was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Delekeseleng and Shanlu were given yellow jackets.
translations.idiomatic: He was praised, made Junior Guardian, and Delekeseleng and Shanlu received yellow jackets.

sentences.zh: 己丑，予告大學士潘世恩卒。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Grand Secretary Pan Shien on leave for mourning died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, retired Grand Secretary Pan Shien died.

sentences.zh: 內大臣壁昌卒。

translations.literal: Inner court minister Bi Chang died.
translations.idiomatic: Inner court minister Bi Chang died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鮑起豹罷，以塔齊布署湖南提督，曾國籓奪職剿賊。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Bao Qibao was dismissed; Taqibu was made acting Hunan provincial military commissioner and Zeng Guofan was stripped of office to campaign against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Bao Qibao was dismissed; Taqibu acted as Hunan commander and Zeng Guofan was demoted to fight rebels.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓克復湘潭，塔齊布、彭玉麟、楊載福剿賊大勝，靖港賊退。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan recovered Xiangtan; Taqibu, Peng Yulin, and Yang Zaifu won great victories suppressing bandits and Jinggang bandits withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan retook Xiangtan; Taqibu, Peng Yulin, and Yang Zaifu routed rebels and Jinggang rebels withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥朔，葛雲飛祠成，賜御書匾額。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day jihai: Ge Yunfei's shrine was completed and an imperial inscribed plaque was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, jihai new moon, Ge Yunfei's shrine was finished and the Emperor bestowed an inscribed plaque.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀國王表請出兵剿賊。

translations.literal: The king of Gorkha memorialized requesting to send troops to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The Gorkha king asked to send troops against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 溫詔止之。

translations.literal: A mild edict forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: A gentle edict refused the request.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，孫瑞珍免，以硃鳳標為戶部尚書，趙光為刑部尚書，彭蘊章為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Sun Ruizhen was dismissed; Zhu Fengbiao was made Minister of Revenue, Zhao Guang Minister of Justice, and Peng Yunzhang Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Sun Ruizhen was dismissed and Zhu Fengbiao, Zhao Guang, and Peng Yunzhang took the revenue, justice, and works ministries.

sentences.zh: 副都統綿洵追賊於豐縣，敗之，賜巴圖魯勇號。

translations.literal: Vice Commander-in-Chief Mianxun pursued bandits at Feng county, defeated them, and was given the Baturu brave title.
translations.idiomatic: Mianxun routed rebels at Feng county and received the Baturu title.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，連鎮賊首李開方竄陷高唐州，勝保督兵追之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Lianzhen bandit chief Li Kaifang fled and took Gaotang prefecture; Sengbao supervised troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Li Kaifang of Lianzhen seized Gaotang and Sengbao pursued.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上祈雨大高殿。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Hall of Great Heights.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Hall of Great Heights.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，祈雨天神壇。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, he prayed for rain at the Altar of the God of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, he prayed for rain at the Altar of the God of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 庚申，荊州將軍官文奏官軍收復監利縣、宜昌府城。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Jingzhou general Guan Wen memorialized that government troops had recovered Jianli county and Yichang prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Guan Wen reported Jianli county and Yichang city recovered.

sentences.zh: 敕塔齊布統軍赴湖北剿賊。

translations.literal: Taqibu was ordered to lead troops to Hubei to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Taqibu was ordered to Hubei to suppress rebels.

sentences.zh: 前湖北巡撫崇綸以託病奪職。

translations.literal: Former Hubei governor Chong Lun was stripped of office for feigning illness.
translations.idiomatic: Ex-governor Chong Lun was dismissed for sham illness.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，雨。

translations.literal: On day renxu, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，和春、福濟奏收復安徽六安州城。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Hechun and Fu Ji memorialized recovering Lu'an prefectural city in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Hechun and Fu Ji reported Lu'an city recovered.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰朔，賜臨清、冠縣被賊難民一月口糧。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day wuchen: one month's ration grain was given to victims of bandit hardship in Linqing and Guan county.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, wuchen new moon, Linqing and Guan victims received one month's rations.

sentences.zh: 江西賊竄湖北德安。

translations.literal: Jiangxi bandits fled into De'an, Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi rebels entered Hubei's De'an.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，許乃釗免，以吉爾杭阿為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Xu Naijiao was dismissed; Gilang'a was made Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Xu Naijiao was dismissed and Gilang'a became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「中國海口，除通商五口外，夷船向不駛入。

translations.literal: Edict: "At China's sea ports, apart from the five treaty ports for trade, foreign ships were never permitted to enter.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said China's ports, except the five treaty ports, had never admitted foreign ships.

sentences.zh: 近日乃有闌入金陵、鎮江之事，意欲何為？

translations.literal: Recently there have been intrusions into Jinling and Zhenjiang—what do they intend?"
translations.idiomatic: Recently they had entered Jinling and Zhenjiang—what was their purpose?"

sentences.zh: 葉名琛即向各國夷酋正言阻止。

translations.literal: Ye Mingchen is forthwith to speak plainly to the chiefs of each country and stop them."
translations.idiomatic: Ye Mingchen was to speak plainly to each foreign chief and stop them."

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，詔直省團練殺賊者，建立總坊，入祀忠義祠，婦女遇難捐軀者，入祀節孝祠。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, an edict: those in the provinces who in militia training killed bandits were to have a general memorial arch erected and be entered in the Loyalty and Righteousness Shrine; women who met calamity and gave their lives were to be entered in the Chastity and Filial Piety Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, militia who killed rebels were to have memorial arches and shrine honors; women who died in calamity were to enter the Chastity Shrine.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賊陷武昌。

translations.literal: On day guimao, bandits took Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Wuchang fell.

sentences.zh: 台涌罷，以楊霈為湖北巡撫，署總督。

translations.literal: Tai Yong was dismissed; Yang Yue was made Hubei governor and acting governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Tai Yong was dismissed; Yang Yue became Hubei governor and acting governor-general.

sentences.zh: 命曾國籓由岳州進剿，英桂赴信陽防堵。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was ordered to advance from Yuezhou in suppression; Ying Gui went to Xinyang to defend and block.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was to advance from Yuezhou and Ying Gui was sent to block Xinyang.

sentences.zh: 副都統達洪阿卒于軍，贈都統。

translations.literal: Vice Commander-in-Chief Da Hong'a died in the army and was posthumously made commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Da Hong'a died in camp and was posthumously made commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，敕葉名琛剿捕廣東會匪盜船。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Ye Mingchen was ordered to suppress and capture Guangdong secret-society bandits' pirate ships.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Ye Mingchen was ordered to suppress Guangdong society pirates.

sentences.zh: 鑄鐵錢、鉛錢。

translations.literal: Iron cash and lead cash were cast.
translations.idiomatic: Iron and lead cash were cast.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，湖北賊陷岳州，連陷常德。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinchou: Hubei bandits took Yuezhou and in succession took Changde.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, xinchou, Hubei rebels took Yuezhou and then Changde.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔：「青麟棄城逃走，遠赴長沙，飭官文傳旨正法。

translations.literal: On day renzi, edict: "Qing Lin abandoned the city and fled, going far to Changsha; order Guan Wen to transmit the decree for execution by law."
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, an edict ordered Qing Lin executed by law for abandoning the city and fleeing to Changsha.

sentences.zh: 」副都統特爾清額卒于軍。

translations.literal: Vice Commander-in-Chief Teer Qing'e died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Teer Qing'e died in the army.

sentences.zh: 庚申，湖南水師克復岳州，予革職侍郎曾國籓三品銜。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Hunan river forces recovered Yuezhou; dismissed Vice Minister Zeng Guofan was given third-rank status.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Hunan forces retook Yuezhou and demoted Zeng Guofan received third rank.

sentences.zh: 命道員胡林翼攻剿常德。

translations.literal: Circuit intendant Hu Linyi was ordered to attack and suppress Changde.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi was ordered to attack Changde.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，楊霈奏克復沔陽，賊陷安陸。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Yang Yue memorialized recovering Mianyang; bandits took Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Yang Yue reported Mianyang recovered but Anlu fell.

sentences.zh: 閏七月戊辰，湖北官軍克復安陸。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day wuchen: Hubei government troops recovered Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 7, wuchen, Hubei troops retook Anlu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，欽差大臣琦善卒于軍，以托明阿為欽差大臣，督辦揚州軍務。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Imperial Commissioner Qishan died in the army; Tuoming'a was made Imperial Commissioner to oversee Yangzhou military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Qishan died in camp and Tuoming'a became commissioner for Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，楊霈奏克復京山、孝感、天門、黃陂、麻城等城。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Yang Yue memorialized recovering Jingshan, Xiaogan, Tianmen, Huangpi, Macheng, and other cities.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Yang Yue reported Jingshan, Xiaogan, Tianmen, Huangpi, Macheng, and others recovered.

sentences.zh: 向榮奏官軍收復高淳。

translations.literal: Xiang Rong memorialized that government troops had recovered Gaochun.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Rong reported Gaochun recovered.

sentences.zh: 丙申，和春奏克復太平。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Hechun memorialized recovering Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Hechun reported Taiping recovered.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，官文奏連復嘉魚、蒲圻。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengzi: Guan Wen memorialized in succession recovering Jiayu and Puqi.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, gengzi, Guan Wen reported Jiayu and Puqi recovered.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，廣東土匪陷肇慶，調湖南、福建兵剿之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Guangdong local bandits took Zhaoqing; Hunan and Fujian troops were transferred to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Guangdong bandits took Zhaoqing and Hunan and Fujian troops were sent.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，湖南官軍由城陵磯進攻通城。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Hunan government troops advanced from Chenglingji to attack Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Hunan troops advanced from Chenglingji against Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，英、美二國兵船抵天津海口，命桂良蒞事。

translations.literal: On day guihai, British and American warships reached Tianjin's sea mouth; Gui Liang was ordered to go handle matters.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, British and American ships reached Tianjin and Gui Liang was sent to handle them.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，湖北、湖南官軍攻克武昌、漢陽。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinwei: Hubei and Hunan government troops captured Wuchang and Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, xinwei, Hubei and Hunan troops took Wuchang and Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 授楊霈湖廣總督，曾國籓以二品銜署湖北巡撫，塔齊布賜黃馬褂，李孟群、羅澤南、李續賓並升敘有差。

translations.literal: Yang Yue was made governor-general of Huguang; Zeng Guofan with second-rank status acted as Hubei governor; Taqibu was given a yellow jacket; Li Mengqun, Luo Zemin, and Li Xubin were promoted with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yue became Huguang governor-general; Zeng Guofan acted as Hubei governor at second rank; Taqibu got a yellow jacket; Li Mengqun, Luo Zemin, and Li Xubin were promoted.

sentences.zh: 殉難布政使岳興、署按察使李卿穀均予諡建祠。

translations.literal: Martyred administration commissioner Yue Xing and acting surveillance commissioner Li Qinggu were both given posthumous titles and shrines built.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Xing and acting commissioner Li Qinggu received posthumous titles and shrines.

sentences.zh: 壬午，湖北官軍克復黃州。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Hubei government troops recovered Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Hubei troops retook Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 命曾國籓以兵部侍郎銜會塔齊布督軍東下。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was ordered with Vice Minister of War status to join Taqibu in supervising the army eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was ordered east with vice minister rank alongside Taqibu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，裕瑞罷，以黃宗漢為四川總督，何桂清為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Yu Rui was dismissed; Huang Zonghan was made Sichuan governor-general and He Guiqing Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Yu Rui was dismissed; Huang Zonghan took Sichuan and He Guiqing took Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，安徽官軍收復廬江。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Anhui government troops recovered Lujiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Anhui troops retook Lujiang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，魏元烺卒，以翁心存為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Wei Yuanyao died; Weng Xincun was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Wei Yuanyao died and Weng Xincun became minister of war.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，以花沙納為吏部尚書，全慶為工部尚書，領國子監。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingchen: Huashana was made Minister of Personnel, Quan Qing Minister of Works and head of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, bingchen, Huashana took personnel, Quan Qing took works and the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 調文慶為滿洲都統，奕興為漢軍都統，奕山為內大臣。

translations.literal: Wen Qing was transferred to Manchu commandant-in-chief, Yi Xing to Han Army commandant-in-chief, and Yi Shan to inner court minister.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Qing became Manchu commandant, Yi Xing Han Army commandant, and Yi Shan inner court minister.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，曾國籓奏水陸軍攻半壁山賊，斃賊萬餘。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Zeng Guofan memorialized that combined land and river forces attacked bandits at Banbishan and killed more than ten thousand bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Zeng Guofan reported land and river forces killed over ten thousand rebels at Banbishan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以扎拉芬泰為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Zhala Fentai was made Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Zhala Fentai became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 甲子，曾國籓等奏攻克田家鎮，予楊載福、彭玉麟升敘。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Zeng Guofan and others memorialized capturing Tianjiazhen; Yang Zaifu and Peng Yulin were promoted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Zeng Guofan reported Tianjiazhen taken and Yang Zaifu and Peng Yulin were promoted.

sentences.zh: 湖北軍收復蘄州。

translations.literal: Hubei forces recovered Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei forces retook Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingchou: the Emperor went to the Hall of Great Heights to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, dingchou, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Hall of Great Heights.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，楊霈奏克復廣濟、黃梅。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Yang Yue memorialized recovering Guangji and Huangmei.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Yang Yue reported Guangji and Huangmei recovered.

sentences.zh: 戊子，羅繞典卒，以恆春為雲貴總督，王慶雲為山西巡撫，吳振棫為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Luo Raodian died; Hengchun was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general, Wang Qingyun Shanxi governor, and Wu Zhenduo Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Luo Raodian died; Hengchun took Yunnan-Guizhou, Wang Qingyun Shanxi, and Wu Zhenduo Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 綏遠城將軍善祿卒于軍。

translations.literal: Suiyuan City general Shanlu died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Shanlu died in the army at Suiyuan City.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大學士、軍機大臣祁俊藻致仕。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Grand Secretary and Grand Councillor Qi Junyuan retired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Grand Secretary Qi Junyuan retired.

sentences.zh: 以賈楨為大學士，翁心存為吏部尚書，周祖培為兵部尚書，許乃普為左都御史。

translations.literal: Jia Zhen was made Grand Secretary, Weng Xincun Minister of Personnel, Zhou Zupei Minister of War, and Xu Naipu Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhen became grand secretary; Weng Xincun took personnel, Zhou Zupei war, and Xu Naipu the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，湖北賊陷安徽英山。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Hubei bandits took Yingshan, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Hubei rebels took Yingshan in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 安慶賊竄九江、湖口，及於吳城。

translations.literal: Anqing bandits fled to Jiujiang, Hukou, and as far as Wucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Anqing rebels fled to Jiujiang, Hukou, and Wucheng.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，曾國籓奏攻克小池口，上嘉獎之，賜狐腿黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiwei: Zeng Guofan memorialized capturing Xiao Chikou; the Emperor praised him and bestowed a fox-leg yellow jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, yiwei, Zeng Guofan reported Xiao Chikou taken and received a fox-leg yellow jacket.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，和春奏克復英山。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Hechun memorialized recovering Yingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Hechun reported Yingshan recovered.

sentences.zh: 以克復英、霍兩縣均資民力，免三年漕糧。

translations.literal: Because recovery of Ying and Huo counties had relied on the people's strength, three years of grain transport tax were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ying and Huo counties were exempted from three years of transport tax for popular effort in recovery.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，袁甲三奏舉人臧紆青進攻桐城，力竭陣亡，贈三品銜，予世職。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Yuan Jiasan memorialized that licentiate Zang Yuqing in attacking Tongcheng exhausted his strength and died in battle; he was given third-rank status and a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Yuan Jiasan reported licentiate Zang Yuqing died attacking Tongcheng and received third rank and a hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，封奕紀之子載中貝勒，嗣隱志郡王，改名載治。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Yi Ji's son Zai Zhong was enfeoffed as beile and succeeded to Prince of Yin Zhi; his name was changed to Zai Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Yi Ji's son Zai Zhong became beile, succeeded Prince Yin Zhi as Zai Zhi.

sentences.zh: 貴州官兵擊賊，敗之，解興義城圍。

translations.literal: Guizhou government troops attacked bandits, defeated them, and relieved the siege of Xingyi city.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou troops defeated rebels and lifted the siege of Xingyi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，安徽官軍克復含山。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Anhui government troops recovered Hanshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Anhui troops retook Hanshan.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁奏攻毀西連鎮賊巢。

translations.literal: Senggelinqin memorialized attacking and destroying the bandit nest at West Lianzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Senggelinqin reported destroying the rebel nest at West Lianzhen.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the joint autumn sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the autumn joint sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免河南、山東、山西、福建、湖南、廣西等省一百二十九州縣，又廣西土州縣十二災賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, grain tax was remitted for 129 prefectures and counties in Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, Fujian, Hunan, Guangxi, and other provinces, and disaster levies were remitted in varying degrees for twelve native prefectures and counties in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: That year, 129 prefectures and counties in six provinces had grain tax remitted and twelve Guangxi native districts had disaster levies reduced.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年乙卯春正月己巳，四川官軍克復貴州桐梓。

translations.literal: Fifth year, yimao, spring, first month, day jisi: Sichuan government troops recovered Tongzi in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5, month 1, jisi, Sichuan troops retook Guizhou's Tongzi.

sentences.zh: 壬申，貴州官軍剿匪雷台山，擒匪首陳良模。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Guizhou government troops suppressed bandits at Leitai Mountain and captured bandit chief Chen Liangmo.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Guizhou troops took Leitai Mountain and captured Chen Liangmo.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以江、浙漕米不敷京倉支放，命怡良開辦米捐解京。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, because Jiangsu and Zhejiang transport grain was insufficient for the capital granaries, Yi Liang was ordered to open rice contributions for delivery to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, insufficient Jiangsu-Zhejiang grain transport led Yi Liang to open rice contributions for Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，吉爾杭阿奏克復上海縣城。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Gilang'a memorialized recovering Shanghai county seat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Gilang'a reported Shanghai county recovered.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉獎之。

translations.literal: An edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，湖北賊由黃梅回竄漢口，楊霈退守德安，奪職，仍留任。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Hubei bandits from Huangmei doubled back to Hankou; Yang Yue withdrew to defend De'an, was stripped of office but remained in post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, rebels from Huangmei retook Hankou; Yang Yue fell back to De'an, was demoted but kept his post.

sentences.zh: 癸未，江西官軍克復武寧。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Jiangxi government troops recovered Wuning.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Jiangxi troops retook Wuning.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，僧格林沁奏攻克連鎮，首逆林鳳祥就擒。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Senggelinqin memorialized capturing Lianzhen and chief rebel Lin Fengxiang was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Senggelinqin reported Lianzhen taken and Lin Fengxiang captured.

sentences.zh: 封僧格林沁親王，移軍山東，攻剿高唐踞匪。

translations.literal: Senggelinqin was enfeoffed as prince, shifted his army to Shandong, and attacked and suppressed the bandits entrenched at Gaotang.
translations.idiomatic: Senggelinqin was made prince, moved to Shandong, and attacked the rebels at Gaotang.

sentences.zh: 欽差大臣勝保師久無功，褫職逮問。

translations.literal: Imperial Commissioner Sheng Bao's army had long been without success; he was stripped of office and arrested for inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao lost his commission after prolonged failure and was arrested.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，浙江樂清土匪滋事，剿平之。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, bandits caused trouble in Yueqing, Zhejiang; they were suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Yueqing bandits in Zhejiang were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 敘連鎮功，西凌阿、瑞麟、慶祺、綿洵、拉木棍布扎布、棍楚克林沁各予優賚。

translations.literal: Merit at Lianzhen was recounted; Xiling'a, Ruilin, Qingqi, Mianxun, Lamugun Buzhabu, and Sengge Rinchen each received generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Lianzhen honors brought rich rewards to Xiling'a, Ruilin, Qingqi, Mianxun, Lamugun Buzhabu, and Sengge Rinchen.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午朔，王懿德奏夷商來閩販茶，租賃民房久居，藉收茶稅，從之。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day jiawu: Wang Yide memorialized that foreign merchants came to Fujian to sell tea, rented civilian houses for long residence, and sought to collect tea tax thereby; the court assented.
translations.idiomatic: At the second-month new moon, jiawu, Wang Yide won assent to tax foreign tea merchants renting houses in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 以法將剌尼樂助攻上海，賚綢四端、銀一萬兩，從吉爾杭阿請也。

translations.literal: Because the French general Rigault assisted in attacking Shanghai, four bolts of silk and ten thousand taels of silver were bestowed, as Ji'erhang'a had requested.
translations.idiomatic: Rigault's aid at Shanghai brought him silk and ten thousand taels of silver at Ji'erhang'a's request.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor held court lecture on the classics.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁奏克復高唐州，餘匪竄入馮官屯。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen memorialized that Gaotang prefecture had been recovered and the remaining bandits had fled into Fengguantun.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen reported Gaotang retaken while remnant bandits fled to Fengguantun.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，福建匪徒作亂，剿平之。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, bandits rebelled in Fujian; they were suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Fujian bandits were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，鄂賊北竄，敕僧格林沁調撥馬步兵三四千赴河南助防。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Hu bandits fled north; Sengge Rinchen was ordered to transfer three or four thousand cavalry and infantry to Henan to aid defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, northern-fleeing Hu bandits drew three or four thousand of Sengge Rinchen's troops to Henan.
