sentences.zh: 三月甲子，廣東官軍復海豐。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: Guangdong government troops recovered Haifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi day, Guangdong forces retook Haifeng.

sentences.zh: 皖賊陷徽州。

translations.literal: Anhui bandits took Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huizhou fell to Anhui bandits.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上謁西陵。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 賊陷武昌，巡撫陶恩培死之，以胡林翼署湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Bandits took Wuchang; Governor Tao Enpei died in the fighting; Hu Linyi was ordered to administer as Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchang fell, Tao Enpei was killed, and Hu Linyi acted as Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上還京。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，貴州匪首楊鳳捕誅，餘匪平。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Yang Feng, ringleader of Guizhou bandits, was captured and executed; the remaining bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Guizhou's Yang Feng was executed and his followers pacified.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，安徽官軍收復婺源。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiwei: Anhui government troops recovered Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, yiwei, Anhui forces retook Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 以額駙景壽為御前大臣。

translations.literal: The emperor's son-in-law Jingshou was made an imperial presence grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: Jingshou, the emperor's son-in-law, became an imperial presence grand minister.

sentences.zh: 丁未，江西賊陷廣信。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Jiangxi bandits took Guangxin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Guangxin fell to Jiangxi bandits.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，僧格林沁等奏攻克馮官屯賊巢，擒獲首逆李開芳，餘匪盡殲。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Sengge Rinchen and others memorialized that the Fengguantun bandit nest had been stormed, chief rebel Li Kaifang captured, and the remaining bandits entirely annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Sengge Rinchen reported Fengguantun taken, Li Kaifang captured, and the remnant destroyed.

sentences.zh: 得旨：欣慰，僧格林沁即以親王世襲，許乘肩輿，德勒克色楞加貝勒銜，餘各升敘。

translations.literal: An edict responded: "We are relieved. Sengge Rinchen is forthwith enfeoffed as a prince with hereditary succession, permitted to ride in a sedan chair, and Deleksereng is given the title of beile; the rest are promoted in rank."
translations.idiomatic: The throne made Sengge Rinchen a hereditary prince with sedan-chair privilege, ennobled Deleksereng, and promoted his officers.

sentences.zh: 江西官軍復弋陽。

translations.literal: Jiangxi government troops recovered Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyang was retaken by Jiangxi government troops.

sentences.zh: 浙江賊陷開化。

translations.literal: Zhejiang bandits took Kaihua.
translations.idiomatic: Kaihua fell to Zhejiang bandits.

sentences.zh: 己未，西安將軍扎拉芬在湖北剿賊陣亡，優恤之。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Xi'an General Zhalafen died in battle while suppressing bandits in Hubei; generous condolence was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Zhalafen of Xi'an died fighting bandits in Hubei and received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 褫楊霈職，以官文為湖廣總督，綿洵為荊州將軍，瑞麟為西安將軍。

translations.literal: Yang Pi was stripped of office; Guan Wen was made Huguang governor-general, Mianxun Jingzhou general, and Ruilin Xi'an general.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Pi was dismissed; Guan Wen took Huguang, Mianxun Jingzhou, and Ruilin Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 以西凌阿為欽差大臣，赴湖北剿賊。

translations.literal: Xiling'a was made Imperial Commissioner and sent to Hubei to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Xiling'a went to Hubei as Imperial Commissioner against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 庚申，江西官軍復饒州、廣信及興安。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Jiangxi government troops recovered Raozhou, Guangxin, and Xing'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Jiangxi forces retook Raozhou, Guangxin, and Xing'an.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，廣東官軍剿匪獲勝，水陸股匪悉平。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Guangdong government troops won victories suppressing bandits; land and water bandit gangs were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Guangdong forces pacified all land and water bandit gangs.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，恤福建陣亡知縣高鴻飛，入祀京師昭忠祠，並於台灣建祠。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingyin: the fallen magistrate Gao Hongfei of Fujian was mourned, entered the Beijing Shrine of Loyalty, and a shrine was also built in Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, bingyin, fallen Fujian magistrate Gao Hongfei was honored in Beijing and Taiwan shrines.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，向榮奏剿賊三山，勝之。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Xiang Rong memorialized that in suppressing bandits at Sanshan he was victorious.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Xiang Rong reported victory at Sanshan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，廣東官軍復河源等縣，殲賊於三水。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Guangdong government troops recovered Heyuan and other counties and annihilated bandits at Sanshui.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Guangdong retook Heyuan and destroyed bandits at Sanshui.

sentences.zh: 辛未，上御乾清門，奉命大將軍惠親王綿愉、參贊大臣親王僧格林沁恭繳大將軍印、參贊關防。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor attended at the Gate of Heavenly Purity as the commissioned Grand General, Prince Mianyu, and the assisting Grand General, Prince Sengge Rinchen, respectfully returned the grand general's seal and the assisting commissioner's seal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day at Qianqing Gate, Princes Mianyu and Sengge Rinchen returned their grand-general seals.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔曰：「興辦團練，原以保衛鄉閭。

translations.literal: On day renshen, an edict said: "Organizing local militia was originally to protect villages and hamlets.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day an edict warned that militia were meant to guard the countryside.

sentences.zh: 而河南迭有抗糧、抗官之事。

translations.literal: Yet Henan has repeatedly had grain-tax resistance and resistance to officials.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Henan kept seeing tax revolts and defiance of officials.

sentences.zh: 似此相率效尤，流弊甚大。

translations.literal: If such examples spread in succession, the harm will be very great.
translations.idiomatic: Mass imitation of that kind would do great harm.

sentences.zh: 各督撫其尚加意整頓，勿令日久釀患。

translations.literal: All governors-general and governors should take extra care to rectify matters and not let long delay breed trouble."
translations.idiomatic: All governors were told to tighten control before trouble grew.

sentences.zh: 」是時，山東已有黑團之害，尚未上聞。

translations.literal: At that time Shandong already had harm from the "Black Militia," not yet reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong's Black Militia scourge was not yet known at court.

sentences.zh: 其後卒以兵力平之。

translations.literal: Later they were finally suppressed by military force.
translations.idiomatic: They were eventually crushed by force of arms.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以柏葰為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Boqiu was made Rehe commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Boqiu became Rehe commandant.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，楊霈軍復隨州。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Yang Pi's army recovered Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Yang Pi's force retook Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，河南軍收復光山。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Henan forces recovered Guangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Henan troops retook Guangshan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，胡林翼奏分督水陸各軍力攻武、漢，四戰四勝。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Hu Linyi memorialized that land and water forces under separate command jointly attacked Wuhan and won four battles in four engagements.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Hu Linyi reported four straight victories pressing Wuhan by land and water.

sentences.zh: 得旨，迅圖克復。

translations.literal: An edict ordered swift recovery.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered rapid recapture.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕聞雲南回民易滋事端，屢有聚眾抗糧之事。

translations.literal: An edict said: "We hear that Yunnan Hui people easily cause incidents and have repeatedly gathered crowds to resist grain levies.
translations.idiomatic: An edict warned that Yunnan Hui communities kept resisting grain levies in armed crowds.

sentences.zh: 恆春、舒興阿務將首要各犯懲處，勿令日久蔓延。

translations.literal: Hengchun and Shuxing'a must punish the chief culprits and not let the trouble spread over time."
translations.idiomatic: Hengchun and Shuxing'a were told to punish ringleaders before unrest spread.

sentences.zh: 」以李鈞為東河河道總督。

translations.literal: Li Jun was made Grand Canal governor-general of the Eastern River.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jun became Eastern River canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，江西賊陷義寧。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiwei: Jiangxi bandits took Yining.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, yiwei, Jiangxi bandits took Yining.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，提督鄧紹良克復休寧。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Regional Commander Deng Shaoliang recovered Xiuning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Deng Shaoliang retook Xiuning.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，廣東官軍收復封川，殲賊於虎門洋面。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Guangdong government troops recovered Fengchuan and annihilated bandits on the Humen sea surface.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Guangdong retook Fengchuan and destroyed bandits off Humen.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，河南蘭陽河溢。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Lanyang River in Henan burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Henan's Lanyang River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 己未，敕安徽徽寧池廣道照台灣道專摺奏事。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Anhui circuit intendant for Huizhou, Ningguo, Chizhou, and Guangde was ordered to submit special memorials on important matters, as the Taiwan circuit intendant did.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Anhui's Huining circuit gained Taiwan-style direct memorial rights.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，官文奏官軍克復雲夢、應城。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Guan Wen memorialized that government troops had recovered Yunmeng and Yingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Guan Wen reported Yunmeng and Yingcheng recovered.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌朔，尊皇貴太妃為康慈皇太后。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon on day renxu: the Honored Imperial Noble Consort was elevated as Empress Dowager Kangci.
translations.idiomatic: At the seventh-month new moon, renxu, the Honored Imperial Noble Consort became Empress Dowager Kangci.

sentences.zh: 廣東賊陷湖南郴州、宜章。

translations.literal: Guangdong bandits took Chenzhou and Yizhang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's Chenzhou and Yizhang fell to Guangdong bandits.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，陳啟邁奪職，以文俊為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Chen Qimai was dismissed; Wen Jun was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Chen Qimai fell and Wen Jun took Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 己巳，向榮奏克復蕪湖。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Xiang Rong memorialized that Wuhu had been recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Xiang Rong reported Wuhu recovered.

sentences.zh: 庚午，皇太后崩。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Empress Dowager died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，西凌阿進剿德安賊匪不利，退守隨州。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Xiling'a's advance against De'an bandits went badly and he withdrew to defend Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Xiling'a failed at De'an and fell back to Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 命都興阿自馮官屯移軍剿之。

translations.literal: Duxing'a was ordered to move his army from Fengguantun to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Duxing'a was told to leave Fengguantun and pursue the rebels.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，恭親王奕訢罷直軍機，回上書房讀書。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Prince Gong Yixin was removed from duty on the Grand Council and returned to the Upper Study to read books.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Prince Gong Yixin left the Grand Council for the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 以文慶為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Wenqing was made a Grand Council minister.
translations.idiomatic: Wenqing joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 癸未，廣東官軍收復肇慶府、德慶州。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Guangdong government troops recovered Zhaoqing prefecture and Deqing department.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Guangdong retook Zhaoqing and Deqing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，山西陽城土匪滋事，剿平之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, local bandits caused trouble in Yangcheng, Shanxi; they were suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Yangcheng bandits in Shanxi were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，官文奏克復漢川。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Guan Wen memorialized that Hankou had been recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Guan Wen reported Hankou recovered.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯朔，胡林翼督軍攻克漢鎮，進圍漢陽。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day xinmao: Hu Linyi directed the army in storming the Han towns and advanced to besiege Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the eighth-month new moon, xinmao, Hu Linyi stormed the Han towns and besieged Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，英桂奏邱聯恩擒獲捻首易添富、王黨等誅之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Ying Gui memorialized that Qiu Lian'en had captured and executed Nian chiefs Yi Tianfu, Wang Dang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Ying Gui reported Qiu Lian'en had executed Nian leaders Yi Tianfu and Wang Dang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，湖南提督塔齊布卒于軍，贈將軍。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Hunan Regional Commander Taqibu died in camp; he was posthumously made a general.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Taqibu of Hunan died in the field and was made a general posthumously.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上大行皇太后尊諡曰孝靜康慈皇后。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the late Empress Dowager was given the honorific title Empress Xiaojing Kangci.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the late Empress Dowager received the title Empress Xiaojing Kangci.

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾回匪入卡，倭什琿布派兵逐出之。

translations.literal: Hui bandits from Kashgar entered the pass; troops sent by Ishaqpa drove them out.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar Hui raiders entered the pass and Ishaqpa's troops expelled them.

sentences.zh: 戊申，廣東官軍連復連州、三江、連山，解永安城圍。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Guangdong government troops in succession recovered Lianzhou, Sanjiang, and Lianshan and lifted the siege of Yong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Guangdong recovered Lianzhou, Sanjiang, and Lianshan and relieved Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，大學士卓秉恬卒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiazi: Grand Secretary Zhuo Bingtian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiazi day, Grand Secretary Zhuo Bingtian died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以劉鉦為漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Liu Zheng was made commander of the Eight Banners.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Liu Zheng became Eight Banners commander.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命文慶、葉名琛協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Wenqing and Ye Mingchen were ordered to assist as grand secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Wenqing and Ye Mingchen were assigned to assist the grand secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，發內帑十萬兩續賑直隸、山東災民。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, one hundred thousand taels from the inner treasury were issued to continue relief for disaster victims in Zhili and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, another hundred thousand taels went to Zhili and Shandong disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 壬午，四川馬邊廳夷匪滋事，官軍剿平之。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Yi bandits caused trouble in Mabian department, Sichuan; government troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Mabian Yi unrest in Sichuan was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，捻首張洛行由歸德南竄，命提督武隆額剿之。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Nian chief Zhang Luoxing fled south from Guide; Regional Commander Wu Long'e was ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Zhang Luoxing fled south from Guide and Wu Long'e was sent after him.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命官文為欽差大臣，督辦湖北軍務。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Guan Wen was made Imperial Commissioner to supervise Hubei military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Guan Wen became Imperial Commissioner over Hubei.

sentences.zh: 浙軍克復安徽休寧、石埭。

translations.literal: Zhejiang forces recovered Xiuning and Shicheng in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang troops retook Anhui's Xiuning and Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 戊子，調鄧紹良為固原提督。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Deng Shaoliang was transferred to be regional commander of Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Deng Shaoliang became Guyuan regional commander.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，和春、福濟奏克復廬州府城。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingyou: Hechun and Fu Ji memorialized that Luzhou prefectural city had been recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, dingyou, Hechun and Fu Ji reported Luzhou city recovered.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎，賜和春黃馬褂，福濟太子少保，免合肥三年額賦。

translations.literal: An edict praised and rewarded them: Hechun was given a yellow riding jacket, Fu Ji made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and three years of quota levies for Hefei were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The court gave Hechun a yellow jacket, made Fu Ji Junior Guardian, and remitted three years of Hefei taxes.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，貴州苗匪陷都江。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Miao bandits in Guizhou took Dujiang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Guizhou Miao bandits took Dujiang.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，官文奏克復德安。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Guan Wen memorialized that De'an had been recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Guan Wen reported De'an recovered.

sentences.zh: 戊申，石達開回竄湖北，胡林翼堵剿之。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Shi Dakai fled back into Hubei; Hu Linyi blocked and suppressed him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Shi Dakai re-entered Hubei and Hu Linyi moved to stop him.

sentences.zh: 壬子，永免河南攤徵河工加價銀四十萬兩。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the forty myriad taels of added river-works surcharge levied in Henan were permanently remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Henan's forty-myriad-tael river-works surcharge was abolished forever.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，胡林翼奏，羅澤南、李續賓迎擊石達開、韋俊於羊樓峒，敗之；

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: Hu Linyi memorialized that Luo Zinan and Li Xubin met and attacked Shi Dakai and Wei Jun at Yangloudong and defeated them;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, jiazi, Hu Linyi reported Luo Zinan and Li Xubin defeated Shi Dakai and Wei Jun at Yangloudong;

sentences.zh: 請購洋砲擊賊。

translations.literal: he requested purchase of foreign cannon to strike the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: and asked to buy foreign guns against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 敕葉名琛採購洋砲六百尊，由湖南水運湖北應用。

translations.literal: Ye Mingchen was ordered to purchase six hundred foreign cannon and have them transported by water from Hunan to Hubei for use.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Mingchen was told to buy six hundred foreign guns and ship them from Hunan to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 辛未，廓爾喀夷人占踞後藏濟嚨。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Gorkha foreigners occupied Jilong in rear Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Gorkhas seized Jilong in rear Tibet.

sentences.zh: 德興卒，調麟魁為刑部尚書，以瑞麟為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Dexing died; Lin Kui was transferred to be Minister of Justice, and Ruilin was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: After Dexing's death, Lin Kui took Justice and Ruilin took Rites.

sentences.zh: 戊子，官文奏攻克咸寧、金口，並報江西賊陷義寧，檄飭羅澤南回剿。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Guan Wen memorialized that Xianning and Jinkou had been stormed, and also reported that Jiangxi bandits had taken Yining and ordered Luo Zinan to return to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Guan Wen reported Xianning and Jinkou taken and wanted Luo Zinan recalled when Yining fell.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「羅澤南正在攻剿，武漢契緊，不可回剿。

translations.literal: An edict responded: "Luo Zinan is now attacking and suppressing; the Wuhan front is pressing; he must not be recalled for suppression elsewhere."
translations.idiomatic: The throne refused recall: Luo Zinan must stay on the pressing Wuhan front.

sentences.zh: 」詔令曾國籓等遣周汝筠前赴崇、通，為羅澤南後路援應。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zeng Guofan and others to send Zhou Ruyun ahead to Chongyang and Tongcheng as rear support for Luo Zinan.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was told to send Zhou Ruyun to Chongyang and Tongcheng to back Luo Zinan.

sentences.zh: 和春等奏捻匪李兆受竄踞英山，道員何桂珍密謀會捕，不克，死之。

translations.literal: Hechun and others memorialized that Nian bandit Li Zhaoshou had fled into and occupied Yingshan; Circuit Intendant He Guizhen secretly plotted joint capture but failed and died.
translations.idiomatic: Hechun reported Li Zhaoshou holding Yingshan and He Guizhen's failed secret ambush in which he died.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinmao: the Emperor went to the Hall of Great Height to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, xinmao, the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙申，江西賊陷臨江、瑞州，敕曾國籓撥兵剿之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Jiangxi bandits took Linjiang and Ruizhou; Zeng Guofan was ordered to detach troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Linjiang and Ruizhou fell and Zeng Guofan was told to send troops.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，留江蘇漕米二十萬石濟江南軍。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, two hundred thousand piculs of Jiangsu tribute grain were retained to supply the Jiangnan army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, two hundred thousand piculs of Jiangsu grain were held for the Jiangnan army.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，廣西官軍收復興安。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Guangxi government troops recovered Xing'an.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Guangxi forces retook Xing'an.

sentences.zh: 貴州賊徐廷傑陷鎮筸，分陷思南。

translations.literal: Guizhou bandit Xu Tingjie took Zhengan and also took parts of Sinan.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Tingjie of Guizhou seized Zhengan and raided Sinan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命文慶、葉名琛為大學士，桂良、彭蘊章協辦大學士，柏葰為戶部尚書，奕湘為盛京將軍，英隆為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Wenqing and Ye Mingchen were made grand secretaries; Gui Liang and Peng Yunzhang were ordered to assist as grand secretaries; Boqiu was made Minister of Revenue; Yixiang was made Shengjing general; Yinglong was made Rehe commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Wenqing and Ye Mingchen became grand secretaries with Gui Liang and Peng Yunzhang assisting; Boqiu took Revenue, Yixiang Shengjing, and Yinglong Rehe.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以鄭親王端華為滿洲都統，奕山為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Prince Duanhua of the Zheng lineage was made Manchu commander-in-chief, and Yishan was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Prince Duanhua became Manchu commander and Yishan Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 命西凌阿赴河南防剿。

translations.literal: Xi Ling'a was ordered to proceed to Henan for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Ling'a was sent to Henan to fight bandits.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，捻匪張洛行回竄歸德。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Nien bandit Zhang Luoxing fled back toward Guide.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Nien leader Zhang Luoxing retreated toward Guide.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命英桂督剿豫、東、皖三省捻匪。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Yinggui was ordered to supervise suppression of Nien bandits in Henan, Shandong, and Anhui provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Yinggui took command against Nien rebels in Henan, Shandong, and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 景淳奏陳防夷情形，上嘉獎之。

translations.literal: Jingchun memorialized on defense against barbarians; the Emperor commended and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchun reported on coastal defense; the Emperor praised him.

sentences.zh: 駐藏大臣赫特賀奏馳抵後藏籌御大略。

translations.literal: Tibet Resident Commissioner Hetehe memorialized that he had hurried to rear Tibet to plan the general defense.
translations.idiomatic: Hetehe reported rushing to rear Tibet to organize defense.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「江孜、定日汛、馬布加各地，均屬中道要害，即宜扼守。

translations.literal: Received the edict: "Gyantse, Dingri post, Mapuja, and other places are all key points on the central route and should be held at once.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said Gyantse, Dingri, Mapuja, and other central-route strongpoints must be held immediately.

sentences.zh: 噶布倫中擇其為夷情信仰者，令協同辦事，以輔兵力之不及。

translations.literal: Among the kashag agents, choose those trusted by the barbarians and order them to cooperate in affairs to supplement what troops cannot cover.
translations.idiomatic: Trusted kashag agents were to assist where troops fell short.

sentences.zh: 生擒夷人，暫留營中，令來往通信，以示羈縻。

translations.literal: Barbarians captured alive should be kept temporarily in camp and allowed to communicate back and forth to show conciliatory control.
translations.idiomatic: Captured tribesmen were to be held as messengers for a conciliatory policy.

sentences.zh: 樂斌等所擬六條，下該大臣知之。

translations.literal: The six articles drafted by Le Bin and others were sent down for the resident commissioner to know.
translations.idiomatic: Le Bin's six proposals were sent to the commissioner.

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: " On day dingsi, the combined seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed." On dingsi day, the court held the temple combined sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、山東、湖北、廣西、貴州等省二府一百五十八州縣，又廣西三十八土州縣災賦，江蘇鹽場場課各有差。

translations.literal: That year, taxes were remitted for 158 prefectures and counties in two circuits each in Zhili, Shandong, Hubei, Guangxi, Guizhou, and other provinces; disaster levies were also remitted for thirty-eight native districts in Guangxi; and salt-field duties in Jiangsu were adjusted variously.
translations.idiomatic: That year tax relief covered 158 districts in Zhili, Shandong, Hubei, Guangxi, and Guizhou, thirty-eight Guangxi native districts, and adjusted Jiangsu salt-field dues.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 六年丙辰春正月己未朔，惇郡王奕脤復親王。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, new moon day jiwei: Prince Dun Yi Song was restored to princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6, spring month 1, new moon jiwei, Prince Dun Yi Song regained princely rank.

sentences.zh: 以奕山為御前大臣，貝勒載治御前行走。

translations.literal: Yi Shan was made an imperial presence grand minister and Beile Zai Zhi was assigned to walk attendance before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Shan joined the imperial presence and Beile Zai Zhi received front-audience duty.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，楊以增卒，以庚長為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Yang Yizeng died; Geng Chang was made Grand Canal governor-general of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Yang Yizeng died and Geng Chang became Jiangnan canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賊擾湖南晃州、麻陽，官軍擊走之，斬賊首何祿。

translations.literal: On day renshen, rebels harried Hunan's Huangzhou and Mayang; government troops drove them off and beheaded rebel leader He Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, rebels struck Huangzhou and Mayang in Hunan; troops routed them and killed He Lu.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔駱秉章檄知府劉長佑赴江西剿賊。

translations.literal: On day yihai, an edict ordered Luo Bingzhang to dispatch prefect Liu Changyou to Jiangxi to suppress rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Luo Bingzhang was told to send Prefect Liu Changyou to fight rebels in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，廣東提督昆壽剿歸善賊，平之。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Guangdong provincial military commissioner Kunshou suppressed Guiji rebels and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Kunshou pacified Guiji rebels in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，提督秦定三攻克舒城。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, provincial military commissioner Qin Dingsan captured Shucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Qin Dingsan took Shucheng.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰，詔湖南苗弁剿匪出力，准其留營序補。

translations.literal: Second month, day renchen: an edict said Hunan Miao officers who exerted themselves suppressing bandits might remain in camp for seniority promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, renchen, Miao officers who fought well in Hunan could earn camp seniority for promotion.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor held the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，順天府尹蔣琦淳疏進克己、復禮二箴，上嘉納之。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Shuntian prefect Jiang Qichun presented memorials advancing the Maxims on Self-Restraint and on Returning to Rites; the Emperor commended and accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Jiang Qichun submitted essays on restraint and ritual; the Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 丙午，英、美二國求改條約，下葉名琛知之。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Britain and the United States sought treaty revision; the matter was sent down for Ye Mingchen to know.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Britain and America asked to revise treaties; Ye Mingchen was notified.

sentences.zh: 丁未，調吉林、黑龍江、察哈爾、綏遠城兵赴山東、河南剿賊。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, troops from Jilin, Heilongjiang, Chahar, and Suiyuan city were transferred to Shandong and Henan to suppress rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, banner troops from the northeast were sent to Shandong and Henan against rebels.

sentences.zh: 己酉，酌增直省文員減成養廉。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, civil officials in provinces directly under the court were given an increase to their reduced-percentage integrity-nourishment allowances.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, provincial civil officials received increased integrity-pay supplements.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命福興幫辦江南軍務。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Fuxing was ordered to assist in Jiangnan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Fuxing was assigned to Jiangnan military affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，廓爾喀請罷兵。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Nepal asked to cease fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Nepal sought peace.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，貴州官軍攻克銅仁。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Guizhou government troops captured Tongren.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Guizhou troops took Tongren.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，瓜州賊出竄運河，托明阿追剿之。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiwei: Guazhou rebels sallied onto the Grand Canal; Tuoming'a pursued and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, jiwei, Guazhou rebels raided the canal and Tuoming'a pursued them.

sentences.zh: 奕湘免，以慶祺為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Yi Xiang was dismissed and Qingqi was made Mukden general.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Xiang left office and Qingqi became Mukden general.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，湖南官軍克復永明、江華。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Hunan government troops recovered Yongming and Jianghua.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Hunan troops recovered Yongming and Jianghua.

sentences.zh: 劉長佑軍入江西，復萍鄉。

translations.literal: Liu Changyou's army entered Jiangxi and recovered Pingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Changyou entered Jiangxi and retook Pingxiang.

sentences.zh: 江西賊陷吉安。

translations.literal: Jiangxi rebels captured Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels took Ji'an in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上耕耤田。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 甲子，江南賊再陷揚州，奪托明阿、雷以諴職，授德興阿欽差大臣，少詹事翁同書副之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Jiangnan rebels again captured Yangzhou; Tuoming'a and Lei Yixuan were stripped of office; Dexing'a was made Imperial Commissioner with Junior Guardian Weng Tongshu as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Yangzhou fell again; Tuoming'a and Lei Yixuan lost rank; Dexing'a became Imperial Commissioner with Weng Tongshu as deputy.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，石達開陷瑞州，詔廣東堵剿。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Shi Dakai captured Ruizhou; an edict ordered Guangdong to block and suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Shi Dakai took Ruizhou and Guangdong was ordered to intercept him.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，釋賽尚阿、訥爾經額於戍所。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Saišang'a and Ne'erjing'e were released from exile posts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Saišang'a and Ne'erjing'e were freed from exile.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，提督鄧紹良力攻揚州，克之，命幫辦德興阿軍務。

translations.literal: On day yihai, provincial military commissioner Deng Shaoliang pressed the attack on Yangzhou, captured it, and was ordered to assist Dexing'a in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Deng Shaoliang stormed Yangzhou, took it, and joined Dexing'a's staff.

sentences.zh: 賊竄江浦。

translations.literal: Rebels fled to Jiangpu.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fled toward Jiangpu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，羅澤南力攻武昌，陣亡，贈巡撫，賜恤予諡。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Luo Zeyuan pressed the attack on Wuchang, died in battle, was posthumously made governor, and given condolence gifts and a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Luo Zeyuan died assaulting Wuchang and was posthumously ennobled as governor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賊陷江西建昌。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, rebels captured Jiangxi's Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, rebels took Jianchang in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 命浙江學政萬青藜、布政使晏端書督辦三衢防務。

translations.literal: Zhejiang education intendant Wan Qingli and provincial administration commissioner Yan Duanshu were ordered to supervise defense of the Three Qu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Qingli and Yan Duanshu were ordered to defend the Three Qu region in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，穆宗生母懿嬪那拉氏晉封懿妃。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the birth mother of Muzong, Yipin of the Nara clan, was promoted to Yifei.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the future Empress Dowager Cixi was raised from yipin to yifei.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓攻賊樟樹失利，下部議處。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan attacked rebels at Zhangshu unsuccessfully and was referred to the Boards for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan failed at Zhangshu and faced board review.

sentences.zh: 癸未，恆春奏軍務省分督撫，請許單銜奏事，從之。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Hengchun memorialized that military affairs provinces should have governors and governors-general memorialize under single signature; assent was given.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Hengchun won permission for frontier governors to memorialize on military affairs alone.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，張國樑軍攻克浦口。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Zhang Guoliang's army captured Pukou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Zhang Guoliang took Pukou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，粵賊復陷儀徵，官軍尋復之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: Guangdong rebels again captured Yizheng; government troops soon recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, wuzi, Guangdong rebels retook Yizheng but troops soon recovered it.

sentences.zh: 甲午，貴州軍復郎岱。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Guizhou troops recovered Langdai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Guizhou troops retook Langdai.

sentences.zh: 丙申，雲南楚雄漢、回構釁。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Han and Hui in Yunnan's Chuxiong clashed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Han and Hui rioted in Chuxiong, Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，江西軍復進賢。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Jiangxi troops recovered Jinxian.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Jiangxi troops retook Jinxian.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，奉天金州地震。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Fengtian's Jinzhou had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Jinzhou in Fengtian was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，安徽賊陷寧國。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Anhui rebels captured Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, rebels took Ningguo in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 丙午，前協辦大學士、致仕光祿寺卿湯金釗卒，贈尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, former associate grand councillor and retired Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Tang Jin'gao died and was posthumously made minister.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, retired minister Tang Jin'gao died and was posthumously made minister.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜翁同龢等二百一十六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Weng Tonghe and 215 others were granted jinshi degrees with ranks by distinction.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Weng Tonghe and 215 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，德興阿奏官軍攻賊三汊河，毀其巢。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Dexing'a memorialized that government troops had attacked rebel nests at San Cha River and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Dexing'a reported destroying rebel nests at San Cha River.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，以穆克德訥為廣州將軍，都興阿為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: Mukedena was made Guangzhou general and Duxing'a Jiangning general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, xinyou, Mukedena became Guangzhou general and Duxing'a Jiangning general.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，湖北通城官軍失利，道員江忠濟死之。

translations.literal: On day renxu, government troops were defeated at Tongcheng, Hubei, and circuit intendant Jiang Zhongji died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Hubei troops lost at Tongcheng and Jiang Zhongji was killed.

sentences.zh: 江蘇巡撫吉爾杭阿擊賊鎮江之黃泥州，不勝，死之，贈總督。

translations.literal: Jiangsu governor Ji'erhang'a attacked rebels at Huangnizhou near Zhenjiang, was defeated, and died; he was posthumously made governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Ji'erhang'a died fighting at Huangnizhou near Zhenjiang and was posthumously made governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以趙德轍署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhao Dezhe was made acting Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dezhe became acting Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，江南賊撲九華山營盤，陷之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Jiangnan rebels stormed the Jiuhua Mountain encampment and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, rebels stormed and took the Jiuhua Mountain camp.

sentences.zh: 河南軍復光州。

translations.literal: Henan troops recovered Guang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Henan troops retook Guang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 復西凌阿都統。

translations.literal: Xi Ling'a was restored as commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Ling'a regained his commandant rank.

sentences.zh: 袁甲三復三品卿。

translations.literal: Yuan Jiasan was restored as third-rank grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Jiasan regained third-rank secretary rank.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賊陷溧水。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, rebels captured Lishui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, rebels took Lishui.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌朔，金陵賊撲陷大營，官軍退守丹陽，奪向榮、福興職。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon day bingxu: Jinling rebels stormed and took the great camp; government troops fell back to defend Danyang; Xiang Rong and Fuxing were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: At the sixth-month new moon, bingxu, Taiping rebels overran the Jinling great camp; troops fell back to Danyang; Xiang Rong and Fuxing lost rank.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以按察使徐宗幹幫辦安徽防務。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, surveillance commissioner Xu Zonggan was ordered to assist in Anhui defense affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Xu Zonggan joined Anhui defense staff.

sentences.zh: 命怡良雇募火輪船入江剿賊。

translations.literal: Yiliang was ordered to hire steamships to enter the river and suppress rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Yiliang was told to hire steam gunboats for the Yangzi campaign.

sentences.zh: 敕河南、廣東撥兵，和春、傅振邦赴援江南。

translations.literal: An imperial command ordered Henan and Guangdong to detach troops; Hechun and Fu Zhenbang were sent to aid Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were ordered from Henan and Guangdong; Hechun and Fu Zhenbang went south to aid Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，葉名琛奏英、美、法各國公使以定約十二年，請赴京重修條約。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Ye Mingchen memorialized that British, American, and French ministers, citing the twelve-year treaty provision, asked to go to the capital to revise treaties.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Ye Mingchen said British, American, and French ministers wanted treaty revision in Beijing after twelve years.

sentences.zh: 詔酌允變通，阻止來京。

translations.literal: An edict granted flexible approval in part but barred their coming to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The court allowed some flexibility but barred the envoys from Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，永定河溢。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Yongding River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Yongding River burst its banks.

sentences.zh: 江西賊陷饒州。

translations.literal: Jiangxi rebels captured Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels took Raozhou in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，廣東援軍連復江西上猶、雩都，解贛州城圍。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinyou: Guangdong relief troops successively recovered Shangyou and Yudu in Jiangxi and lifted the siege of Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, xinyou, Guangdong troops retook Shangyou and Yudu and raised the siege of Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 王懿德呈進美國國書，得旨：「更換條約，難以准行，仍令回廣東商訂。

translations.literal: Wang Yide presented the American state letter; received the edict: "Treaty replacement is hard to approve; they are still ordered back to Guangdong to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yide presented America's letter; an edict refused treaty replacement and sent negotiators back to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，命總兵張國梁幫辦向榮軍務。

translations.literal: " On day dingmao, Brigadier Zhang Guoliang was ordered to assist Xiang Rong in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed." On dingmao day, Zhang Guoliang joined Xiang Rong's staff.

sentences.zh: 壬申，江西官軍連復南康、饒州。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Jiangxi government troops successively recovered Nankang and Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Jiangxi troops retook Nankang and Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，欽差大臣向榮卒于軍。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Imperial Commissioner Xiang Rong died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Xiang Rong died at the front.

sentences.zh: 丙子，甘肅撒拉回匪滋事，官軍剿平之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Salar Hui rebels in Gansu stirred trouble; government troops suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Salar rebels in Gansu were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 命和春馳赴丹陽剿賊，鄭魁士接辦安徽軍務。

translations.literal: Hechun was ordered to hurry to Danyang to suppress rebels; Zheng Kuishi took over Anhui military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Hechun was sent to Danyang and Zheng Kuishi took Anhui command.

sentences.zh: 湖北援軍克復江西新昌、上高。

translations.literal: Hubei relief troops recovered Xinchang and Shanggao in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei reinforcements retook Xinchang and Shanggao in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 赫特賀奏廓爾喀與唐古忒和成，撤回戍兵。

translations.literal: Hetehe memorialized that Nepal and Tangut Tibet had made peace and garrison troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Hetehe reported peace between Nepal and Tibet and withdrawal of garrisons.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，黃宗漢罷，以吳振棫為四川總督，譚廷襄為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuzi: Huang Zonghan was dismissed; Wu Zhendong was made Sichuan governor-general and Tan Tingxiang Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, wuzi, Huang Zonghan left office; Wu Zhendong became Sichuan governor-general and Tan Tingxiang Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命舒興阿嚴辦回匪，舉行鄉團。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Shuxing'a was ordered strictly to handle Hui rebels and organize local militia.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Shuxing'a was ordered to suppress Hui rebels and raise local militia.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，廣西官軍復上思州、貴縣。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Guangxi government troops recovered Shangsizhou and Guixian.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Guangxi troops retook Shangsizhou and Guixian.

sentences.zh: 丁未，貴州賊陷都勻、施秉，進陷古州。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Guizhou rebels captured Duyun and Shibing and advanced to take Guzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, rebels took Duyun and Shibing in Guizhou and then Guzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，安徽官軍攻克三河。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Anhui government troops captured Sanhe.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Anhui troops took Sanhe.

sentences.zh: 己酉，江西會匪攻陷廣昌、南豐、新昌、瀘溪。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Jiangxi secret-society bandits attacked and captured Guangchang, Nanfeng, Xinchang, and Luxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Jiangxi secret societies took Guangchang, Nanfeng, Xinchang, and Luxi.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon day yimao: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the ninth-month new moon, yimao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊午，京師米貴，開五城飯廠，並撥倉穀制錢賑固安六州縣飢民。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, grain was dear in the capital; soup kitchens were opened in the Five Wards and granary grain and cash were issued for famine relief to hungry people in six prefectures and counties including Gu'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, dear grain in Beijing brought soup kitchens and relief for Gu'an and five other districts.

sentences.zh: 己巳，雲南土匪陷浪穹。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Yunnan bandits captured Langqiong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, bandits took Langqiong in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，江南官軍攻高淳，克之。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Jiangnan government troops attacked Gaochun and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Jiangnan troops took Gaochun.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，安徽官軍復無為州。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Anhui government troops recovered Wuwei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Anhui troops retook Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，文慶等疏進孟保繙譯大學衍義，命校刊頒行。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Wenqing and others presented Meng Bao's translated Great Learning and Its Extensions; an edict ordered collation and distribution.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Wenqing submitted Meng Bao's translation of the Daxue yanyi for publication.

sentences.zh: 壬午，西寧黑番族滋事，提督索文剿平之。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Black Tibetan tribes in Xining stirred trouble; provincial military commissioner Suowen suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Suowen suppressed Black Tibetan unrest near Xining.

sentences.zh: 易棠病免，以樂斌為陝甘總督，有鳳為成都將軍，東純為福州將軍。

translations.literal: Yi Tang was dismissed for illness; Le Bin was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, You Feng Chengdu general, and Dong Chun Fuzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Tang left office; Le Bin became Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general; You Feng and Dong Chun took regional commands.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，貴州賊陷台拱、黃平。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingxu: Guizhou rebels captured Taigong and Huangping.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, bingxu, Guizhou rebels took Taigong and Huangping.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，官文剿襄陽匪徒，平之。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Guan Wen suppressed bandits in Xiangyang and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Guan Wen pacified Xiangyang bandits.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命英桂、秦定三會剿渦河、蒙城捻匪。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Yinggui and Qin Dingsan were ordered jointly to suppress Nien bandits at the Wo River and Mengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Yinggui and Qin Dingsan were sent against Nien bandits on the Wo River and at Mengcheng.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，安徽官軍克復和州。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Anhui government troops recovered Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Anhui troops retook Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 雲南大理回匪戕官踞城。

translations.literal: Yunnan Dali Hui rebels killed officials and seized the city.
translations.idiomatic: Dali Hui rebels in Yunnan killed officials and held the city.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，襄樊賊犯鄧州。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Xiangyang-Fancheng rebels attacked Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Xiang-Fan rebels struck Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 河南賊由夏邑趨擾徐州。

translations.literal: Henan rebels from Xiayi moved to harass Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Henan raiders from Xiayi pressed toward Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，浙江官軍再復休寧。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Zhejiang government troops again recovered Xiuning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Zhejiang forces retook Xiuning.

sentences.zh: 予前巡撫張芾三品卿。

translations.literal: Former governor Zhang Fei was granted third-rank grand secretary rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ex-governor Zhang Fei received third-rank grand secretary rank.

sentences.zh: 丁未，廣西右江鎮標兵變，勞崇光討平之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Right River garrison of Guangxi mutinied; Lao Chongguang suppressed it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Guangxi's Right River garrison mutinied and Lao Chongguang put it down.

sentences.zh: 壬子，何桂清奏浙軍進克黟縣，徽州肅清。

translations.literal: On day renzi, He Guiqing memorialized that Zhejiang troops had taken Yi county and Huizhou was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, He Guiqing reported Yi county taken and Huizhou pacified.

sentences.zh: 邵燦奏官軍擊退捻匪，徐州解圍。

translations.literal: Shao Can memorialized that government troops had beaten back Nian bandits and the siege of Xuzhou was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Can reported Nian bandits driven off and Xuzhou relieved.

sentences.zh: 以常清為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Changqing was made Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: Changqing became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯朔，宣宗實錄成。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon day yimao: the Veritable Record of the Xuanzong Emperor was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon yimao, the Xuanzong Veritable Record was finished.

sentences.zh: 以彭蘊章為大學士，翁心存協辦大學士，許乃普為工部尚書，硃嶟為左都御史。

translations.literal: Peng Yunzhang was made Grand Secretary; Weng Xincun was made cooperating Grand Secretary; Xu Naipu was made Minister of Works; Zhu Yun was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yunzhang became Grand Secretary, Weng Xincun cooperating secretary, Xu Naipu works minister, and Zhu Yun left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，雲南官軍克復姚州。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Yunnan government troops recovered Yao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Yunnan forces retook Yao prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，升文昌入中祀。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Wenchang was promoted to middle sacrifice rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Wenchang was raised to middle sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 命鄭魁士移軍會英桂剿捻匪，秦定三會福濟剿皖匪。

translations.literal: Zheng Kuishi was ordered to move his army to join Ying Gui in suppressing Nian bandits; Qin Dingsan was to join Fu Ji in suppressing Anhui bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Kuishi was sent to join Ying Gui against the Nian, and Qin Dingsan to join Fu Ji against Anhui rebels.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命勝保赴安徽軍營。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Shengbao was ordered to proceed to the Anhui army camp.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Shengbao was ordered to the Anhui front.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大學士文慶卒。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Grand Secretary Wenqing died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Grand Secretary Wenqing died.

sentences.zh: 英人在廣東以查船構釁，放砲攻城。

translations.literal: The English at Guangdong used ship inspection as a pretext for trouble and fired on the city.
translations.idiomatic: At Guangdong the British provoked a clash over ship searches and shelled the city.

sentences.zh: 紳團憤擊之，殲數百人。

translations.literal: Gentry militia angrily attacked them and killed several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Local gentry forces struck back and killed hundreds.

sentences.zh: 敕葉名琛相機辦理。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Ye Mingchen to handle matters as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Mingchen was told to manage the affair as he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命柏葰為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Bo Shu was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Bo Shu joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，江西賊陷撫州。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Jiangxi rebels took Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Jiangxi rebels captured Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，楚軍道員劉長佑連復江西袁州、分宜，加按察使銜，予其父母三品封典，予巡撫駱秉章花翎。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Hunan army circuit intendant Liu Changyou successively recovered Yuanzhou and Fenyi in Jiangxi; he was given the rank of surveillance commissioner, his parents a third-rank enfeoffment patent, and Governor Luo Bingzhang a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Liu Changyou retook Jiangxi's Yuanzhou and Fenyi, received surveillance commissioner rank and honors for his parents, and Luo Bingzhang a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 英桂奏攻破雉河集賊巢。

translations.literal: Ying Gui memorialized that the bandit nest at Zhiheji had been stormed.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Gui reported the Zhiheji bandit lair taken.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上臨大學士文慶第賜奠。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor went in person to Grand Secretary Wenqing's residence to offer condolence sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor personally mourned at Wenqing's home.

sentences.zh: 壬午，胡林翼克復武昌，癸未，官文克復漢陽，均得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Hu Linyi recovered Wuchang; on day guiwei, Guan Wen recovered Hanyang; both received commendatory edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Hu Linyi retook Wuchang and on guiwei Guan Wen retook Hanyang, each praised by edict.

sentences.zh: 貴州軍攻克都勻。

translations.literal: Guizhou troops stormed and took Duyun.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou forces captured Duyun.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，湖北官軍攻克老河口。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiyou: Hubei government troops stormed and took Laohekou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiyou day, Hubei forces took Laohekou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上祈雪。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor prayed for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor prayed for snow.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以肅親王華豐為內大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Prince Su Hua Feng was made inner grand minister.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Prince Su Hua Feng became an inner grand minister.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔曰：「湖北累為賊踞，小民兵燹餘生，瘡痍可念。

translations.literal: On day jichou, an edict said: "Hubei has repeatedly been occupied by bandits; the common soldiers and people, survivors of war and slaughter, bear wounds that call for pity.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the court said: "Hubei has been ravaged by rebels; soldiers and civilians left alive deserve compassion.

sentences.zh: 現在武、漢既復，亟宜援救民瘼。

translations.literal: Now that Wuhan has been recovered, relief for the people's suffering must be urgent.
translations.idiomatic: With Wuhan restored, the people's hardships must be eased at once.

sentences.zh: 錢糧分別蠲緩，災黎作何撫恤，其速籌議以聞。

translations.literal: Grain taxes are to be remitted or deferred by category; how disaster victims are to be comforted—plan quickly and report."
translations.idiomatic: Remit or defer taxes by case and report quickly how the afflicted are to be relieved."

sentences.zh: 」湖北官軍連復武昌縣、黃州府城。

translations.literal: Hubei government troops successively recovered Wuchang county and Huangzhou prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei forces then retook Wuchang county and Huangzhou city.

sentences.zh: 甲午，胡林翼奏陳湖北兵政吏治。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Hu Linyi memorialized on Hubei military affairs and civil administration.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Hu Linyi reported on Hubei army and government.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「既能確有所見，即當實力舉行。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Since you truly have definite views, you should carry them out in earnest."
translations.idiomatic: The court replied: "Where you have clear views, put them into practice."

sentences.zh: 」丙申，官文奏剿辦隨州土匪，匪首就擒。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Guan Wen memorialized on suppressing bandits in Suizhou; the bandit chiefs were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Guan Wen reported Suizhou bandits suppressed and their leaders taken.

sentences.zh: 續報官軍連復興國、大冶、蘄水、蘄州、廣濟。

translations.literal: Further reports said government troops had successively recovered Xingguo, Daye, Qishui, Qizhou, and Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: Further word came that Xingguo, Daye, Qishui, Qizhou, and Guangji had been retaken.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，皖、浙官軍克復寧國，賜何桂清花翎。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Anhui and Zhejiang government troops recovered Ningguo; He Guiqing was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Anhui and Zhejiang forces retook Ningguo and He Guiqing received a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以湖南官軍剿除湖北崇、通賊匪，加候選道王珍按察使銜。

translations.literal: On day guimao, because Hunan government troops had exterminated bandits in Chongyang and Tongcheng, Hubei, candidate circuit intendant Wang Zhen was given surveillance commissioner rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Wang Zhen received surveillance commissioner rank for clearing Chong and Tong bandits in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，官文奏官軍在九江焚毀賊船。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Guan Wen memorialized that government troops at Jiujiang had burned rebel boats.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Guan Wen reported rebel shipping burned at Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 詔曾國籓激厲將士，由湖出江，以便合剿。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zeng Guofan to urge his officers and men to advance from the lake onto the river so that joint suppression might be effected.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was told to drive his forces from the lake to the Yangtze for a combined campaign.

sentences.zh: 戊申，山東官軍剿斃捻首王方雲。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Shandong government troops killed and destroyed Nian chieftain Wang Fangyun.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Shandong forces killed Nian leader Wang Fangyun.

sentences.zh: 湖北官軍克復黃梅。

translations.literal: Hubei government troops recovered Huangmei.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei forces retook Huangmei.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命桂良為大學士，柏葰協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Gui Liang was made Grand Secretary and Bo Shu cooperating Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Gui Liang became Grand Secretary and Bo Shu cooperating secretary.

sentences.zh: 以譚廷襄為直隸總督，曾望顏為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Tan Tingxiang was made Zhili governor-general; Zeng Wangyan was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tingxiang took Zhili and Zeng Wangyan Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day renzi, joint sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the court held joint ancestral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江蘇、山東、山西、河南、湖南、貴州等省一百六十五州縣被災、被賊額賦，又免江蘇六場鹽課各有差。

translations.literal: That year, quota levies were remitted for one hundred sixty-five prefectures and counties in Zhili, Jiangsu, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Hunan, Guizhou, and other provinces stricken by disaster or bandits; Jiangsu's six salterns also had salt levies remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: That year 165 disaster- and bandit-stricken districts in several provinces had taxes remitted, and six Jiangsu salterns received salt-tax relief.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年丁巳春正月庚午，怡良奏傅振邦克復高淳，張國樑進取句容。

translations.literal: Seventh year, day dingsi, spring, first month, day gengwu: Yiliang memorialized that Fu Zhenbang had recovered Gaochun and Zhang Guoliang was advancing on Jurong.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7, spring month 1, gengwu, Yiliang reported Fu Zhenbang's recovery of Gaochun and Zhang Guoliang's advance on Jurong.

sentences.zh: 何桂清奏浙省援剿，內防本境，外保鄰封。

translations.literal: He Guiqing memorialized that Zhejiang was sending relief columns while defending its own territory and protecting neighboring circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He Guiqing reported Zhejiang aiding neighbors while holding its own ground.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: An edict praised and rewarded them.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised and rewarded them.

sentences.zh: 調全慶為兵部尚書，文彩為工部尚書，肅順為左都御史。

translations.literal: Quanqing was transferred as Minister of War; Wencai as Minister of Works; Sushun as Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Quanqing took war, Wencai works, and Sushun the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 廣西太平府土匪平。

translations.literal: Bandits in Taiping prefecture, Guangxi, were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi's Taiping prefecture bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 丙子，召西凌阿、崇安回京。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Xiling'a and Chong'an were recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Xiling'a and Chong'an were recalled.

sentences.zh: 加勝保副都統銜，幫辦剿匪事宜。

translations.literal: Shengbao was given vice censor-in-chief rank to assist in suppressing bandit affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shengbao received vice censor rank to help suppress bandits.

sentences.zh: 王履謙回籍，命李鈞接辦河防。

translations.literal: Wang Lvqian returned to his native place; Li Jun was ordered to take over river defense.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lvqian went home and Li Jun took charge of river defense.

sentences.zh: 己卯，葉名琛奏防剿英夷獲勝。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Ye Mingchen memorialized victory in defending against and suppressing the English.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Ye Mingchen reported victory over the British.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「控制外夷，非內地可比。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Controlling foreign barbarians is not comparable to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: The court said: "Managing foreigners is not like governing inland provinces.

sentences.zh: 定海前事，可取為鑒。

translations.literal: The Dinghai affair of old may serve as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier Dinghai episode should be a warning.

sentences.zh: 其務操縱得宜，勿貽後悔，朕不為遙制也。

translations.literal: You must manipulate matters suitably and not leave regrets; I shall not control you from afar."
translations.idiomatic: Handle them skillfully and avoid regret; I will not micromanage from afar."

sentences.zh: 下蘇、直、閩、浙各督撫知之。

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors of Jiangsu, Zhili, Fujian, and Zhejiang were informed.
translations.idiomatic: The order went to the Jiangsu, Zhili, Fujian, and Zhejiang governors.
So ordered.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，曾國籓奏克復建昌。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou: Zeng Guofan memorialized the recovery of Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiyou day, Zeng Guofan reported Jianchang recovered.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor held court lecture on the classics.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，湖北官軍收復宜昌。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Hubei government troops recovered Yichang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Hubei forces retook Yichang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，雲南賓川回匪作亂。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Yunnan Binchuan Hui bandits rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Hui rebels rose at Yunnan's Binchuan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，湖北賊陷遠安、荊門，官軍擊走之。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Hubei rebels took Yuan'an and Jingmen; government troops drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Hubei rebels seized Yuan'an and Jingmen but were beaten back.

sentences.zh: 丁未，安徽賊匪上犯黃梅，都興阿擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Anhui bandits advanced to attack Huangmei; Du Xing'a defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Anhui rebels pressed Huangmei and Du Xing'a repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 安徽匪陷六安。

translations.literal: Anhui bandits took Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui rebels captured Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 壬子，英桂、勝保奏剿辦捻匪，奪回烏龍集，進規固始。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Ying Gui and Shengbao memorialized on suppressing Nian bandits, recapturing Wulongji, and advancing against Gushi.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Ying Gui and Shengbao reported Nian bandits beaten, Wulongji retaken, and an advance on Gushi.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳朔，曾國籓丁父憂，給假治喪，命楊載福暫統水軍，彭玉麟副之。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon day guisi: Zeng Guofan entered mourning for his father; leave was granted to observe mourning, and Yang Zaifu was ordered temporarily to command the navy with Peng Yulin as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon guisi, Zeng Guofan mourned his father; Yang Zaifu commanded the fleet and Peng Yulin assisted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，湖北官軍唐訓方、巴揚阿剿南彰匪徒，敗之，賊首劉尚義降。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Hubei government troops Tang Xunfang and Bayanga suppressed southern Zhang bandits, defeated them, and bandit chief Liu Shangyi surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Tang Xunfang and Bayanga defeated southern Zhang bandits and Liu Shangyi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 貴州提督孝順兵潰於都勻，死之。

translations.literal: Guizhou provincial commander-in-chief Xiaoshun's troops were routed at Duyun and he died.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou commander Xiaoshun was defeated at Duyun and killed.

sentences.zh: 己未，襄樊賊陷河南內鄉，官軍擊復之。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Xiang-Fan rebels took Neixiang in Henan; government troops struck and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Xiang-Fan rebels took Neixiang but government troops retook it.

sentences.zh: 詔怡良「密查張國樑是否與和春意見不合。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yiliang: "Secretly investigate whether Zhang Guoliang and Hechun are at odds in opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Yiliang was told: "Secretly find out whether Zhang Guoliang and Hechun disagree.

sentences.zh: 軍中統帥，全在能得人心，倘駕馭無方，使健將不肯出力，貽誤非輕」。

translations.literal: Command of an army depends wholly on winning men's hearts; if control is poor and able generals refuse to exert themselves, the harm is no light matter."
translations.idiomatic: An army lives on loyalty; if command fails and good officers hold back, the damage is grave."

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上耕耤田。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Emperor performed the plowing rite.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以耆齡為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Qiling was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Qiling became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敘克復武、漢功，協領多隆阿以副都統用。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, merit in recovering Wuhan was recorded; assistant banner commander Duolong'a was employed as vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Wuhan recovery honors went out and Duolong'a received vice censor rank.

sentences.zh: 辛未，恆春奏回匪滋擾，將領乏員，請調鄖陽鎮總兵王國材來滇協剿，從之。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Hengchun memorialized that Hui rebels were spreading disturbance and commanders were lacking; he asked that Zhenyangguan garrison commander Wang Guocai be transferred to Yunnan to assist suppression, and assent was given.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Hengchun reported Hui unrest and shortage of officers; Wang Guocai was transferred to Yunnan to help.

sentences.zh: 壬申，江西官軍攻景德鎮，不利，都司畢金科戰歿，劉長佑復敗於新喻。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Jiangxi government troops attacked Jingdezhen without success; battalion commander Bi Jinke died in battle, and Liu Changyou was again defeated at Xinyu.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Jiangxi forces failed at Jingdezhen; Bi Jinke fell and Liu Changyou lost again at Xinyu.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，廣西橫州土匪滋事，廣東官軍剿平之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, bandits in Hengzhou, Guangxi, made trouble; Guangdong government troops suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Guangxi Hengzhou bandits rose and Guangdong forces suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 葉名琛奏英船退出省河。

translations.literal: Ye Mingchen memorialized that English ships had withdrawn from the provincial river.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Mingchen reported British ships had left the provincial river.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「總宜弭此釁端，不可使生邊患。

translations.literal: An edict said: "You should always quell this quarrel and must not let border trouble arise."
translations.idiomatic: The court said: "End the quarrel and do not let it become a frontier war."
So ordered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，恆春奏迤西回匪降。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: Hengchun memorialized that western Yunnan Hui bandits had surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiashen day, Hengchun reported western Yunnan Hui rebels had submitted.

sentences.zh: 德勒克多爾濟奏俄國請遣使來京，詔止之。

translations.literal: Deleke duo'erji memorialized that Russia asked to send envoys to the capital; an edict forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: Deleke duo'erji reported a Russian request for envoys to Beijing; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，江西賊竄福建，陷邵武、光澤。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Jiangxi rebels fled into Fujian and took Shaowu and Guangze.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Jiangxi rebels entered Fujian and captured Shaowu and Guangze.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，怡良以病免，命何桂清為兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Yiliang was dismissed for illness; He Guiqing was made Liang-Jiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Yiliang left office for illness and He Guiqing became Liang-Jiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙未，貴州賊陷永從。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Guizhou rebels took Yongcong.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Guizhou rebels captured Yongcong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，湖南援軍劉長佑攻克江西新喻。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Hunan relief army commander Liu Changyou stormed and took Xinyu in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Liu Changyou's Hunan relief force retook Jiangxi's Xinyu.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，薩迎阿卒，以劉鉦署西安將軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen: Saying'a died; Liu Zheng acted as Xi'an general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingchen day, Saying'a died and Liu Zheng acted as Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 湖北官軍克復江西奉新、靖安、安義。

translations.literal: Hubei government troops recovered Fengxin, Jing'an, and Anyi in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei forces retook Jiangxi's Fengxin, Jing'an, and Anyi.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，李孟群奏赴援廬州，克復英山。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Li Mengqun memorialized on going to relieve Luzhou and recovering Yingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Li Mengqun reported marching to Luzhou and retaking Yingshan.

sentences.zh: 福建賊陷汀州。

translations.literal: Fujian rebels took Tingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian rebels captured Tingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，德勒克多爾濟奏俄使由天津來京，敕譚廷襄羈縻之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Deleke duo'erji memorialized that the Russian envoy came to the capital by way of Tianjin; Tan Tingxiang was ordered to detain him tactfully.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Deleke duo'erji reported a Russian envoy via Tianjin; Tan Tingxiang was to detain him diplomatically.

sentences.zh: 閏五月甲申，和春奏克復溧水。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, day jiashen: Hechun memorialized the recovery of Lishui.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, on jiashen day, Hechun reported Lishui recovered.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，曾國籓奏請終制，溫旨留之，仍令迅赴江西視師。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Zeng Guofan memorialized asking to observe full mourning; a warm edict detained him and still ordered him to hurry to Jiangxi to take command.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Zeng Guofan asked for full mourning but was kept in service and told to hurry to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，雲南武定州回匪滋事，官軍剿平之。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Yunnan Wuding prefecture Hui bandits made trouble; government troops suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Hui rebels at Yunnan's Wuding rose and government troops put them down.

sentences.zh: 李孟群奏擊敗霍丘竄賊，得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: Li Mengqun memorialized defeating Huoqiu raiding bandits; an edict praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mengqun reported victory over Huoqiu raiders and received praise.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，勝保攻正陽關，不利，道員金光箸死之，贈布政使。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Shengbao attacked Zhengyang Pass without success; circuit intendant Jin Guangzhu died and was posthumously granted administration commissioner rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Shengbao failed at Zhengyang Pass; Jin Guangzhu was killed and posthumously made administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚子，俄人以兵至海蘭泡，建營安砲，要求通商。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Russians brought troops to Hailanpao, built camps, emplaced artillery, and demanded trade.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Russian troops reached Hailanpao, encamped with guns, and asked to trade.

sentences.zh: 命奕山拒之。

translations.literal: Yishan was ordered to refuse them.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Yishan to turn them away.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，何桂清奏請知府溫紹原復官，辦理六合鄉團。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, He Guiqing memorialized requesting restoration of Prefect Wen Shaoyuan to office to manage the Liuhe local militia.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, He Guiqing asked that Prefect Wen Shaoyuan be restored to run Liuhe militia.

sentences.zh: 詔吉林、黑龍江兵久勞於外，酌量撤回。

translations.literal: An edict said troops of Jilin and Heilongjiang had long labored abroad and were to be withdrawn as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered a measured withdrawal of Jilin and Heilongjiang troops long stationed away.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，慶英奏浩罕勾結回匪，占踞英吉沙爾城，集兵剿之。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Qing Ying memorialized that Kokand had joined with Hui rebels, seized Yingjisha city, and he was gathering troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Qing Ying reported Kokand and Muslim rebels holding Yingjisha and mobilized to crush them.

sentences.zh: 以張國樑為湖南提督。

translations.literal: Zhang Guoliang was made Hunan provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guoliang became Hunan provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，福建官軍收復光澤、汀州，踞匪出竄連城，擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Fujian government troops recovered Guangze and Tingzhou; entrenched rebels fled toward Liancheng and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Fujian troops retook Guangze and Tingzhou and beat rebels fleeing to Liancheng.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，召舒興阿來京，以桑春榮為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: Shu Xing'a was summoned to the capital; Sang Chunrong was made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi day, Shu Xing'a was called to Beijing and Sang Chunrong made Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，福建官軍收復邵武。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Fujian government troops recovered Shaowu.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Fujian troops retook Shaowu.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，江南官軍克復句容，加和春太子少保，賜張國樑黃馬褂。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Jiangnan government troops recovered Jurong; He Chun was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Zhang Guoliang was given a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Jiangnan troops took Jurong; He Chun became Junior Guardian and Zhang Guoliang received a yellow jacket.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，王珍援江西吉安，連戰勝之，賜巴圖魯勇號。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Wang Zhen reinforced Ji'an in Jiangxi, won successive battles, and was given a Baturu valor title.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Wang Zhen relieved Ji'an, won repeatedly, and received a Baturu title.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，河南南陽土匪平。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, bandits in Nanyang, Henan, were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Nanyang bandits in Henan were pacified.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，福建官軍收復泰寧、建寧。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Fujian government troops recovered Taining and Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Fujian troops retook Taining and Jianning.

sentences.zh: 俄夷至天津遞國書，命文謙卻之。

translations.literal: Russian envoys reached Tianjin with a state letter; Wen Qian was ordered to reject them.
translations.idiomatic: Russian envoys brought credentials to Tianjin and Wen Qian was told to refuse them.

sentences.zh: 永定河決。

translations.literal: The Yongding River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River broke through.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，雲南回匪犯省城，恆春自盡。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Yunnan Hui rebels attacked the provincial city and Hengchun killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yunnan Muslim rebels struck the capital and Hengchun committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 事聞，調吳振棫為雲貴總督，以王慶雲為四川總督，恆福為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: When word came, Wu Zhenzhang was transferred as Yun-Gui governor-general, Wang Qingyun as Sichuan governor-general, and Hengfu as Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On report, Wu Zhenzhang took Yun-Gui, Wang Qingyun Sichuan, and Hengfu Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 丙子，江西官軍收復龍泉。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Jiangxi government troops recovered Longquan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Jiangxi troops retook Longquan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命許乃釗幫辦江南軍務，張亮基予五品銜，幫辦雲南剿匪事宜。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Xu Naizhao was ordered to assist Jiangnan military affairs; Zhang Liangji was given fifth-rank status to assist Yunnan bandit suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Xu Naizhao joined Jiangnan command and Zhang Liangji received fifth rank for Yunnan suppression.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，李孟群奏收復霍山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yiyou: Li Mengqun memorialized recovery of Huoshan.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, on yiyou day, Li Mengqun reported Huoshan recovered.

sentences.zh: 己丑，河南官軍收復鄧州。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Henan government troops recovered Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Henan troops retook Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命奕山會集俄使勘定黑龍江兩岸邊界。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Yishan was ordered to assemble the Russian envoy to survey and fix the boundaries on both banks of the Amur.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Yishan was told to meet Russian envoys to demarcate both banks of the Amur.

sentences.zh: 甲午，貴州官軍收復錦屏。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Guizhou government troops recovered Jinping.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Guizhou troops retook Jinping.

sentences.zh: 湖北官軍攻剿黃梅大勝，總兵王國材力戰陣歿，贈提督，賜恤建祠。

translations.literal: Hubei government troops attacked Huangmei with a great victory; overall commander Wang Guocai fought fiercely and died in battle, was posthumously made provincial commander, and granted condolence payments and an official temple.
translations.idiomatic: At Huangmei Hubei troops won heavily; Wang Guocai died fighting and was posthumously promoted with rites and a temple.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命都興阿幫辦官文軍務。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Duxing'a was ordered to assist Guanwen in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Duxing'a was assigned to help Guanwen.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou, first day of the month: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiyou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬子，福建官軍收復寧化。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Fujian government troops recovered Ninghua.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Fujian troops retook Ninghua.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，江西官軍克復瑞州。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Jiangxi government troops recovered Ruizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Jiangxi troops retook Ruizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，法福理奏克復英吉沙爾回城，解漢城圍。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Fafuli memorialized recovery of the Muslim city of Yingjisha and relief of the siege of Hancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Fafuli reported Yingjisha Muslim city recovered and Hancheng relieved.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，官文、胡林翼奏湖北全境肅清。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Guanwen and Hu Linyi memorialized that all Hubei was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Guanwen and Hu Linyi reported all Hubei cleared.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「胡林翼親督所部攻克小池口賊城，即乘此聲威規復九江，以振全局。
