translations.literal: An edict said: "Hu Linyi personally commanded his forces in capturing the rebel city of Xiaochikou; riding this prestige he should plan recovery of Jiujiang to revive the overall situation.
translations.idiomatic: The throne said Hu Linyi's capture of Xiaochikou should be used to recover Jiujiang and revive the whole front.

sentences.zh: 」先是，林翼密奏欲保鄂省而復金陵，惟有先取九江，次復安慶，始握要領，故明詔從之。

translations.literal: "Previously Hu Linyi had memorialized confidentially that to secure Hubei and recover Jinling one must first take Jiujiang, then recover Anqing—that is grasping the essentials; hence the explicit edict followed his view."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Hu Linyi had urged Jiujiang then Anqing to save Hubei and Nanjing, and the edict followed him.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰，湖南援贛道員王珍卒于軍，贈布政使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengchen: Hunan relief circuit intendant for Ganzhou, Wang Zhen, died in camp and was posthumously made provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengchen day, relief commander Wang Zhen died in Jiangxi service and was posthumously made administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，勝保奏克復正陽關，又奏鳳台生員苗沛霖藉團聚眾。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Sheng Bao memorialized recovery of Zhengyang Pass and also that Fengtai licentiate Miao Peilin was gathering crowds under militia pretense.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Sheng Bao reported Zhengyang Pass taken and warned Miao Peilin was rallying men as militia.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「正當示之不疑，藉消反側。

translations.literal: An edict said: "One should show no suspicion and use him to calm restiveness."
translations.idiomatic: The court said to trust him and calm unrest.

sentences.zh: 」丙戌，法福理奏收復喀什噶爾回城。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Fafuli memorialized recovery of the Kashgar Muslim city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Fafuli reported Kashgar Muslim city recovered.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，湖北賊陷舒城。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Hubei rebels took Shucheng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, rebels took Shucheng in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 河南捻匪陷南陽。

translations.literal: Henan Nian rebels took Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Nian bandits took Nanyang in Henan.

sentences.zh: 丙申，江西官軍克復東鄉。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Jiangxi government troops recovered Dongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Jiangxi troops retook Dongxiang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，湖南援黔官軍克復黎平。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Hunan relief troops for Guizhou recovered Liping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Hunan relief troops retook Liping in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申朔，官文、胡林翼奏，李續賓等水陸齊進，攻克江西湖口縣城。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wushen, first day of the month: Guanwen and Hu Linyi memorialized that Li Xubin and others advanced by land and water and captured Hukou county in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, on the wushen new moon, Guanwen and Hu Linyi reported Li Xubin took Jiangxi Hukou by land and water.

sentences.zh: 勝保、袁甲三奏，總兵硃連泰、史榮椿等攻剿捻匪，平毀韓圩賊巢。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao and Yuan Jiasan memorialized that overall commanders Zhu Liantai, Shi Rongchun, and others attacked Nian bandits and leveled the Hanwei rebel nest.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao and Yuan Jiasan reported Zhu Liantai and Shi Rongchun destroyed Nian nests at Hanwei.

sentences.zh: 蔣霨遠、佟攀梅奏，剿辦苗匪、教匪，斬擒多名，都勻賊退。

translations.literal: Jiang Yunzhi and Tong Panmei memorialized that in suppressing Miao and religious rebels many were beheaded or captured and Duyun rebels withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Yunzhi and Tong Panmei reported Miao and sect rebels cut down and Duyun rebels driven back.

sentences.zh: 河南官軍敗賊於南召，進剿裕州、泌陽餘匪。

translations.literal: Henan government troops defeated rebels at Nanzhao and advanced to mop up remnants at Yuzhou and Biyang.
translations.idiomatic: Henan troops beat rebels at Nanzhao and pursued remnants at Yuzhou and Biyang.

sentences.zh: 己未，李孟群剿捻匪於獨山，不利，兵潰。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Li Mengqun suppressed Nian bandits at Dushan unsuccessfully; his troops collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Li Mengqun failed against Nian at Dushan and his force broke.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，湖北援軍李續賓等攻克彭澤。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Hubei relief forces under Li Xubin and others captured Pengze.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Li Xubin's Hubei relief force took Pengze.

sentences.zh: 廣西官軍收復南寧。

translations.literal: Guangxi government troops recovered Nanning.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi government troops retook Nanning.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，胡林翼奏漕糧積弊，請改章徵收，以濟軍需，從之。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Hu Linyi memorialized accumulated abuses in grain transport tax and requested reform of collection to fund military needs; assented.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Hu Linyi won assent to reform transport grain levies for the army.

sentences.zh: 庚午，河南賊入武勝關，直撲商南，陝西官軍擊走之。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Henan rebels entered Wusheng Pass and rushed toward Shangnan; Shaanxi government troops drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Henan rebels broke through Wusheng Pass toward Shangnan and Shaanxi troops repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以楊載福為福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Yang Zaifu was made Fujian land forces provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Yang Zaifu became Fujian land commander.

sentences.zh: 以李續賓為浙江布政使。

translations.literal: Li Xubin was made Zhejiang administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xubin became Zhejiang administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅朔，英桂奏德楞泰敗賊於盧氏，邱聯恩敗賊於淅川。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin, first day of the month: Yinggui memorialized Deling defeated rebels at Lushi and Qiu Lian'en defeated rebels at Xichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the wuyin new moon, Yinggui reported victories at Lushi and Xichuan.

sentences.zh: 安徽賊陷和州、霍山。

translations.literal: Anhui rebels took Hezhou and Huoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui rebels took Hezhou and Huoshan.

sentences.zh: 楊載福克復望江、東流、銅陵。

translations.literal: Yang Zaifu recovered Wangjiang, Dongliu, and Tongling.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaifu retook Wangjiang, Dongliu, and Tongling.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，駱秉章奏蔣益澧、江忠濬援剿廣西，連戰獲勝，進圍平樂。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Luo Bingzhang memorialized Jiang Yizao and Jiang Zhongjun aided Guangxi suppression with successive victories and were besieging Pingle.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Luo Bingzhang reported Jiang Yizao and Jiang Zhongjun winning in Guangxi and besieging Pingle.

sentences.zh: 戊子，胡林翼疏薦布衣萬斛泉、宋鼎、鄒金粟等。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Hu Linyi memorialized recommending commoners Wan Huquan, Song Ding, Zou Jinshu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Hu Linyi recommended commoners Wan Huquan, Song Ding, and Zou Jinshu.

sentences.zh: 甲午，廓爾喀奉表輸誠，頒賞珍物。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Gurkha presented tribute in sincere submission and was bestowed precious gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Nepal sent loyal tribute and received imperial gifts.

sentences.zh: 丙申，德興阿等奏克復瓜州。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Dexing'a and others memorialized recovery of Guazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Dexing'a reported Guazhou recovered.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉勉，賜雙眼花翎、騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: An edict praised and rewarded them; double-eyed peacock feather and hereditary Chariot Commandant rank were granted.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised them with double peacock feathers and hereditary Chariot Commandant rank.

sentences.zh: 翁同書以侍郎用，鞠殿華加提督銜。

translations.literal: Weng Tonghe was employed as vice minister; Ju Dianhua was given provincial commander status.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Tonghe joined as vice minister and Ju Dianhua received commander status.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，和春奏同張國樑克復鎮江，賜和春雙眼花翎、輕車都尉世職，張國樑騎都尉世職，何桂清太子太保。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, He Chun memorialized that with Zhang Guoliang he recovered Zhenjiang; He Chun received double peacock feather and hereditary Light Chariot Commandant, Zhang Guoliang hereditary Chariot Commandant, and He Guiqing Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, He Chun and Zhang Guoliang retook Zhenjiang; He Chun received double peacock feathers and Light Chariot Commandant succession, Zhang Guoliang Chariot Commandant succession, He Guiqing Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚子，英桂奏敗賊於汝州，豫西肅清。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Yinggui memorialized defeat of rebels at Ruzhou and pacification of western Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Yinggui reported victory at Ruzhou and western Henan cleared.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，永定河合龍。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Yongding River was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Yongding River breach was closed.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，耆齡奏曾國荃攻克吉水。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: Qiling memorialized Zeng Guoquan captured Jishui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinhai day, Qiling reported Zeng Guoquan took Jishui.

sentences.zh: 駱秉章、勞崇光會奏官軍攻克平樂。

translations.literal: Luo Bingzhang and Lao Chongguang jointly memorialized government troops captured Pingle.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Bingzhang and Lao Chongguang jointly reported Pingle taken.

sentences.zh: 廣西賊陷慶遠。

translations.literal: Guangxi rebels took Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi rebels took Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，督辦三省剿匪副都統勝保奏請皖兵悉歸節制。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Associate Grand Councilor in charge of suppressing bandits in three provinces, Sheng Bao, memorialized requesting all Anhui troops be placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Sheng Bao asked that all Anhui troops answer to him.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「勝保尚屬勇敢，若平其躁氣，斂其驕心，可為有用之材，何庸自行凟请。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Sheng Bao is still brave; if he calms his rashness and checks his arrogance he can be useful—why need he himself presumptuously petition?"
translations.idiomatic: The throne said Sheng Bao could serve if he curbed rash pride and need not petition for command.

sentences.zh: 」庚申，英人入廣東省城，劫總督葉名琛以去。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, English entered the Guangdong provincial city and seized Governor Ye Mingchen and took him away.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the British entered Guangzhou and abducted Governor Ye Mingchen.

sentences.zh: 詔革名琛職，以黃宗漢為兩廣總督，柏貴署理。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Ye Mingchen of office; Huang Zonghan was made Liang-Guang governor-general and Bo Gui acted in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Mingchen was dismissed; Huang Zonghan became Liang-Guang governor-general with Bo Gui acting.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，李孟群奏粵、捻合股東竄，偪近商、固。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Li Mengqun memorialized Guangdong and Nian bandits joined in an eastern thrust pressing Shang and Gu.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Li Mengqun warned Cantonese and Nian rebels were thrusting east toward Shang and Gu.

sentences.zh: 命勝保嚴防之。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao was ordered to guard strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao was ordered to block them firmly.

sentences.zh: 丙子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the combined seasonal worship was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the court held seasonal temple rites.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、江蘇、山東、山西、河南、陝西、湖南、廣西等省二百三十五廳州縣衛，廣西四土縣被災、被賊額賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, land tax was remitted in varying degrees for 235 departments, districts, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Jiangsu, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Shaanxi, Hunan, Guangxi, and other provinces, and for four indigenous districts of Guangxi stricken by disaster or rebels.
translations.idiomatic: That year tax was forgiven in 235 units across several provinces and four Guangxi indigenous districts hit by disaster or rebels.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 八年戊午春正月己卯，佟攀梅罷，以蔣玉龍為貴州提督。

translations.literal: Eighth year, day wuwu, spring, first month, day jimao: Tong Panmei was dismissed; Jiang Yulong was made Guizhou provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Xianfeng 8, spring, month 1, jimao: Tong Panmei left office and Jiang Yulong became Guizhou commander.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，敕王懿德籌備海防。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Wang Yide was ordered to prepare coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Wang Yide was told to ready coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，江西官軍收復臨江。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Jiangxi government troops recovered Linjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Jiangxi troops retook Linjiang.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，官軍克復秣陵關，進圍金陵，加和春太子太保，張國樑雙眼花翎，陣亡總兵虎坤元優恤世職。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengwu: government troops recovered Moling Pass and advanced to besiege Jinling; He Chun was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, Zhang Guoliang given double peacock feather, and fallen overall commander Hu Kunyuan generously granted hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, on gengwu day, troops took Moling Pass and besieged Nanjing; He Chun became Grand Guardian, Zhang Guoliang received double peacock feathers, and Hu Kunyuan's heirs were honored.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑朔，勝保奏剿賊獲勝，固始解圍。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou, first day of the month: Sheng Bao memorialized victories in bandit suppression and relief of Gushi siege.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, on the dingchou new moon, Sheng Bao reported wins and Gushi relieved.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: An edict praised and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，俄船至天津。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Russian ships reached Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Russian ships reached Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 敕譚廷襄防堵。

translations.literal: Tan Tingxiang was ordered to block them.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tingxiang was ordered to stop them.

sentences.zh: 癸未，江北官軍克復江浦，道員溫紹原復官。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, northern Jiang government troops recovered Jiangpu and Circuit Intendant Wen Shaoyuan was restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, northern Jiang troops retook Jiangpu and Wen Shaoyuan was restored.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，福濟奏收復和州。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Fu Ji memorialized recovery of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Fu Ji reported Hezhou recovered.

sentences.zh: 貴州賊陷都勻，前提督佟攀梅死之。

translations.literal: Guizhou rebels took Duyun and former provincial commander Tong Panmei died.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou rebels took Duyun and ex-commander Tong Panmei was killed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午朔，譚廷襄奏俄人不守興安舊約，請以烏蘇里河、綏芬河為界，使臣仍請進京。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingwu, first day of the month: Tan Tingxiang memorialized Russians were not observing the old Xing'an treaty and requested the Ussuri and Suifen rivers as boundary while envoys still asked to enter the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, on the bingwu new moon, Tan Tingxiang said Russia ignored Xing'an, sought Ussuri and Suifen boundaries, and envoys still wanted Beijing.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「分界已派大員會勘，使臣非時不得入京，駁之。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Boundary demarcation has already been assigned to high officials for joint survey; envoys may not enter the capital out of season—reject them."
translations.idiomatic: The throne said demarcation was under appointed commissioners and off-season envoys must be refused.

sentences.zh: 」丁未，江西賊竄入福建，陷政和、松谿。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Jiangxi rebels entered Fujian and took Zhenghe and Songxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Jiangxi rebels entered Fujian and took Zhenghe and Songxi.

sentences.zh: 戊申，俄人請由陸路往來，英人、法人請隔數年進京一次，詔不許。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Russians requested overland travel; English and French requested entry to the capital once every several years; edict did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Russia asked inland passage and Britain and France periodic Beijing entry; all were denied.

sentences.zh: 勝保奏捻首李兆受乞降，許之。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao memorialized Nian leader Li Zhaoshou begged surrender; permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao reported Li Zhaoshou's surrender and it was accepted.

sentences.zh: 己酉，安徽賊陷麻城，另股陷蒙、亳、懷、宿，詔袁甲三剿之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Anhui rebels took Macheng while another band took Meng, Bo, Huai, and Su; Yuan Jiasan was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Anhui rebels took Macheng and other points; Yuan Jiasan was sent against them.

sentences.zh: 詔許俄之通商，不許進京。

translations.literal: An edict permitted Russian trade but not entry to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Trade with Russia was allowed but not embassy entry to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賊陷和州。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, rebels took Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, rebels retook Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 雲南大理回匪陷順寧。

translations.literal: Dali Muslim rebels in Yunnan took Shunning.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Dali Muslims took Shunning.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔譚廷襄告知英人、法人，減稅增市，俟之粵事結日，彼時再議來京。

translations.literal: On day wushen, an edict ordered Tan Tingxiang to inform English and French that taxes would be reduced and markets expanded, to wait until Cantonese affairs were settled before discussing coming to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Tan Tingxiang was told to offer Britain and France lower duties and more ports after Guangdong affairs ended.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，江西賊陷常山、開化，命總兵周天受加提督銜，專辦浙防，道員饒廷選防守衢州。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Jiangxi rebels took Changshan and Kaihua; overall commander Zhou Tianshou was given provincial commander status dedicated to Zhejiang defense, and circuit intendant Rao Tingxuan was to defend Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Jiangxi rebels took Changshan and Kaihua; Zhou Tianshou received commander status for Zhejiang and Rao Tingxuan held Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，譚廷襄呈進美國國書，詔許減稅率、增口岸，仍不許入京。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Tan Tingxiang presented the American state letter; edict permitted reduced tax rates and additional treaty ports but still did not permit entry to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Tan Tingxiang presented US credentials; reduced duties and more ports were allowed but not Beijing entry.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，英、法兵船入大沽，官軍退守。

translations.literal: On day yimao, British and French warships entered Dagukou; government troops withdrew to defend.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Anglo-French warships entered the Dagu forts and Qing forces fell back.

sentences.zh: 命僧格林沁備兵通州。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen was ordered to prepare troops at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen was told to ready forces at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，江西官軍復雩都、樂安、崇化、宜黃。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Jiangxi government troops recovered Yudu, Le'an, Chonghua, and Yihuang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Jiangxi forces retook Yudu, Le'an, Chonghua, and Yihuang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，英、法船抵津關。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, English and French ships reached the Tientsin passes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Anglo-French vessels arrived at the Tientsin barrier.

sentences.zh: 命大學士桂良、尚書花沙納往辦夷務。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Guiliang and Minister Huashana were ordered to go handle barbarian affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Guiliang and Huashana were sent to manage foreign affairs.

sentences.zh: 江西賊竄浙江，陷處州及永康。

translations.literal: Jiangxi rebels fled into Zhejiang and took Chuzhou and Yongkang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi rebels crossed into Zhejiang and captured Chuzhou and Yongkang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，湖北官軍克復九江，加官文、胡林翼太子少保，李續賓加巡撫銜。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Hubei government troops recovered Jiujiang; Guanwen and Hu Linyi were advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Li Xubin was given acting governor rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Hubei forces retook Jiujiang; Guanwen and Hu Linyi became Junior Guardians of the Heir Apparent, and Li Xubin received acting governor rank.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，英、法兵退三汊河，與俄、美來文，請求議事大臣須有全權便宜行事，始可開議。

translations.literal: On day yichou, English and French troops withdrew to San Cha He; Russia and America sent letters requesting that negotiating ministers must have full discretionary authority before talks could open.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Anglo-French forces pulled back to San Cha He; Russian and American letters insisted plenipotentiaries with full discretion were needed before negotiations could begin.

sentences.zh: 桂良等以聞，詔許便宜行事。

translations.literal: Guiliang and others reported it; an edict permitted discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: Guiliang reported in and the court authorized discretionary powers.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命僧格林沁佩帶欽差大臣關防，辦理防務。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Sengge Rinchen was ordered to wear the Imperial Commissioner seal and handle defense affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Sengge Rinchen was given the Imperial Commissioner seal to manage coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，勝保奏克復六安。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Sengbao memorialized recovery of Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Sengbao reported the recapture of Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，敕各省軍營挑練馬隊。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an edict ordered military camps in each province to select and train cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, every provincial camp was told to pick and drill mounted units.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命和春兼辦浙江軍務。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, He Chun was ordered concurrently to handle Zhejiang military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, He Chun was also put in charge of Zhejiang operations.

sentences.zh: 英船開出大沽。

translations.literal: English ships departed from Dagu.
translations.idiomatic: British vessels left Dagu.

sentences.zh: 桂良等奏英人之約於鎮江、漢口通商，長江行輪，擇地設立領事，國使駐京。

translations.literal: Guiliang and others memorialized that the English treaty provided for trade at Zhenjiang and Hankou, steam navigation on the Yangtze, consuls at chosen sites, and envoys resident in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Guiliang reported English terms for Zhenjiang and Hankou trade, Yangtze steamers, consular posts, and ministers resident in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 上久而許之。

translations.literal: After a long delay the Emperor assented.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor finally approved.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，皖匪陷湖北黃安。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingzi: Anhui bandits took Huang'an in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingzi day, Anhui rebels seized Huang'an in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 桂良、花沙納奏，英使堅偪立約，不見耆英。

translations.literal: Guiliang and Huashana memorialized that the English envoy pressed hard to conclude a treaty and would not see Qiying.
translations.idiomatic: Guiliang and Huashana reported the English minister insisting on a treaty and refusing to meet Qiying.

sentences.zh: 耆英請回京，詔止之。

translations.literal: Qiying requested to return to the capital; an edict forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: Qiying asked to go back to Beijing and was ordered to stay.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，捻匪陷懷遠。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Nian bandits took Huaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Nian rebels captured Huaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，奕山奏請黑龍江左岸曠地割畀俄人。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Yishan memorialized requesting cession of vacant lands on the left bank of the Heilongjiang to the Russians.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Yishan asked to cede vacant Heilongjiang left-bank lands to Russia.

sentences.zh: 甲申，桂良等奏俄允代轉圜，先允俄人陸行。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Guiliang and others memorialized that Russia agreed to mediate; the Russians' overland passage was granted first.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Guiliang reported Russian mediation and prior approval of Russian overland travel.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命廷臣集議和戰二者，兩害取其輕。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, court ministers were ordered to deliberate on peace and war and choose the lesser of two harms.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, ministers were told to weigh peace against war and take the lesser evil.

sentences.zh: 戊子，桂良等奏英人謂我徒事遷延，即棄和言戰。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Guiliang and others memorialized that the English said China was merely delaying and would abandon peace and speak of war.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Guiliang reported the English warning that delay meant abandoning talks for war.

sentences.zh: 大學士裕誠卒，上親臨賜奠。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Yucheng died; the Emperor personally attended to bestow funeral offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Yucheng died and the Emperor attended the funeral rites in person.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，桂良等奏進英、法訂約五十一款，並請先訂俄、美條約。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Guiliang and others memorialized presenting the fifty-one-article English-French treaty and asked to conclude Russian and American treaties first.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Guiliang submitted the fifty-one-clause Anglo-French treaty and urged Russian and American treaties first.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，湖北官軍復黃安、麻城。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Hubei government troops recovered Huang'an and Macheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Hubei forces retook Huang'an and Macheng.

sentences.zh: 福建官軍復光澤。

translations.literal: Fujian government troops recovered Guangze.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian forces recaptured Guangze.

sentences.zh: 廣東官軍復廣西梧州。

translations.literal: Guangdong government troops recovered Wuzhou in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong forces retook Wuzhou in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 敕耆齡檄調蕭啟江、張運蘭、王開化各軍由祁門進援浙江。

translations.literal: Qiling was ordered by dispatch to mobilize the armies of Xiao Qijiang, Zhang Yunlan, and Wang Kaihua from Qimen to advance in relief of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Qiling was told to move Xiao Qijiang, Zhang Yunlan, and Wang Kaihua from Qimen to reinforce Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，耆英擅回京，賜自盡。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Qiying returned to the capital without authorization and was ordered to commit suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Qiying left his post for Beijing without leave and was ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 太傅杜堮卒，上親臨賜奠。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor Du Kun died; the Emperor personally attended to bestow funeral offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Du Kun died and the Emperor attended the funeral rites in person.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命曾國籓辦理浙江軍務。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Zeng Guofan was ordered to handle Zhejiang military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Zeng Guofan was put in charge of Zhejiang operations.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，桂良、花沙納奏進俄、美、英、法四國條約。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Guiliang and Huashana memorialized presenting the treaties of Russia, America, England, and France.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Guiliang and Huashana submitted the Russian, American, English, and French treaties.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「既巳蓋用關防，今復硃批依議，宜示四國照此辦理。

translations.literal: Receiving the rescript: "The seals have already been affixed; now the vermillion endorsement approves as deliberated; the four powers should be shown to proceed accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: The rescript read: "Seals are already applied; the vermillion endorsement now approves as discussed; inform all four powers to act accordingly.

sentences.zh: 至通商稅則，在上海議之。

translations.literal: As for commercial tax schedules, they will be discussed at Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Commercial tariffs will be negotiated at Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 」庚子，江北官軍克復江浦、來安。

translations.literal: "On day gengzi, Jiangbei government troops recovered Jiangpu and Lai'an.
translations.idiomatic: "On gengzi day, Jiangbei forces retook Jiangpu and Lai'an.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，夷船全數退出內河。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, all barbarian ships withdrew from the inner rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, every foreign vessel left the inland waterways.

sentences.zh: 命吏部侍郎匡源、內閣學士文祥在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Kuang Yuan and Hanlin Academician Wen Xiang were ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Kuang Yuan and Wen Xiang were added to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，命桂良、花沙納、侍郎基溥、武備院卿明善前往江蘇會議通商稅則。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: Guiliang, Huashana, Vice Minister Jipu, and Wubeiyuan Director Mingshan were ordered to Jiangsu to confer on commercial tax schedules.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiyou day, Guiliang, Huashana, Jipu, and Mingshan were sent to Jiangsu to negotiate trade tariffs.

sentences.zh: 江西官軍復新城、金谿。

translations.literal: Jiangxi government troops recovered Xincheng and Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi forces retook Xincheng and Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，福建匪陷建寧。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Fujian bandits took Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Fujian rebels seized Jianning.

sentences.zh: 福興罷，以周天受統其軍赴援福建。

translations.literal: Fuxing was dismissed; Zhou Tianshou was placed in command of his army to go relieve Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Fuxing was removed and Zhou Tianshou took his troops to aid Fujian.

sentences.zh: 召桑春榮來京，以張亮基為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Sang Chunrong was summoned to the capital; Zhang Liangji was made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Sang Chunrong was called to Beijing and Zhang Liangji became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，廣西軍復象州。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Guangxi troops recovered Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Guangxi forces retook Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，浙江賊陷壽昌，官軍尋復之。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Zhejiang rebels took Shouchang; government troops soon recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Zhejiang rebels captured Shouchang but government forces soon took it back.

sentences.zh: 福濟以不職，奪宮銜，解任。

translations.literal: Fu Ji was stripped of rank and removed for malfeasance.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Ji lost his rank and office for neglect of duty.

sentences.zh: 以翁同書為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Weng Tongshu was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Tongshu became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，論天津失事狀，譚廷襄解任，提督張殿元遣戍。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Tianjin disaster was deliberated; Tan Tingxiang was removed and Commander Zhang Dianyuan was banished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Tianjin debacle was reviewed; Tan Tingxiang was dismissed and Zhang Dianyuan banished.

sentences.zh: 以慶祺為直隸總督，玉明為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Qing Qi was made Zhili governor-general and Yu Ming was made Mukden general.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Qi took Zhili and Yu Ming became Mukden general.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，福建道員趙印川剿匪，死之。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Fujian circuit intendant Zhao Yinchuan suppressed bandits and died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Fujian intendant Zhao Yinchuan died fighting bandits.

sentences.zh: 浙江官軍復常山、開化。

translations.literal: Zhejiang government troops recovered Changshan and Kaihua.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang forces retook Changshan and Kaihua.

sentences.zh: 江西援軍復浙江武義、永康、衢州，紹興城圍解嚴。

translations.literal: Jiangxi relief troops recovered Wuyi, Yongkang, and Quzhou in Zhejiang; the siege alert at Shaoxing was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi reinforcements retook Wuyi, Yongkang, and Quzhou and eased the Shaoxing siege.

sentences.zh: 瑞麟請籌款修築天津營壘砲台，下僧格林沁辦理。

translations.literal: Ruilin requested funds to build Tianjin camps and batteries; the matter was referred to Sengge Rinchen.
translations.idiomatic: Ruilin asked for money to fortify Tianjin and the task went to Sengge Rinchen.

sentences.zh: 辛未，俄人請停辦驛站羊只，詔庫倫大臣援舊事拒之。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Russians requested halting station sheep levies; an edict told the Kuren minister to refuse citing precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Russia sought an end to relay-station sheep dues and Kuren was told to refuse on precedent.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賞刑部員外郎段承實五品卿銜，幫辦會議稅則。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Vice Director of Punishments Duan Chengshi was granted fifth-rank noble rank to assist in conferring on tax schedules.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Duan Chengshi of the Ministry of Punishments received fifth-rank rank to help negotiate tariffs.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓奏由九江登陸赴浙，詔嘉勉之。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan memorialized landing from Jiujiang to proceed to Zhejiang; an edict praised and encouraged him.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan reported marching inland from Jiujiang toward Zhejiang and was praised by edict.

sentences.zh: 浙江軍復縉雲。

translations.literal: Zhejiang troops recovered Jinyun.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang forces retook Jinyun.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌朔，奕山、景淳奏俄人闖越黑河口，欲入松花江，於烏蘇里建屋安砲。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiaxu new moon: Yishan and Jingchun memorialized that Russians crossed the Hei River mouth intending to enter the Songhua and were building houses and emplacing guns on the Ussuri.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, jiaxu new moon, Yishan and Jingchun reported Russians crossing the Hei estuary toward the Songhua and building fortified posts on the Ussuri.

sentences.zh: 詔勘明吉、黑地界，據理拒絕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered demarcation of Jilin and Heilongjiang borders and reasonable refusal.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Jilin and Heilongjiang boundaries surveyed and a justified refusal.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以李孟群署安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Li Mengqun was made acting Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Li Mengqun became acting Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，從法福理請，升喀什噶爾領隊大臣為辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, at the French envoy Favier's request, the Kashgar commandant was promoted to commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Kashgar's commandant was raised to commissioner at French envoy Favier's request.

sentences.zh: 周天受攻復浙江處州，移軍福建。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianshou attacked and recovered Chuzhou in Zhejiang, then moved his army to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tianshou retook Zhejiang's Chuzhou and shifted his army to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔曾國籓衢、嚴肅清，改援福建。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, an edict ordered Zeng Guofan to clear Quzhou and Yanzhou and shift relief to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Zeng Guofan was told to secure Qu and Yan and redirect aid to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，楊載福收復安徽建德。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Yang Zaifu recovered Jiande in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Yang Zaifu retook Jiande in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，湖北巡撫胡林翼丁母憂，詔在任守制，給假、給銀治喪。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Hubei Governor Hu Linyi entered mourning for his mother; an edict permitted mourning in office with leave and silver for the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Hu Linyi of Hubei began mourning for his mother; the court let him stay in post with leave and funeral funds.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賊陷廬州，李孟群奪職留軍，以勝保為欽差大臣，督辦安徽軍務，袁甲三援剿三省捻匪。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, rebels took Luzhou; Li Mengqun was dismissed but kept with the army; Sengbao was made Imperial Commissioner to supervise Anhui military affairs; Yuan Jiasan aided in suppressing Nian bandits in three provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, rebels seized Luzhou; Li Mengqun was demoted but kept in the field; Sengbao became Imperial Commissioner for Anhui; Yuan Jiasan helped fight Nian rebels in three provinces.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，福建軍復建陽、光澤，賊陷寧化。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Fujian forces recovered Jianyang and Guangze; rebels took Ninghua.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Fujian retook Jianyang and Guangze while rebels took Ninghua.

sentences.zh: 庚子，召晏端書來京，以胡興仁為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Yan Duanshu was summoned to the capital; Hu Xingren was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Yan Duanshu was called to Beijing and Hu Xingren became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，張芾軍復龍泉，賜花翎。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Zhang Fu's army recovered Longquan and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Zhang Fu retook Longquan and received the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯朔，復設天津水師。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao new moon: the Tianjin naval division was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guimao new moon, the Tianjin fleet was restored.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，福建軍復政和、松谿。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Fujian forces recovered Zhenghe and Songxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Fujian retook Zhenghe and Songxi.

sentences.zh: 勝保奏發逆偽英王陳玉成竄店埠、梁園，直撲定遠。

translations.literal: Sengbao memorialized that the Taiping false King of Ying Chen Yucheng fled to Dianbu and Liangyuan and drove straight at Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbao reported the rebel King of Ying Chen Yucheng at Dianbu and Liangyuan striking toward Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，李定太剿賊玉山，勝之，解其圍。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Li Dingtai suppressed bandits at Yushan, defeated them, and lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Li Dingtai beat rebels at Yushan and raised the siege.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，蔣益澧援軍復廣西慶遠，擢按察使。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Jiang Yili's relief army recovered Qingyuan in Guangxi; he was promoted to surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Jiang Yili's reinforcements retook Qingyuan in Guangxi and he became surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，周天受援福建，克復浦城，進克寧化。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Zhou Tianshou relieved Fujian, recovered Pucheng, and advanced to recover Ninghua.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Zhou Tianshou aided Fujian, took Pucheng, and then Ninghua.

sentences.zh: 捻匪陷豐縣。

translations.literal: Nian bandits took Feng county.
translations.idiomatic: Nian rebels captured Feng county.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，捻匪竄山東，陷單縣。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Nian bandits fled into Shandong and took Shan county.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Nian rebels crossed into Shandong and seized Shan county.

sentences.zh: 調英桂為山西巡撫，恆福為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Ying Gui was transferred as Shanxi governor and Hengfu as Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Gui went to Shanxi and Hengfu to Henan as governors.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，官軍復豐縣。

translations.literal: On day yichou, government troops recovered Feng county.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, government forces retook Feng county.

sentences.zh: 捻匪陷曹縣，尋復之。

translations.literal: Nian bandits took Cao county but it was soon recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Nian rebels seized Cao county but it was quickly retaken.

sentences.zh: 何桂清請以海關盈餘用充軍饟，允之。

translations.literal: He Guiqing requested using customs surpluses for army provisions; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He Guiqing asked to fund the army from customs surpluses and was allowed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，江北軍在浦口失利，奪德興阿、鞠殿華職。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Jiangbei forces were defeated at Pukou; De Xing'a and Ju Dianhua were stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Jiangbei troops lost at Pukou and De Xing'a and Ju Dianhua were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 和春奏：「浦口失利，已飛調援浙之師徑赴六合。

translations.literal: He Chun memorialized: "After the Pukou defeat, troops that had been rushed to relieve Zhejiang were redirected straight to Liuhe.
translations.idiomatic: He Chun reported: "After Pukou fell, forces bound for Zhejiang were diverted straight to Liuhe.

sentences.zh: 探聞閩省回竄之賊，將由寧、太以援金陵，明系城賊圍急，令其部眾到處竄擾，以分我兵力。

translations.literal: Scouts report rebels circling back from Fujian will pass through Ningguo and Taiping to aid Jinling; clearly the besieged city garrison, pressed in the siege, is sending detachments to raid everywhere to divide our forces.
translations.idiomatic: Intelligence says Fujian rebels returning through Ning and Tai will relieve Jinling; the trapped garrison is clearly raiding widely to split our armies.

sentences.zh: 請飭各路自行援剿，勿致掣動全局。

translations.literal: I request that each route suppress on its own and not upset the overall disposition."
translations.idiomatic: I ask each front to fight locally and not pull apart the whole plan."

sentences.zh: 」上是之。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉朔，湖北官軍多隆阿克復太湖。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou new moon: Hubei government troops under Duolong'a recovered Taihu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiyou new moon, Duolong'a's Hubei forces retook Taihu.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔以「天長、儀徵相繼失陷，六合危急，溫紹原雖素得民心，日久亦恐難支。

translations.literal: On day yihai, an edict said: "Tianchang and Yizheng fell in succession; Liuhe is critical; though Wen Shaoyuan has long had the people's hearts, in time he too may not hold.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, an edict warned: "Tianchang and Yizheng have fallen; Liuhe is desperate; Wen Shaoyuan is popular but may not last.

sentences.zh: 即調周天培一軍分援六合、德安，一軍前往援應。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianpei's army is immediately to be divided to relieve Liuhe and De'an, with one corps to go forward in support."
translations.idiomatic: Split Zhou Tianpei's force between Liuhe and De'an and send another corps to reinforce."

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，官文、胡林翼奏李續賓、都興阿分路克復桐城、潛山，多隆阿進攻石牌，鮑超力攻雷公埠，均屬得手。

translations.literal: "On day xinsi, Guanwen and Hu Linyi memorialized that Li Xubin and Du Xing'a recovered Tongcheng and Qianshan on separate routes, Duolong'a advanced on Shipai, and Bao Chao pressed Leigongbu—all with success.
translations.idiomatic: "On xinsi day, Guanwen and Hu Linyi reported Li Xubin and Du Xing'a retook Tongcheng and Qianshan, Duolong'a took Shipai, and Bao Chao stormed Leigongbu—all successfully.

sentences.zh: 詔令聯絡水師進規安慶。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the navy coordinated to advance on Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the fleet linked for an advance on Anqing.

sentences.zh: 湖南官軍克復吉安，予同知曾國荃等升敘有差。

translations.literal: Hunan government troops recovered Ji'an; Registrar Zeng Guoquan and others were promoted with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan forces retook Ji'an and Zeng Guoquan and others were rewarded with promotions.

sentences.zh: 壬午，明誼奏俄案議結，互換文憑，開辦通商。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Ming Yi memorialized the Russian case concluded, credentials exchanged, and trade opened.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Ming Yi reported the Russian settlement done, documents exchanged, and trade begun.

sentences.zh: 賊陷揚州，奪德興阿世職。

translations.literal: Rebels took Yangzhou; De Xing'a's hereditary rank was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels captured Yangzhou and De Xing'a lost his hereditary title.

sentences.zh: 命柏葰、翁心存為大學士，官文、周祖培協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Bo Xia and Weng Xincun were made Grand Secretaries; Guanwen and Zhou Zupei assisted as Grand Secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Xia and Weng Xincun became Grand Secretaries with Guanwen and Zhou Zupei as assistants.

sentences.zh: 調瑞麟為戶部尚書，肅順為禮部尚書，硃鳳標為戶部尚書，陳孚恩為兵部尚書，瑞常為理籓院尚書，綿森為左都御史。

translations.literal: Ruilin was transferred as Minister of Revenue, Su Shun as Minister of Rites, Zhu Fengbiao as Minister of Revenue, Chen Fuen as Minister of War, Ruichang as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, and Miansen as Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: Ruilin took Revenue, Su Shun Rites, Zhu Fengbiao Revenue, Chen Fuen War, Ruichang Colonial Affairs, and Miansen Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 敕總兵毛三元、成明幫辦德興阿軍務。

translations.literal: Brigade commanders Mao Sanyuan and Cheng Ming were ordered to assist De Xing'a's military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Sanyuan and Cheng Ming were told to help De Xing'a command.

sentences.zh: 甲午，張國樑攻克揚州，續復儀徵。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Zhang Guoliang captured Yangzhou and subsequently recovered Yizheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Zhang Guoliang took Yangzhou and then Yizheng.

sentences.zh: 慶端奏攻克邵武，閩省肅清。

translations.literal: Qing Duan memorialized capture of Shaowu and pacification of Fujian province.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Duan reported Shaowu taken and Fujian pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，荊州將軍綿洵卒，調都興阿為荊州將軍，和春為江寧將軍，張國樑為江南提督。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Jingzhou General Mianxun died; Du Xing'a was transferred as Jingzhou general, He Chun as Jiangning general, and Zhang Guoliang as Jiangnan commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Mianxun of Jingzhou died; Du Xing'a became Jingzhou general, He Chun Jiangning general, and Zhang Guoliang Jiangnan commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賊陷六合，知縣溫紹原死之。

translations.literal: On day jihai, rebels took Liuhe; Magistrate Wen Shaoyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, rebels seized Liuhe and Magistrate Wen Shaoyuan was killed.

sentences.zh: 紹原孤守危城，數年百餘戰，力竭而陷。

translations.literal: Shaoyuan held the perilous city alone; over several years he fought more than a hundred battles and fell when his strength was exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Shaoyuan alone held Liuhe through peril, fought a hundred-odd battles over years, and fell when spent.

sentences.zh: 上悼惜之，贈布政使，優恤，建祠予諡。

translations.literal: The Emperor mourned him, posthumously granted the rank of provincial administrative commissioner, gave generous bereavement grace, and had a temple built with a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor mourned him, posthumously made him administrative commissioner, granted generous relief, and built a temple with posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯朔，浙江寧海土匪滋事，提督阿麟保剿平之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day guimao: bandits rose in Ninghai, Zhejiang; Admiral Alinbao suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, guimao new moon, Ninghai bandits were pacified by Admiral Alinbao.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，勝保奏克復天長，李兆受在事出力。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Sheng Bao memorialized the recovery of Tianchang; Li Zhaoshou had rendered distinguished service in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Sheng Bao reported Tianchang retaken and praised Li Zhaoshou's service.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「李兆受賜名李世忠，予三品銜、花翎，以參將補用。

translations.literal: An edict replied: "Li Zhaoshou is granted the name Li Shizhong, given third-rank insignia and peacock feather, and appointed colonel."
translations.idiomatic: The court ruled Li Zhaoshou would be named Li Shizhong, given third rank and peacock feather, and made colonel.

sentences.zh: 」己酉，御史孟傳金奏劾舉人平齡硃墨不符，派載垣、端華認真查辦。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Censor Meng Chuanjin memorialized impeaching graduate Ping Ling for ink-script mismatch; Zaiyuan and Duhua were assigned to investigate thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Meng Chuanjin impeached Ping Ling for exam ink fraud; Zaiyuan and Duhua were ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，僧格林沁奏天津砲台工竣。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Sengge Rinchen memorialized that Tianjin forts were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Sengge Rinchen reported Tianjin forts finished.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之，賜御服。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised this and granted imperial robes.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised him and gave imperial dress.

sentences.zh: 己未，江南官軍復溧水。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Jiangnan government troops recovered Lishui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Jiangnan forces retook Lishui.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命李續賓幫同勝保辦理安徽軍務。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Li Xubin was ordered to assist Sheng Bao in managing Anhui military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Li Xubin was assigned to help Sheng Bao with Anhui affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔本年鄉試主考、同考官荒謬已極，覆試應議之卷，竟有五十本之多，正考官柏葰先革職，副考官硃鳳標、程庭桂暫行解任，聽候查辦。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, an edict stated that this year's provincial examination chief and associate examiners had been absurd to the extreme—more than fifty papers that should have been failed still passed the re-examination; chief examiner Baozhan was first dismissed from office, and associate examiners Zhu Fengbiao and Cheng Tinggui were temporarily removed pending investigation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the court denounced the provincial examiners' absurdity—fifty failed papers had passed re-check; Baozhan was dismissed and Zhu Fengbiao and Cheng Tinggui suspended pending inquiry.

sentences.zh: 命庄親王奕仁在御前大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: Prince Zhuang Yiren was ordered to study and serve among grand ministers before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhuang Yiren was assigned to train among imperial presence grand ministers.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申朔，移吉林馬隊益袁甲三軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day renshen: Jilin cavalry was transferred to reinforce Yuan Jiasan's army.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, renshen new moon, Jilin horse troops reinforced Yuan Jiasan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，袁甲三請于山東東三府抽釐助饟，許之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Yuan Jiasan requested levies from Shandong's eastern three prefectures to aid army pay; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yuan Jiasan won levy rights in eastern Shandong to fund the army.

sentences.zh: 己卯，徐澤醇卒，以硃嶟為禮部尚書，張祥河為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Xu Zechun died; Zhu Yun was made Minister of Rites and Zhang Xianghe Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Xu Zechun died; Zhu Yun took rites and Zhang Xianghe the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，援閩、浙軍復浦城、順昌，予周天培提督銜。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, troops aiding Fujian and Zhejiang recovered Pucheng and Shunchang; Zhou Tianpei was given grand commander rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Fujian-Zhejiang relief forces retook Pucheng and Shunchang; Zhou Tianpei gained grand commander rank.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，恆福奏官軍剿捻大勝，豫境肅清，總兵傅振邦擢提督，編修袁保恆賜巴圖魯勇號。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Hengfu memorialized a great government victory over Nian bandits and that Henan was pacified; Brigadier Fu Zhenbang was promoted to grand commander, and Compiler Yuan Baoheng was granted the Batulu brave title.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Hengfu reported Henan cleared of Nian rebels; Fu Zhenbang became grand commander and Yuan Baoheng gained a Batulu title.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，內閣副本庫被盜。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Grand Secretariat duplicate archive was robbed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Grand Secretariat duplicate vault was burgled.

sentences.zh: 己亥，吳振棫以病免，以張亮基為雲貴總督，徐之銘為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Wu Zhendong was relieved for illness; Zhang Liangji was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general and Xu Zhiming Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, ill Wu Zhendong yielded to Zhang Liangji as Yunnan-Guizhou governor and Xu Zhiming as Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，予陣亡提督鄧紹良優恤建祠。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, fallen Admiral Deng Shaoliang received generous bereavement grace and a memorial temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, fallen Admiral Deng Shaoliang was mourned with relief and a temple.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，以宋丞相陸秀夫從祀文廟。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei: Song Chancellor Lu Xiufu was admitted to secondary sacrifice at the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, dingwei, Lu Xiufu joined Confucian temple sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，提督李朝斌收復安徽東流、建德，賜巴圖魯勇號。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Admiral Li Chaobin recovered Dongliu and Jiande in Anhui and was granted the Batulu brave title.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Li Chaobin retook Dongliu and Jiande and gained a Batulu title.

sentences.zh: 永州鎮總兵樊燮以乘肩輿劾免。

translations.literal: Yongzhou garrison commander Fan Xie was impeached and dismissed for riding in a sedan chair.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Xie lost his Yongzhou command for using a sedan chair.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以鄭魁士為浙江提督，督辦寧國軍務。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Zheng Kuishi was made Zhejiang grand commander to supervise Ningguo military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Zheng Kuishi became Zhejiang commander to handle Ningguo affairs.

sentences.zh: 己未，李續賓進剿安徽，敗績於三河集，死之，贈總督，建祠予諡。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Li Xubin advanced into Anhui, was defeated at Sanheji, and died; he was posthumously made governor-general, with a temple and posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Li Xubin died in defeat at Sanheji; he was posthumously made governor-general with temple honors.

sentences.zh: 同知曾國華贈道員，予諡。

translations.literal: Subprefect Zeng Guohua was posthumously made circuit intendant with a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guohua was posthumously made circuit intendant and titled.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以何桂清為欽差大臣，辦理通商事宜。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, He Guiqing was made Imperial Commissioner to handle trade affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, He Guiqing became Imperial Commissioner for trade.

sentences.zh: 趙德轍免，以徐有壬為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhao Dezhe was dismissed; Xu Youren was made Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dezhe left office; Xu Youren took Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以瑞麟為大學士，調肅順為戶部尚書，麟魁為禮部尚書，瑞常為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Ruilin was made grand secretary; Suishun became Minister of Revenue, Lin Kui Minister of Rites, and Ruichang Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Ruilin entered the grand secretariat; Suishun, Lin Kui, and Ruichang took revenue, rites, and punishments.

sentences.zh: 祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: The autumnal collective sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn joint sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、安徽、福建、湖北、貴州等省九十二廳州縣被災、被賊額賦，又免江蘇六場鹽課各有差。

translations.literal: That year, quota taxes were remitted for ninety-two districts in Zhili, Anhui, Fujian, Hubei, Guizhou, and elsewhere stricken by disaster or bandits; Jiangsu salt levies at six fields were also remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: That year, taxes were forgiven in ninety-two disaster- or bandit-struck districts and Jiangsu salt dues partly remitted.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年己未春正月壬申朔，桂良等奏英人藉口廣東有事，罷議回粵。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, new moon on day renshen: Gui Liang and others memorialized that the English used Guangdong affairs as a pretext to break off talks and return south.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, spring, renshen new moon, Gui Liang reported the English quit talks citing Guangdong troubles.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，召袁甲三來京，以傅振邦督剿三省捻匪，伊興阿副之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Yuan Jiasan was summoned to the capital; Fu Zhenbang was placed in command over three provinces' Nian suppression, with Yixing'a as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yuan Jiasan was recalled; Fu Zhenbang commanded three provinces' Nian campaigns with Yixing'a assisting.

sentences.zh: 壬午，江西官軍復瑞金，解安遠圍，別賊陷南安。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Jiangxi government troops recovered Ruijin and lifted the siege of Anyuan; other bandits took Nan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Jiangxi forces retook Ruijin and relieved Anyuan while Nan'an fell elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 桂良等奏和約四事。

translations.literal: Gui Liang and others memorialized four treaty items.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang reported four treaty points.

sentences.zh: 敕俟英使回滬妥議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered awaiting the English envoy's return to Shanghai for proper negotiation.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered talks to await the envoy's return to Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，福建匪周灴爔等降，遂復連城。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Fujian rebels including Zhou Huangxi submitted, and Liancheng was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Zhou Huangxi and other Fujian rebels submitted and Liancheng was retaken.

sentences.zh: 乙未，安徽官軍復建德。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Anhui government troops recovered Jiande.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Anhui forces retook Jiande.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，敕湖北採買馬匹訓練馬隊。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Hubei was ordered to purchase horses and train cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Hubei was told to buy horses and train cavalry.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，桂良等奏英使堅欲進京。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Gui Liang and others memorialized that the English envoy insisted on entering Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Gui Liang reported the English envoy demanded entry to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 敕僧格林沁嚴防海口。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sengge Rinchen to guard the sea mouth strictly.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Sengge Rinchen to hold the coastal forts.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，都興阿請假，以多隆阿接統其軍。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Duxing'a took leave; Duolong'a took over his army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Duxing'a went on leave and Duolong'a took his command.

sentences.zh: 詔海運漕船探避夷輪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered grain-transport ships on the sea route to scout and avoid foreign steamers.
translations.idiomatic: The court told grain ships to watch for and avoid foreign steamers.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，捻匪薛之元舉江浦降，會李世忠攻克浦口，賜名薛成良，予花翎、三品銜，擢李世忠副將。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingwei: Nian chieftain Xue Zhiyuan surrendered at Jiangpu; joining Li Shizhong's capture of Pukou, he was granted the name Xue Chengliang, given peacock feather and third-rank insignia, and Li Shizhong was promoted to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, dingwei, Xue Zhiyuan surrendered at Jiangpu; with Pukou taken, he became Xue Chengliang with third rank and peacock feather, and Li Shizhong was made deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，築奉天沿海砲台。

translations.literal: On day guichou, coastal forts were built in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Fengtian coastal batteries were built.

sentences.zh: 鄭魁士攻克灣沚、黃池賊壘。

translations.literal: Zheng Kuishi captured rebel fortifications at Wanzhi and Huangchi.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Kuishi took rebel forts at Wanzhi and Huangchi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上召廷臣宣示戊午科場舞弊罪狀，依載垣、端華所擬，主考官大學士柏葰坐家人掉換中卷批條，處斬。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor summoned court ministers and announced the crimes in the wuwu examination scandal; following Zaiyuan and Duhua's recommendations, chief examiner Grand Secretary Baozhan was sentenced to death for having servants switch papers and alter marking slips in the middle exam halls.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor announced the wuwu exam scandal; Baozhan was beheaded for servants swapping papers per Zaiyuan and Duhua's finding.

sentences.zh: 同考官浦安坐聽從李鶴齡賄屬，羅鴻繹行賄得中，均處斬。

translations.literal: Associate examiner Pu An was sentenced to death for obeying Li Heling's bribery requests, and Luo Hongyi to death for bribing his way to success.
translations.idiomatic: Pu An was beheaded for taking Li Heling's bribes and Luo Hongyi for buying his pass.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，張芾奏官軍攻克婺源，賊目張淙相等乞降。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Zhang Fei memorialized government troops' capture of Wuyuan; bandit leaders including Zhang Congxiang begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Zhang Fei reported Wuyuan taken and Zhang Congxiang and other leaders sought surrender.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，翁同書奏賊陷六安。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Weng Tongshu memorialized that bandits took Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Weng Tongshu reported Lu'an fallen.

sentences.zh: 慶祺卒，以恆福為直隸總督，瑛棨為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Qingqi died; Hengfu was made Zhili governor-general and Yingqi Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Qingqi died; Hengfu became Zhili governor-general and Yingqi Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，張國樑奏攻克揚州、儀徵，回軍連克溧水。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Zhang Guoliang memorialized capturing Yangzhou and Yizheng and, on the return march, retaking Lishui in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Zhang Guoliang took Yangzhou and Yizheng and retook Lishui on the march back.

sentences.zh: 特詔嘉獎，予輕車都尉世職，李若珠賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: A special edict praised and rewarded him, granting hereditary Commandant of Light Chariots rank; Li Ruozhu was given a yellow jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Special praise granted Zhang Guoliang hereditary commandant rank; Li Ruozhu received a yellow jacket.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，曾國籓奏軍抵南康，蕭啟江克復南安。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Zeng Guofan memorialized his army reaching Nankang; Xiao Qijiang recovered Nan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Zeng Guofan reached Nankang and Xiao Qijiang retook Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉獎，予蕭啟江巴圖魯勇號。

translations.literal: An edict praised this; Xiao Qijiang was granted the Batulu brave title.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised them and gave Xiao Qijiang a Batulu title.

sentences.zh: 詔編修李鴻章交伊興阿差委。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Compiler Li Hongzhang attached to Yixing'a for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was assigned to Yixing'a's staff.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未朔，前布政使李孟群兵潰於官亭，死之，復官予恤。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day xinwei: former provincial commissioner Li Mengqun's army was routed at Guanting and he died; his office was restored and bereavement granted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, xinwei new moon, Li Mengqun was killed when routed at Guanting; his rank was posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，奕山、景淳奏俄人徑至烏蘇里江、綏芬河擇地建屋，並請會勘，詔不許。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Yishan and Jingchun memorialized Russians going straight to the Ussuri and Suifen rivers to choose sites and build houses, and requesting a joint survey; an edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Yishan reported Russians building on the Ussuri and Suifen; joint survey was refused.

sentences.zh: 丙子，捻匪犯河南西華、舞陰，前總兵邱聯恩死之，贈提督，予恤。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Nian bandits attacked Xihua and Wuyin in Henan; former brigadier Qiu Lian'en died; he was posthumously made grand commander with bereavement.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Nian rebels struck Henan; Qiu Lian'en was killed and posthumously made grand commander.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，桂良等奏英使兵船北上，阻止不聽。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Gui Liang and others memorialized English warships going north; orders to stop them were not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Gui Liang reported English ships heading north despite orders to halt.

sentences.zh: 己卯，四川里塘頭人作亂，恩慶討平之，誅其夷目鄧珠。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Sichuan Litang headmen rebelled; En Qing suppressed them and executed their chieftain Deng Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Litang headmen rebelled; En Qing crushed them and killed Deng Zhu.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以旱求言。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, because of drought he sought memorials and advice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, drought prompted a call for counsel.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，李鈞卒，以黃贊湯為東河河道總督。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Li Jun died; Huang Zantang was made Grand Canal governor-general of the Eastern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Li Jun died; Huang Zantang took the Eastern Canal post.

sentences.zh: 乙未，俄人在黑龍江通商，許免徵稅，不許闌入烏蘇里、綏芬。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Russians were allowed to trade on the Amur tax-free, but forbidden to intrude into the Ussuri and Suifen.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Russians traded tax-free on the Amur but could not enter the Ussuri or Suifen.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑朔，勝保奏克復六安。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day xinchou: Sheng Bao memorialized recovery of Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, xinchou new moon, Sheng Bao reported Lu'an retaken.

sentences.zh: 伊興阿解幫辦，以關保幫辦傅振邦軍務。

translations.literal: Yixing'a was relieved from assisting; Guanbao was assigned to assist Fu Zhenbang's military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing'a left the staff; Guanbao joined Fu Zhenbang's command.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，調王慶雲為兩廣總督，黃宗漢為四川總督。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Wang Qingyun was transferred as Liangguang governor-general and Huang Zonghan as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Wang Qingyun took Liangguang and Huang Zonghan Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 江西賊竄湖南郴州、桂陽，劉長佑擊走之。

translations.literal: Jiangxi bandits fled into Chenzhou and Guiyang in Hunan; Liu Changyou drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi rebels entered Hunan; Liu Changyou repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，勝保奏捻匪張元龍降，收復鳳陽府縣，並復臨淮關。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Sheng Bao memorialized Nian chieftain Zhang Yuanlong's surrender and recovery of Fengyang prefecture and county and Linhuai Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Sheng Bao reported Zhang Yuanlong's surrender and Fengyang and Linhuai retaken.

sentences.zh: 築寧河砲台。

translations.literal: Ninghe forts were built.
translations.idiomatic: Ninghe batteries were constructed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，浙江餘姚土匪作亂，討平之。

translations.literal: On day wushen, bandits rose in Yuyao, Zhejiang; they were suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Yuyao bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，俄使賽善由察哈爾陸路入京，請助槍砲，致於恰克圖。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Russian envoy Saishan entered Beijing by land through Chahar and requested guns and cannon, which were sent to Kyakhta.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Russia's Saishan reached Beijing overland and obtained arms sent via Kyakhta.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上再祈雨。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor again prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Emperor prayed for rain again.

sentences.zh: 己未，邵燦病免，以袁甲三署漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Shao Can was relieved for illness; Yuan Jiasan acted as Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, ill Shao Can was replaced by Yuan Jiasan acting as canal transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 調勞崇光為廣東巡撫，兼署總督。

translations.literal: Luo Chongguang was transferred as Guangdong governor and also acting governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Chongguang became Guangdong governor and acting governor-general.

sentences.zh: 賊陷天長，前提督德安死之，復官予恤。

translations.literal: Bandits took Tianchang; former Admiral De'an died; his office was restored and bereavement granted.
translations.idiomatic: Tianchang fell; former Admiral De'an was killed and posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，奕山奏俄船由黑龍江入松花江東駛入海。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Yishan memorialized Russian ships entering the Songhua from the Amur and sailing east to sea.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Yishan reported Russian ships entering the Songhua from the Amur bound for sea.

sentences.zh: 得旨，不許入綏芬，令特普欽派員阻之。

translations.literal: An edict replied: entry into Suifen was not permitted; Te Puqin was ordered to send men to block them.
translations.idiomatic: The court forbade Suifen entry and told Te Puqin to block the ships.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，王懿德免，以慶端為閩浙總督，羅遵殿為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Wang Yide was dismissed; Qingduan was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Luo Zundian Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Wang Yide left office; Qingduan took Fujian-Zhejiang and Luo Zundian Fujian.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，雨。

translations.literal: On day guihai, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜孫家鼐等一百八十人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Sun Jianai and one hundred eighty others were granted jinshi degrees and court ranks in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Sun Jianai and 180 others received jinshi ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，廣東官軍復嘉應，竄賊擾連平，陷樂昌。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Guangdong government troops recovered Jiaying; fleeing bandits harassed Lianping and took Lechang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Guangdong retook Jiaying; fleeing rebels took Lechang after raiding Lianping.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，詔駱秉章仍令田興恕回援貴州，兆琛一軍撤回。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingzi: an edict ordered Luo Bingzhang still to send Tian Xingyu back to aid Guizhou and to withdraw Zhao Chen's army.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingzi, Luo Bingzhang was told to send Tian Xingyu to Guizhou and pull back Zhao Chen's force.

sentences.zh: 己卯，敕奕山更正俄人條約。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Yishan was ordered to correct the Russian treaty.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Yishan was told to revise the Russian treaty.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，敕慶昀密查張家口、白城居住俄人。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Qingyun was ordered secretly to investigate Russians residing at Zhangjiakou and Baicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Qingyun was told to investigate Russians at Zhangjiakou and Baicheng.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以周天受督辦寧國軍務。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Zhou Tianshou was placed in command of Ningguo military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Zhou Tianshou took over Ningguo operations.

sentences.zh: 甲申，俄人請赴三姓貿易。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Russians requested to trade at Sanxing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Russians asked to trade at Sanxing.

sentences.zh: 詔責奕山辦理輭弱，革副都統吉拉明阿職，枷號烏蘇里地方。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Yishan for weak handling, stripped Vice Banner Commander Jilaming'a of office, and had him cangued at the Ussuri.
translations.idiomatic: The court scolded Yishan's weakness, dismissed Jilaming'a, and cangued him on the Ussuri.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，官文奏探聞石達開將犯四川，詔曾國籓移軍夔州。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Guan Wen memorialized intelligence that Shi Dakai would invade Sichuan; Zeng Guofan was ordered to move his army to Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Guan Wen reported Shi Dakai bound for Sichuan; Zeng Guofan was sent to Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，桂良、花沙納奏英酋於本月十三日起碇入京，桂良等即日馳驛回京。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Gui Liang and Hua Shana memorialized the English chief would weigh anchor on the thirteenth of this month and enter Beijing; Gui Liang and others immediately rushed back to the capital by courier post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Gui Liang reported the English would sail for Beijing on the 13th and raced back by post.

sentences.zh: 大學士翁心存乞休，允之。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Weng Xincun requested retirement; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Xincun retired from the grand secretariat.

sentences.zh: 復以賈楨為大學士。

translations.literal: Jia Zhen was again made grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhen rejoined the grand secretariat.

sentences.zh: 調許乃普為吏部尚書，張祥河為工部尚書，沈兆霖為左都御史。

translations.literal: Xu Naipu was transferred as Minister of Personnel, Zhang Xianghe Minister of Works, and Shen Zhaolin Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Naipu took personnel, Zhang Xianghe works, and Shen Zhaolin the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，駱秉章奏石達開竄湖南，劉長佑、江忠義、田興恕諸軍擊走之。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Luo Bingzhang memorialized Shi Dakai fleeing into Hunan; armies under Liu Changyou, Jiang Zhongyi, and Tian Xingyu drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Luo Bingzhang reported Shi Dakai in Hunan driven off by Liu Changyou and others.

sentences.zh: 丙申，僧格林沁奏英船鳴砲闖入大沽，我軍開砲轟擊，擊沈多船，並有步隊上岸搦戰，我軍徑前奮擊，擊斃數百名，其兵頭赫姓並被砲傷。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Sengge Rinchen memorialized English ships firing cannon and forcing entry at Dagu; our forces opened fire and sank many ships; infantry also landed to skirmish; our troops pressed forward fiercely and killed several hundred; their commander surnamed He was wounded by cannon.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Sengge Rinchen reported English ships forced Dagu; Qing guns sank many and killed hundreds, wounding their leader He.

sentences.zh: 我軍亦傷亡提督史榮椿、副將龍汝元等。

translations.literal: Our forces also lost Admiral Shi Rongchun, Deputy Commander Long Ruyuan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Qing losses included Admiral Shi Rongchun and Deputy Commander Long Ruyuan.

sentences.zh: 夷船即時出口。

translations.literal: The foreign ships immediately left the estuary.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign ships withdrew at once.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「將弁齊心協力，異常奮勇，先獎賞銀五千兩，並查明保奏。

translations.literal: An edict replied: "Officers and men acted in concert with exceptional valor; reward five thousand taels of silver first, and report names for commendation after investigation."
translations.idiomatic: The court granted five thousand taels for exceptional valor and ordered commendations after review.

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，詔夷人雖經懲創，仍宜設法撫馭，即派恆福專辦撫局，僧格林沁仍辦防務。

translations.literal: " On day wuxu, an edict said that although the barbarians had been punished, methods of pacification should still be devised; Hengfu was specially assigned to manage pacification, while Sengge Rinchen continued to handle defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the court ordered continued pacification of the barbarians: Hengfu took the pacification portfolio and Sengge Rinchen kept defense.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥朔，賜僧格林沁御用珍服。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon day jihai: imperial precious robes were bestowed on Sengge Rinchen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon jihai, Sengge Rinchen received imperial robes.

sentences.zh: 庚子，捻匪陷盱眙，官軍尋復之。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Nian bandits took Xuyi; government troops soon recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Nian rebels seized Xuyi and the army soon retook it.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，特普欽奏俄人在三姓者，倔強不肯折回。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Tepuqin memorialized that Russians at Sanxing were obstinate and refused to turn back.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Tepuqin reported Russians at Sanxing would not withdraw.

sentences.zh: 命景淳前往查辦。

translations.literal: Jingchun was ordered to go and investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchun was sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，廣西官軍復上林，匪陷賓州。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Guangxi government troops recovered Shanglin; bandits took Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Guangxi troops retook Shanglin while bandits seized Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，張亮基奏回匪馬凌漢伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Zhang Liangji memorialized that the Hui rebel Ma Linghan had been executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Zhang Liangji reported the execution of Hui rebel Ma Linghan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，恆福奏美人進京換約，許之。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Hengfu memorialized that Americans were coming to the capital to exchange treaties; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Hengfu won assent for Americans to come to Beijing to exchange treaties.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，英、法兵船全數開行。

translations.literal: On day guisi, all English and French warships set sail.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the English and French fleets departed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以李若珠為福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Li Ruozhu was made Fujian land-route provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Li Ruozhu became Fujian land-route commander.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，何桂清奏英、法陸續回滬。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, He Guiqing memorialized that the English and French were returning to Shanghai in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, He Guiqing reported the English and French were returning to Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，陳玉成陷定遠。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Chen Yucheng took Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Chen Yucheng seized Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，和春奏水師剿賊獲勝。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, He Chun memorialized that the naval force had defeated bandits in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, He Chun reported a naval victory over bandits.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，曾國籓奏克景德鎮，復浮梁。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengwu: Zeng Guofan memorialized that Jingdezhen had been taken and Fuliang recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on gengwu day, Zeng Guofan reported the capture of Jingdezhen and recovery of Fuliang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，勝保奏翁同書潰敗情形。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Sheng Bao memorialized on Weng Tonghe's rout.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Sheng Bao reported Weng Tonghe's defeat.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「汝為統帥，只知炫己之長，不原援人之失。

translations.literal: An edict said: "As commander-in-chief you only display your own strengths and do not excuse others' failures.
translations.idiomatic: The court said: "As supreme commander you boast of yourself and blame allies for every setback.

sentences.zh: 日日聚訟，庸何濟乎！

translations.literal: Daily wrangling—of what use is it!"
translations.idiomatic: Daily quarrels accomplish nothing!"

sentences.zh: 」己卯，美使華若翰遞國書，和約用寶，在北塘交換。

translations.literal: " On day jimao, the American minister Ward presented his credentials; the treaty was sealed and exchanged at Beitang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Minister Ward exchanged credentials and the sealed treaty at Beitang.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔曰：「朕聞勝保專以招降為能事，降眾未盡薙髮，張元漋且四外打糧。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, an edict said: "We have heard that Sheng Bao makes recruitment of surrenders his sole talent; surrendered masses have not all shaved their heads, and Zhang Yuanchong is even foraging in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor rebuked Sheng Bao for boasting of surrenders while rebels went unshorn and Zhang Yuanchong foraged widely.

sentences.zh: 又報克復盱眙，該縣並無城池，賊因無糧退出，虛報邀功。

translations.literal: He also reported the recovery of Xuyi, yet that county has no city walls; the bandits withdrew for lack of grain, and he falsely claimed merit.
translations.idiomatic: He also falsely claimed Xuyi, which has no walls, after bandits left for lack of food.

sentences.zh: 此次姑不深究。

translations.literal: This time he is for the present not pursued deeply.
translations.idiomatic: On this occasion the court will not press the matter further.

sentences.zh: 即約束反側，力改前非。

translations.literal: He must at once restrain the disaffected and vigorously reform his former errors.
translations.idiomatic: He must restrain the unreliable and thoroughly mend his ways.

sentences.zh: 凜之！

translations.literal: Take warning!"
translations.idiomatic: Be warned!"

sentences.zh: 」癸未，御史趙元模奏黃河北流，涸出濱河田畝三四千頃，請辦屯田，寓兵於農，較勝團練。

translations.literal: " On day guiwei, Censor Zhao Yuanmo memorialized that the Yellow River had flowed north, exposing three or four thousand mu of riverside fields, and asked to establish military colonies, keeping troops among farmers, which would be better than militia drill.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Censor Zhao Yuanmo urged military farming on fields exposed by the Yellow River's northward shift.

sentences.zh: 上是之，下袁甲三、庚長議奏。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved and referred it to Yuan Jiasan and Gengchang for joint memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved and ordered Yuan Jiasan and Gengchang to report.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔曰：「王大臣續陳審明科場舞弊之大員父子，及遞送關節之職員，分別定擬。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, an edict said: "The princes and ministers have further set forth the examination-fraud case of the great official father and son, and the clerks who relayed examination signals, with separate penalties fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, an edict fixed penalties in the examination-bribery case for great officials, their sons, and signal-carriers.

sentences.zh: 此案程炳采於伊父程庭桂入闈後，接收關節，令家人轉遞場內，程庭桂並不舉發。
