translations.literal: In this case Cheng Bingcai, after his father Cheng Tinggui entered the examination hall, received signals and had household members relay them inside; Cheng Tinggui did not report it.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Bingcai relayed examination signals for his father Cheng Tinggui, who failed to report it.

sentences.zh: 程炳采處斬，程庭桂免死，遣戍軍台。

translations.literal: Cheng Bingcai was sentenced to death; Cheng Tinggui was spared death and sent to garrison duty on the military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Bingcai was executed; Cheng Tinggui was spared and exiled to the military colonies.

sentences.zh: 謝森墀、潘祖同、潘敦儼等俱免死，發遣新疆。

translations.literal: Xie Senchi, Pan Zutong, Pan Dunyi, and others were all spared death and sent to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Senchi, Pan Zutong, Pan Dunyi, and others were spared death and exiled to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 」己丑，駱秉章奏石達開圍寶慶，李續宜援之，立解城圍。

translations.literal: " On day jichou, Luo Bingzhang memorialized that Shi Dakai was besieging Baoxing; Li Xuyi relieved it and the siege was at once raised.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Luo Bingzhang reported Li Xuyi had raised Shi Dakai's siege of Baoxing.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命李若珠幫辦江南軍務。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Li Ruozhu was ordered to assist in Jiangnan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Li Ruozhu was assigned to assist Jiangnan operations.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌朔，崇恩罷，以文煜為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon day wuxu: Chong'en was dismissed and Wen Yu was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon wuxu, Chong'en left office and Wen Yu became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，敕恆祺留辦廣東通商。

translations.literal: On day yisi, an edict ordered Hengqi to remain and manage Guangdong trade.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Hengqi was ordered to stay and handle Guangdong trade.

sentences.zh: 勝保奏李世忠剿賊獲勝，解定遠、滁州圍。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao memorialized that Li Shizhong had defeated bandits and raised the sieges of Dingyuan and Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao reported Li Shizhong's victory and relief of Dingyuan and Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔擢李世忠總兵。

translations.literal: An edict promoted Li Shizhong to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shizhong was promoted to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 廣東官軍復連山、開建。

translations.literal: Guangdong government troops recovered Lianshan and Kaijian.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong troops retook Lianshan and Kaijian.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命曾國籓駐軍湖口。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Zeng Guofan was ordered to station his army at Hukou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Zeng Guofan was ordered to camp at Hukou.

sentences.zh: 命都興阿蒞江寧將軍視事，多隆阿接統所部，總理前敵事務。

translations.literal: Duxing'a was ordered to take up duties as Jiangning General; Dolongga took over his command and was put in overall charge of front-line affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Duxing'a became Jiangning General; Dolongga took his troops and commanded the front.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，景淳奏俄人船在三姓者，現令折回。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Jingchun memorialized that Russian ships at Sanxing had now been ordered to turn back.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Jingchun reported Russian ships at Sanxing were ordered back.

sentences.zh: 在烏蘇里者，未肯聽命。

translations.literal: Those on the Ussuri had not yet obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: Those on the Ussuri still refused.

sentences.zh: 詔體察輿情，妥為辦理。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that public sentiment be gauged and the matter handled properly.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the matter handled with due regard for local opinion.

sentences.zh: 己未，美人請先開市，以英、法約議未定，卻之。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Americans asked to open trade first; because English and French treaty talks were unsettled, it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, an American request for early market opening was refused pending Anglo-French treaties.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，駱秉章奏石達開南陷江華、永門，將入廣西。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Luo Bingzhang memorialized that Shi Dakai had gone south and taken Jianghua and Yongmen and would enter Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Luo Bingzhang reported Shi Dakai had seized Jianghua and Yongmen and was heading into Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 現飭劉長佑統軍追剿。

translations.literal: Liu Changyou was now ordered to command troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Changyou was ordered to pursue with his army.

sentences.zh: 得旨，田興恕一軍援黔，李續宜一軍回湖北備調。

translations.literal: An edict said: Tian Xingyu's army is to aid Guizhou; Li Xuyi's army is to return to Hubei for reserve deployment.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Tian Xingyu to aid Guizhou and Li Xuyi back to Hubei as reserve.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，發逆、捻匪會攻壽州，官軍擊卻之。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Taiping and Nian bandits jointly attacked Shouzhou; government troops beat them back.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Taiping and Nian rebels jointly attacked Shouzhou and were repulsed.

sentences.zh: 御史陳慶松奏科場案內大員子弟陳景彥等贖罪太驟，請仍發遣，嚴旨斥之。

translations.literal: Censor Chen Qingsong memorialized that in the examination case the sons of great officials, Chen Jingyan and others, had been ransomed too quickly and asked that they still be sent into exile; a stern edict rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Chen Qingsong's plea to re-exile examination-case offenders drew a sharp rebuke.

sentences.zh: 甲子，廣東官軍復靈山。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Guangdong government troops recovered Lingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Guangdong troops retook Lingshan.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，安徽賊陷霍山、盱眙，勝保擊退之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuchen: Anhui bandits took Huoshan and Xuyi; Sheng Bao drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuchen day, Anhui rebels took Huoshan and Xuyi and Sheng Bao repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 勝保丁母憂，留營視軍。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao was in mourning for his mother but remained in camp to oversee the army.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao, though mourning his mother, stayed with the army.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，胡興仁罷，調羅遵殿為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Hu Xingren was dismissed and Luo Zundian was transferred as Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Hu Xingren left office and Luo Zundian became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王慶雲病免，以勞崇光為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Wang Qingyun was relieved for illness and Lao Chongguang was made Liang-Guang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Wang Qingyun left for illness and Lao Chongguang took Liang-Guang.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，官文、胡林翼奏多隆阿攻破安徽石牌，擊破援賊，獲賊目霍天燕石廷玉，得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Guan Wen and Hu Linyi memorialized that Dolongga had stormed Shipai in Anhui, broken relieving bandits, and captured the bandit chiefs Huo Tianyan and Shi Tingyu; an edict praised them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Guan Wen and Hu Linyi reported Dolongga's capture of Shipai and bandit chiefs, winning praise.

sentences.zh: 己丑，傅振邦奏追剿捻匪，敗之。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Fu Zhenbang memorialized on pursuing Nian bandits and defeating them.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Fu Zhenbang reported defeating pursuing Nian bandits.

sentences.zh: 甲午，曹澍鍾奏石達開圍廣西省城，蕭啟江、蘇鳳文會合蔣益澧分途剿擊，敗之，立解城圍。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Cao Shuzhong memorialized that Shi Dakai was besieging the Guangxi provincial capital; Xiao Qijiang and Su Fengwen joined Jiang Yili in divided pursuit, defeated him, and at once raised the siege.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Cao Shuzhong reported allied forces had raised Shi Dakai's siege of the Guangxi capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉朔，時享太廟，上親詣行禮。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon day dingyou: the seasonal offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the Emperor went in person to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on the new moon dingyou, the Emperor personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 駱秉章奏賊中投出難民，給予免死護照，資遣回籍，原效力者，准其留營，得旨，各省均可照辦。

translations.literal: Luo Bingzhang memorialized that refugees surrendering from among the bandits were given death-exemption passports, provided funds for return home, and those who wished to serve were allowed to remain in camp; an edict said all provinces might follow this.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Bingzhang's policy of passports and repatriation for surrendering refugees was approved for all provinces.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，雲南官軍克復嵩明，陣斬賊首孫漢鼎。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Yunnan government troops recovered Songming and slew the bandit chief Sun Handing in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Yunnan troops retook Songming and killed bandit chief Sun Handing.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以曾望顏署四川總督，譚廷襄署陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Zeng Wangyan acted as Sichuan governor and Tan Tingxiang acted as Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Zeng Wangyan acted as Sichuan governor and Tan Tingxiang as Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以袁甲三為欽差大臣，督辦安徽軍務。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Yuan Jiasan was made Imperial Commissioner to supervise Anhui military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Yuan Jiasan became Imperial Commissioner for Anhui.

sentences.zh: 以侍郎匡源、內閣學士文祥為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Kuang Yuan and Hanlin Academician Wen Xiang were made Grand Council ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Kuang Yuan and Wen Xiang joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，河南捻匪陷蘭儀，圍考城、通許，擾尉氏，分竄直隸、山東。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Henan Nian bandits took Lanyi, besieged Kaocheng and Tongxu, harassed Weishi, and scattered into Zhili and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Henan Nian rebels took Lanyi, besieged Kaocheng and Tongxu, raided Weishi, and spread into Zhili and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命總兵田在田幫辦傅振邦軍務。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Regional Commander Tian Zaitian was ordered to assist Fu Zhenbang in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Tian Zaitian was assigned to assist Fu Zhenbang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，授袁甲三漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Yuan Jiasan was appointed Grain Transport governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Yuan Jiasan received the Grain Transport post.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，勝保克復懷遠。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Sheng Bao recovered Huaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Sheng Bao retook Huaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 江蘇官軍剿六合失利，奪李若珠職。

translations.literal: Jiangsu government troops were defeated in attacking Liuhe; Li Ruozhu was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu troops failed at Liuhe and Li Ruozhu lost his post.

sentences.zh: 戊午，美使請開潮州、台灣通商口岸。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the American minister asked to open treaty ports at Chaozhou and Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the American minister sought treaty ports at Chaozhou and Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 庚申，河南官軍剿平鄢陵捻匪，西路肅清。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Henan government troops pacified Yanling Nian bandits and the western route was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Henan troops pacified Yanling Nian rebels and cleared the west.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以明誼為烏里雅蘇台將軍，景廉為伊犁參贊大臣，崇實為駐藏大臣。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Mingyi was made Uliasutai General, Jinglian Ili Assistant Resident Commissioner, and Chongshi Tibet Resident Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Mingyi took Uliasutai, Jinglian Ili, and Chongshi Tibet.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命官文、曾國籓、胡林翼妥籌四路規皖。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Guan Wen, Zeng Guofan, and Hu Linyi were ordered to plan properly a four-route campaign against Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Guan Wen, Zeng Guofan, and Hu Linyi were told to plan a four-route Anhui campaign.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，滇匪犯敘州，奪萬福職，以皁升為四川提督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuchen: Yunnan bandits attacked Xuzhou; Wan Fu was stripped of office and Gao Sheng was made Sichuan provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuchen day, Yunnan rebels attacked Xuzhou; Wan Fu lost his post and Gao Sheng became Sichuan commander.

sentences.zh: 辛未，何桂清奏，探聞英、法明春必來尋釁。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, He Guiqing memorialized that intelligence indicated the English and French would certainly come seeking trouble next spring.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, He Guiqing reported intelligence that the English and French would provoke trouble next spring.

sentences.zh: 恆祺奏英兵續行至粵。

translations.literal: Hengqi memorialized that English troops were continuing to Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Hengqi reported English troops were still heading to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 詔僧格林沁加意津防。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sengge Rinchen to pay special attention to Tianjin defenses.
translations.idiomatic: The court told Sengge Rinchen to strengthen Tianjin defenses.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賊陷浦口，總兵周天培死之，予世職。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, bandits took Pukou; Regional Commander Zhou Tianpei died in the fighting and was granted a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, bandits took Pukou; Zhou Tianpei died fighting and received a hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 癸未，特普欽奏俄人在黑龍江左岸占踞五十餘屯，請調西丹墨爾根、布特哈兵交那爾胡善訓練，聯絡旗民參夫，有事抵禦，從之。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Tepuqin memorialized that Russians had occupied more than fifty villages on the left bank of the Amur and asked that Xidan, Moergen, and Buteha troops be transferred to Narenhu Shan for training, linking banner people and hired laborers so that in an emergency they could resist; assent was given.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Tepuqin won assent to train border militia against Russian occupation of Amur villages.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命張芾督辦皖南軍務。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Zhang Fu was ordered to supervise southern Anhui military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Zhang Fu was assigned southern Anhui operations.

sentences.zh: 己丑，曾國籓奏韋志俊以池州降。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Zeng Guofan memorialized that Wei Zhijun had surrendered Chizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Zeng Guofan reported Wei Zhijun's surrender of Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 滇匪陷敘州，另股陷酉陽、秀山。

translations.literal: Yunnan bandits took Xuzhou; another column took Youyang and Xiushan.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan rebels took Xuzhou while another force took Youyang and Xiushan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，四川官軍復筠連、慶符、高縣。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Sichuan government troops recovered Junlian, Qingfu, and Gaoxian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Sichuan troops retook Junlian, Qingfu, and Gaoxian.

sentences.zh: 乙未，戶部災。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Ministry of Revenue caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Ministry of Revenue burned.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申朔，蔣霨遠奏石達開糾黨十餘萬由桂犯黔，將以窺蜀。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon day bingshen: Jiang Yiyuan memorialized that Shi Dakai had gathered more than a hundred thousand followers to invade Guizhou from Guangxi, intending to threaten Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the new moon bingshen, Jiang Yiyuan reported Shi Dakai was leading over a hundred thousand men from Guangxi into Guizhou toward Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 詔田興恕剿之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Tian Xingyu to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Xingyu was ordered to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Emperor went to the Dagao Hall to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 雲南丘北土匪滋事戕官，官軍討平之。

translations.literal: In Yunnan, Qiubei local bandits made trouble and killed officials; government troops suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Qiubei bandits killed officials and were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，和春奏官軍攻破江浦賊壘，揚州西界肅清。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, He Chun memorialized that government troops had stormed bandit stockades at Jiangpu and the western border of Yangzhou was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, He Chun reported the storming of Jiangpu bandit camps and clearance west of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，吏部尚書花沙納卒。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Minister of Personnel Hua Shana died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Minister of Personnel Hua Shana died.

sentences.zh: 丙午，何桂清報英、法兵船到滬。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, He Guiqing reported that English and French warships had reached Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, He Guiqing reported Anglo-French warships at Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 以田興恕為貴州提督。

translations.literal: Tian Xingyu was made Guizhou provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Xingyu became Guizhou provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 辛未，援黔湘軍攻復鎮遠。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Hunan troops aiding Guizhou recovered Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Hunan relief forces retook Zhenyuan in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，景淳奏請招集流民參夫，給地設卡，以助邊防，從之。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Jingchun memorialized asking to recruit migrant laborers, grant land, and establish checkpoints to aid border defense; assent was given.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Jingchun won assent to settle migrants on border lands with checkpoints.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，袁甲三奏攻克臨淮關，得旨嘉勉，下部議敘，穆騰阿加都統銜。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Yuan Jiasan memorialized the capture of Linhuai Pass; an edict praised him, referred the matter to the boards for merit record, and Muteng'a was given the vice-president rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Yuan Jiasan's capture of Linhuai Pass won praise and Muteng'a received a vice-president rank.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the joint seasonal offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the joint seasonal offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免直隸、河南、山東、浙江、貴州等省一百五十七州縣被災、被賊額賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, quota levies were remitted in varying degrees for one hundred fifty-seven districts in Zhili, Henan, Shandong, Zhejiang, Guizhou, and other provinces that had suffered disaster or banditry.
translations.idiomatic: That year, tax relief in varying degrees went to 157 districts in Zhili, Henan, Shandong, Zhejiang, Guizhou, and elsewhere hit by disaster or rebels.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十年庚申春正月丙寅，上三旬萬壽，頒詔覃恩。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, day bingyin, the Emperor's thirtieth-birthday grand celebration was held and an edict of universal grace was issued.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 10, month 1, bingyin, the Emperor's thirtieth birthday brought a grace edict.

sentences.zh: 詔先朝壽節有告祭之禮，升殿之儀，本年勿庸舉行，外吏、外籓並停來京祝嘏。

translations.literal: An edict said that on former dynasties' birthday festivals there were rites of announcement and ascent to the hall; this year they need not be performed, and outer officials and outer vassals are likewise to cease coming to the capital to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: The court suspended former birthday rites and barred outer officials and tributaries from birthday congratulations in the capital.

sentences.zh: 加恩親籓，惇郡王奕脤晉親王，貝子奕劻晉貝勒，餘各封賚，及於廷臣、疆臣。

translations.literal: Grace was extended to imperial clansmen: Prince Dun Yixuan was raised to Prince of the First Rank, Beizi Yikuang to Beile, and the rest received enfeoffments and gifts, extending also to court and frontier ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansmen and ministers received birthday enfeoffments and gifts, including Yixuan as prince and Yikuang as beile.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，前寧夏將軍托雲保卒。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the former Ningxia General Tuo Yunbao died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, former Ningxia General Tuo Yunbao died.

sentences.zh: 己巳，解勝保欽差大臣，專辦河南剿匪，袁甲三專辦安徽。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Sheng Bao was relieved of Imperial Commissioner rank and assigned solely to suppress bandits in Henan; Yuan Jiasan was assigned solely for Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Sheng Bao lost commissioner rank for Henan bandit suppression and Yuan Jiasan took Anhui alone.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，瑛棨以遲解京饟降官，以慶廉為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Ying Qi was demoted for tardy delivery of capital grain funds; Qing Lian was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Ying Qi was demoted for late capital grain funds and Qing Lian became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，刑部主事何秋濤呈進所纂北徼彙編八十卷，上嘉與之，賜名朔方備乘，入直懋勤殿。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Ministry of Punishments clerk He Qiutao presented his eighty-volume compilation Northern Frontier Collected Records; the Emperor praised it, renamed it Shuofang Beicheng, and admitted him to duty in the Maqin Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, He Qiutao presented his frontier compilation; the court praised it, renamed it Shuofang Beicheng, and posted him to the Maqin Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，有鳳免，以全亮為成都將軍，占泰為四川提督。

translations.literal: On day renchen, You Feng was dismissed; Quan Liang was made Chengdu general and Zhan Tai Sichuan provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, You Feng was dismissed; Quan Liang took Chengdu and Zhan Tai took Sichuan command.

sentences.zh: 甲午，御史白恩佑言津防重大，請預籌後路，以保萬全。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Censor Bai Enyou said Tianjin defense was of great weight and asked that rear routes be planned in advance to ensure complete security.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Bai Enyou urged advance planning of rear routes for Tianjin defense.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「所奏固是，然駐兵籌饟，甚覺為難。

translations.literal: An edict replied: "What you memorialized is indeed so, yet quartering troops and raising funds is very difficult.
translations.idiomatic: The court replied that the memorial was sound but garrisoning troops and raising pay would be very hard.

sentences.zh: 現在津防周備，可勿庸議。

translations.literal: Tianjin defenses are now complete; this need not be discussed further.
translations.idiomatic: Tianjin defenses were already complete and the matter need not be pursued.

sentences.zh: 」特普欽奏請召集鄂倫春人入伍，從之。

translations.literal: " Te Puqin memorialized to summon Oroqen into military service; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Te Puqin's request to enlist Oroqen was approved.

sentences.zh: 扎拉芬泰奏請與俄、廓合攻印度。

translations.literal: Zhalafentai memorialized for a joint attack on India with Russia and Nepal.
translations.idiomatic: Zhalafentai proposed a joint Russo-Nepalese attack on India.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「俄非和好也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Russia is no true friend.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said Russia was no true ally.

sentences.zh: 廓豈英敵？

translations.literal: How could Nepal match Britain?
translations.idiomatic: He asked how Nepal could match Britain.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict ended."

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou: the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou day, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以劉源灝為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Liu Yuanhao was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Liu Yuanhao became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 袁甲三奏克復鳳陽，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Yuan Jiasan memorialized the recovery of Fengyang; he was granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Jiasan recovered Fengyang and received a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，何桂清奏上海英人經華商開導，索兵費一百萬。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, He Guiqing memorialized that English at Shanghai, after Chinese merchants' mediation, demanded one million in military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, He Guiqing reported the English at Shanghai demanded one million in military expenses after merchant mediation.

sentences.zh: 津約不能更易，入京換約。

translations.literal: The Tianjin treaty could not be altered; they would enter the capital to exchange ratifications.
translations.idiomatic: They insisted the Tianjin treaty could not change and that ratification must occur in the capital.

sentences.zh: 如不見許，即開船北駛。

translations.literal: If not granted, they would sail north at once.
translations.idiomatic: They threatened to sail north if refused.

sentences.zh: 詔僧格林沁嚴備津防後路。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sengge Rinchen to secure rear routes for Tianjin defense.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Sengge Rinchen to secure Tianjin's rear defenses.

sentences.zh: 海運漕糧，暫緩放洋。

translations.literal: Sea-transport tribute grain was temporarily held from sailing.
translations.idiomatic: Sea-transport tribute grain was temporarily suspended.

sentences.zh: 丙午，湖南官軍克復貴州鎮遠。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Hunan government troops recovered Zhenyuan in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Hunan troops recovered Guizhou's Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，捻匪陷桃源，上竄清江，庚長退守淮安。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Nian bandits took Taoyuan and fled up the Qing River; Geng Chang withdrew to defend Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Nian bandits took Taoyuan and fled toward Qing River while Geng Chang fell back to Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 壬子，援桂湘軍克復柳州、柳城，加道員劉坤一按察使銜。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Hunan troops aiding Guangxi recovered Liuzhou and Liucheng; circuit intendant Liu Kunyi was given vice censor-in-chief rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Hunan relief troops recovered Liuzhou and Liucheng and Liu Kunyi gained vice censor rank.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，張芾奏官軍復建德，匪陷涇縣、旌德，連陷太平。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Zhang Fu memorialized that government troops recovered Jiande but bandits took Jing and Jingde and then took Taiping in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Zhang Fu reported Jiande recovered but Jing, Jingde, and Taiping fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以倭什琿布為禮部尚書，春佑為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Woshihabu was made Minister of Rites and Chunyou Rehe military governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Woshihabu took rites and Chunyou took Rehe command.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔和春分兵援浙。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, an edict ordered He Chun to divide forces to aid Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the court ordered He Chun to send troops to aid Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑朔，袁甲三奏官軍復清江。

translations.literal: Third month, day yichou first of month: Yuan Jiasan memorialized that government troops recovered Qing River.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month's yichou new moon, Yuan Jiasan reported Qing River recovered.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命提督張玉良統軍援浙。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Commander Zhang Yuliang was ordered to command troops aiding Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Zhang Yuliang was ordered to lead the Zhejiang relief force.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賊陷杭州，巡撫羅遵殿死之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, bandits took Hangzhou; Governor Luo Zundian died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Hangzhou fell and Governor Luo Zundian was killed.

sentences.zh: 越六日，將軍瑞昌復其城。

translations.literal: Six days later, General Ruichang recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Six days later Ruichang recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 重賚瑞昌、張玉良等。

translations.literal: Ruichang, Zhang Yuliang, and others were richly rewarded again.
translations.idiomatic: Ruichang, Zhang Yuliang, and others received further rewards.

sentences.zh: 以王有齡為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Wang Youling was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Youling became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上耕耤田。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，浙江官軍克復長興、臨安、孝豐。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Zhejiang government troops recovered Changxing, Lin'an, and Xiaofeng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Zhejiang troops recovered Changxing, Lin'an, and Xiaofeng.

sentences.zh: 甲午，何桂清奏夷船北犯。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, He Guiqing memorialized that foreign ships were raiding north.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, He Guiqing reported foreign ships raiding northward.

sentences.zh: 閏三月癸卯，四川官軍克復蒲江，賊陷名山。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day guimao: Sichuan government troops recovered Pujiang; bandits took Mingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On intercalary month 3, guimao, Sichuan troops recovered Pujiang but Mingshan fell.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命曹澍鍾督軍四川，以劉長佑為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Cao Shuzhong was ordered to command Sichuan forces; Liu Changyou was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Cao Shuzhong took Sichuan command and Liu Changyou became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賊陷溧水，連陷句容。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, bandits took Lishui and then took Jurong in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, bandits took Lishui and then Jurong.

sentences.zh: 以張玉良為廣西提督，留蘇督軍，尋令折回杭州。

translations.literal: Zhang Yuliang was made Guangxi provincial commander but remained in Jiangsu commanding troops; he was soon ordered to turn back to Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuliang was made Guangxi commander but stayed in Jiangsu until ordered back to Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，和春等奏陳玉成率眾突犯大營，城賊出而合犯，官軍力不能支，退守鎮江。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, He Chun and others memorialized that Chen Yucheng led a mass assault on the great camp; city bandits came out and joined the attack; government troops could not hold and withdrew to defend Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, He Chun reported Chen Yucheng's assault on the great camp; city rebels joined; government troops withdrew to Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以王夢齡為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Wang Mengling was made Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Wang Mengling became canal transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，以明儒曹端從祀文廟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingyin: the Ming Confucian Cao Duan was admitted to the Confucian temple sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, bingyin, the Ming scholar Cao Duan entered the Confucian temple sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賊陷丹陽，張國樑死之，和春走常州。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, bandits took Danyang; Zhang Guoliang died; He Chun fled to Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Danyang fell, Zhang Guoliang died, and He Chun fled to Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔直省舉辦團練。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, an edict ordered all provinces to organize militia training.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, all provinces were ordered to organize militia.

sentences.zh: 命都興阿督辦江北軍務。

translations.literal: Duxing'a was ordered to supervise military affairs north of the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: Duxing'a was ordered to supervise Jiangbei military affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔兩江總督何桂清屢失城池，褫職逮問。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, an edict said Liang-Jiang Governor-General He Guiqing had repeatedly lost cities; his office was stripped and he was arrested for inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, He Guiqing was stripped and arrested for repeatedly losing cities.

sentences.zh: 以曾國籓署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was made acting Liang-Jiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan became acting Liang-Jiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 擢兵部郎中左宗棠四品京堂，襄辦曾國籓軍務。

translations.literal: Ministry of War director Zuo Zongtang was promoted to fourth-rank capital official and assigned to assist Zeng Guofan's military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang was promoted to fourth-rank capital official to assist Zeng Guofan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賊犯常州，和春迎戰受傷，卒。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, bandits attacked Changzhou; He Chun met them in battle, was wounded, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, rebels attacked Changzhou; He Chun was wounded in battle and died.

sentences.zh: 以魁玉署江寧將軍，會巴棟阿扼守鎮江。

translations.literal: Kuiyu was made acting Jiangning general; he joined Badeng'a in holding Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Kuiyu became acting Jiangning general and joined Badeng'a defending Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賊陷建平，張玉良兵潰於無錫。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, bandits took Jianping; Zhang Yuliang's army was routed at Wuxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Jianping fell and Zhang Yuliang's army was routed at Wuxi.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賜鍾駿聲等一百八十三人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Zhong Junsheng and one hundred eighty-three others were granted jinshi and other degrees with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Zhong Junsheng and 183 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賊陷蘇州，巡撫徐有壬死之。

translations.literal: On day guisi, bandits took Suzhou; Governor Xu Youcheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Suzhou fell and Governor Xu Youcheng was killed.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午朔，以薛煥為江蘇巡撫，暫署總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu first of month: Xue Huan was made Jiangsu governor and temporarily acted as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth month's jiawu new moon, Xue Huan became Jiangsu governor and acting governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己亥，江蘇常熟縣知縣周沐潤招募沙勇，克復江陰。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Jiangsu Changshu county magistrate Zhou Murun recruited Sha braves and recovered Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Zhou Murun's Sha braves recovered Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賊陷浙江長興，圍湖州，蕭翰慶赴援失利，死之。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, bandits took Zhejiang's Changxing and besieged Huzhou; Xiao Hanqing went to relieve them, was defeated, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Changxing fell, Huzhou was besieged, and Xiao Hanqing died relieving it.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，曾國籓奏陳三路進兵，規蘇保浙，並調沈葆楨差遣。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Zeng Guofan memorialized a three-route advance to recover Suzhou, protect Zhejiang, and also requested Shen Baozhen's dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Zeng Guofan proposed a three-route advance on Suzhou and Zhejiang and asked for Shen Baozhen.

sentences.zh: 上嘉允之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised and approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 以東純兼署四川總督。

translations.literal: Dong Chun was made acting Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Chun became acting Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賊陷吳江、崑山及浙之嘉興。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, bandits took Wujiang, Kunshan, and Zhejiang's Jiaxing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Wujiang, Kunshan, and Jiaxing fell.

sentences.zh: 玉明奏金州、岫岩海口有洋船六十餘停泊，劫掠牲畜。

translations.literal: Yuming memorialized that more than sixty foreign ships were anchored at the sea mouths of Jinzhou and Xiuyan, plundering livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Yuming reported over sixty foreign ships at Jinzhou and Xiuyan plundering livestock.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，敕王夢齡督同喬松年開辦江北糧台。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, an edict ordered Wang Mengling to supervise Qiao Songnian in opening the Jiangbei grain bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Wang Mengling was ordered to open the Jiangbei grain bureau with Qiao Songnian.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，恤殉難在籍侍郎戴熙，贈尚書，予世職，建專祠，諡文節。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Vice Minister Dai Xi, who died for the state while at home, was mourned; he was posthumously made Minister, given hereditary office, a special shrine, and the posthumous title Wenjie.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the martyred Vice Minister Dai Xi was posthumously honored as Minister Wenjie with a shrine and hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命毛昶熙辦河南團練，杜辦山東團練。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Mao Changxi was ordered to organize Henan militia and Du to organize Shandong militia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Mao Changxi took Henan militia and Du took Shandong militia.

sentences.zh: 戊午，李若珠奏薛成良投誠復叛，捕誅之。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Li Ruozhu memorialized that Xue Chengliang had submitted and then rebelled; he was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Li Ruozhu reported Xue Chengliang's feigned submission and execution.

sentences.zh: 己未，曾國籓奏隨調鮑超、硃品隆進駐祁門，鄂軍不宜再調。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Zeng Guofan memorialized that Bao Chao and Zhu Pinlong were being moved to garrison at Qimen and that Hubei troops should not be transferred again.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Zeng Guofan moved Bao Chao and Zhu Pinlong to Qimen and asked that Hubei troops not be shifted again.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 玉明奏洋船到金州海面一百餘艘，文煜奏英、法兵到煙台者約有萬人，探聞有由海豐大山北犯之說，均下僧格林沁知之。

translations.literal: Yuming memorialized that more than one hundred foreign ships reached the Jinzhou coast; Wen Yu memorialized that British and French troops at Yantai numbered about ten thousand, with reports of an overland advance from Haifeng and Dashan; both were referred to Sengge Rinchen.
translations.idiomatic: Yuming reported over a hundred foreign ships off Jinzhou; Wen Yu reported ten thousand Anglo-French troops at Yantai and a possible overland advance; both reports went to Sengge Rinchen.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥朔，敕准巴爾虎旗人一體考試。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai first of month: an edict approved Barga Banner men taking examinations on equal terms.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month's guihai new moon, Barga Banner men were approved for equal examination rights.

sentences.zh: 甲子，英船駛入北塘。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, English ships entered Beitang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, English ships entered Beitang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賊陷青浦、松江。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, bandits took Qingpu and Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Qingpu and Songjiang fell.

sentences.zh: 己巳，劉長佑奏復慶遠，石達開南竄。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Liu Changyou memorialized the recovery of Qingyuan; Shi Dakai fled south.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Liu Changyou recovered Qingyuan as Shi Dakai fled south.

sentences.zh: 庚午，瑞昌奏復廣德。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Ruichang memorialized the recovery of Guangde.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Ruichang reported Guangde recovered.

sentences.zh: 辛未，萬壽節，御殿受賀。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Emperor's birthday: he received congratulations in the palace hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Emperor's birthday, he received court congratulations.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大學士彭蘊章罷直軍機。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Grand Secretary Peng Yunzhang ceased Grand Council duty.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Grand Secretary Peng Yunzhang left Grand Council duty.

sentences.zh: 命邵燦、劉繹、晏端書、龐鍾璐各在原籍舉辦團練。

translations.literal: Shao Can, Liu Yi, Yan Duanshu, and Pang Zhonglu were each ordered to organize militia in their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Can, Liu Yi, Yan Duanshu, and Pang Zhonglu were ordered to organize home-district militia.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王有齡奏在籍道員趙景賢克復湖州。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Wang Youling memorialized that home-district circuit intendant Zhao Jingxian recovered Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Wang Youling reported Zhao Jingxian's recovery of Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 薛煥奏克復松江。

translations.literal: Xue Huan memorialized the recovery of Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Huan reported Songjiang recovered.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，英、法兵登岸，遂踞北塘。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, British and French troops landed and then occupied Beitang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Anglo-French troops landed and occupied Beitang.

sentences.zh: 裁南河河道總督暨淮海道各官。

translations.literal: The Southern Canal commissioner and Huai-Hai circuit posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Canal and Huai-Hai posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬午，僧格林沁奏英、法勢大志驕，難望議和。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Sengge Rinchen memorialized that British and French ambitions were great and arrogant and peace talks could hardly be hoped for.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Sengge Rinchen reported Anglo-French arrogance and little hope of peace.

sentences.zh: 得旨，以撫事責之恆福，以顧大局。

translations.literal: An edict charged Hengfu with pacification and told him to consider the larger situation.
translations.idiomatic: The court charged Hengfu with pacification and urged him to consider the larger situation.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命曾國籓為欽差大臣，實授兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Zeng Guofan was made Imperial Commissioner and formally appointed Liang-Jiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Zeng Guofan became Imperial Commissioner and full Liang-Jiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己丑，夷人犯新河，官軍退守塘沽。

translations.literal: On day jichou, foreigners attacked Xinhe; government troops withdrew to defend Tanggu.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, foreigners attacked Xinhe and government troops withdrew to Tanggu.

sentences.zh: 命駱秉章馳赴四川督辦軍務。

translations.literal: Luo Bingzhang was ordered to hurry to Sichuan to supervise military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Bingzhang was ordered to hurry to Sichuan to supervise the campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，手詔僧格林沁曰：「握手言別，倏逾半載。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, a hand edict to Sengge Rinchen said: "We clasped hands in parting; half a year has swiftly passed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, a hand edict to Sengge Rinchen said they had parted half a year before.

sentences.zh: 大沽兩岸危急，諒汝憂心如焚。

translations.literal: Dagu's two banks are critically perilous; surely your heart burns with anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Dagu's banks were critically perilous and his anxiety must have been intense.

sentences.zh: 惟天下大本在京師不在海口。

translations.literal: Yet the empire's great foundation lies in the capital, not at the sea mouth.
translations.idiomatic: The court said the empire's foundation lay in the capital, not the sea mouth.

sentences.zh: 若有挫失，總須退保津、通，萬不可寄身命於砲台，為一身之計。

translations.literal: If there is setback, you must in all cases fall back and hold Tianjin and Tongzhou; you must never stake your life on the forts for your own sake alone.
translations.idiomatic: On any setback he must fall back to Tianjin and Tongzhou and never stake his life on the forts alone.

sentences.zh: 握管凄愴，汝其勉遵！

translations.literal: I take up the brush in grief; you must earnestly obey!
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote in grief and urged earnest obedience.

sentences.zh: 」敕西凌阿固守天津，瑞麟、伊勒東阿赴通州防堵。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Xiling'a to hold Tianjin firmly; Ruilin and Yiledong'a went to Tongzhou to block the route.
translations.idiomatic: Xiling'a was ordered to hold Tianjin and Ruilin and Yiledong'a went to block Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，命巴棟阿援金壇。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: Badeng'a was ordered to relieve Jintan.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, guisi, Badeng'a was ordered to relieve Jintan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大沽砲台失守，提督樂善死之，優恤建祠。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Dagu forts were lost; Commander Le Shan died; he was generously mourned and granted a shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Dagu fell, Commander Le Shan died, and he received generous mourning and a shrine.

sentences.zh: 庚子，僧格林沁退守通州。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Sengge Rinchen withdrew to defend Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Sengge Rinchen withdrew to Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，英人陷天津。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the English took Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the English took Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 浙江賊陷臨安、餘杭。

translations.literal: Zhejiang bandits took Lin'an and Yuhang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang rebels took Lin'an and Yuhang.

sentences.zh: 四川賊陷邛、蒲、新津。

translations.literal: Sichuan bandits took Qiong, Pu, and Xinjin.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan rebels took Qiong, Pu, and Xinjin.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，江蘇賊復陷松江。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Jiangsu bandits again took Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Jiangsu rebels again took Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以崇實署四川總督。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Chongshi was made acting Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Chongshi became acting Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己酉，裕瑞奏浩罕請依前通商，許之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Yurui memorialized that Kokand asked to trade as before; it was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Yurui reported Kokand's request to resume trade and it was permitted.

sentences.zh: 以常清為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Chang Qing was made Ili General.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Qing became general of Ili.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，金壇陷，知縣李淮守三年，援兵不至，力竭死之，紳民從死者逾千人。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Jintan fell; Magistrate Li Huai had defended for three years; reinforcements did not arrive; he died when his strength was exhausted; gentry and commoners who followed him in death exceeded a thousand persons.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Jintan fell after Magistrate Li Huai's three-year defense without relief; over a thousand gentry and townspeople died with him.

sentences.zh: 命勝保督馬隊守通州。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao was ordered to supervise the cavalry garrison at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao was put in charge of the mounted force defending Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，洋兵至通州，載垣誘擒英使巴夏禮解京。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guihai: foreign troops reached Tongzhou; Zaiyuan lured and seized the British envoy Parkes and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guihai day, foreign troops reached Tongzhou; Zaiyuan captured the British envoy Parkes by ruse and sent him to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，瑞麟等與洋兵戰於八里橋，不利。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Ruilin and others fought foreign troops at Baliqiao; the result was unfavorable.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Ruilin and others fought foreign troops at Baliqiao and were beaten.

sentences.zh: 命恭親王奕訢為欽差大臣，辦理撫局。

translations.literal: Prince Gong Yixin was ordered to serve as Imperial Commissioner to handle the pacification arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Gong Yixin became Imperial Commissioner to manage the peace talks.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上幸木蘭，自圓明園啟鑾。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor proceeded to Mulan, departing from the Yuanming Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Emperor left the Yuanming Garden for Mulan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上駐蹕避暑山莊。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor halted at the Mountain Resort for Escaping the Heat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Emperor took up residence at the Rehe mountain resort.

sentences.zh: 李世忠以擒叛將薛成良擢授江南提督。

translations.literal: Li Shizhong was promoted and appointed Jiangnan Military Governor for capturing the rebel general Xue Chengliang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shizhong was made Jiangnan military governor for capturing the rebel Xue Chengliang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔曰：「江南提督張國樑謀勇兼優，忠義奮發。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, an edict said: "Jiangnan Military Governor Zhang Guoliang combines stratagem and courage, and his loyal devotion was ardent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict praised Jiangnan governor Zhang Guoliang's courage and loyalty:

sentences.zh: 在軍十年，戰功卓著，東南半壁，倚為長城。

translations.literal: In the army ten years, his battle achievements were outstanding; the southeastern half of the realm relied on him as its great wall.
translations.idiomatic: For ten years in the field his victories were outstanding, and the southeast had leaned on him as its bulwark.

sentences.zh: 本年大營潰散，回援擊賊，受傷沒水。

translations.literal: This year the great camp was routed and scattered; returning to reinforce and strike the rebels, he was wounded and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: This year, after the great camp broke up, he was wounded and drowned while hurrying back to fight the rebels.

sentences.zh: 先後奏報，朕猶冀其不確。

translations.literal: Memorials reported this in succession, yet We still hoped it was not certain.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated reports still left the throne hoping they were untrue.

sentences.zh: 迄今數月，其為效死捐軀無疑。

translations.literal: Until now, several months on, there is no doubt that he died in loyal sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Months later his death in service could no longer be doubted.

sentences.zh: 若使張國樑尚在，蘇、常一帶，何至糜爛若此。

translations.literal: Had Zhang Guoliang still been alive, how could the Suzhou and Chang regions have been ruined to this extent.
translations.idiomatic: Had Zhang Guoliang lived, Suzhou and Changzhou would not have collapsed as they did.

sentences.zh: 追念藎勞，益深愴惻。

translations.literal: Recalling his loyal toil, Our grief deepens all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Remembering his loyal service deepened the court's grief.

sentences.zh: 贈太子太保，入祀昭忠祠，分建專祠。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, entered sacrifice at the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty, and separate temples were built in his honor.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, enshrined at the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty, and given dedicated temples.

sentences.zh: 子孫幾人，送部錄用。

translations.literal: Several of his sons and grandsons were sent to the ministries for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Several of his descendants were sent to the ministries for office.

sentences.zh: 」己卯，命都興阿帶兵入衛，從官文請也。

translations.literal: " On day jimao, Du Xing'a was ordered to bring troops to guard the capital, at official Wen's request.
translations.idiomatic: " On jimao day Du Xing'a was ordered to the capital with troops at Wen Wenzao's request.

sentences.zh: 命玉明、成凱、樂斌、文煜、英桂督兵入衛。

translations.literal: Yu Ming, Cheng Kai, Le Bin, Wen Yu, and Ying Gui were ordered to supervise troops entering to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Ming, Cheng Kai, Le Bin, Wen Yu, and Ying Gui were told to bring troops to guard Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命恆福駐古北口備防，吳廷棟接轉文報。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Hengfu was ordered to garrison at Gubeikou on defense, and Wu Tingdong was to relay memorials and reports.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Hengfu was posted at Gubeikou and Wu Tingdong took over dispatch of documents.

sentences.zh: 壬午，浙江官軍克復平湖、嘉善。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Zhejiang government troops recovered Pinghu and Jiashan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Zhejiang forces retook Pinghu and Jiashan.

sentences.zh: 廣東官軍克復樂昌、仁化。

translations.literal: Guangdong government troops recovered Lechang and Renhua.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong forces retook Lechang and Renhua.

sentences.zh: 癸未，江蘇賊陷常熟。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Jiangsu rebels took Changshu.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day rebels seized Changshu in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 圓明園災，常嬪薨，內務府大臣、尚書文豐死之。

translations.literal: The Yuanming Garden suffered disaster by fire; Imperial Concubine Chang died; Grand Minister of the Imperial Household and Minister Wen Feng died in it.
translations.idiomatic: Fire ravaged the Yuanming Garden; Concubine Chang and Household Minister Wen Feng perished in it.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，恭親王奏請還巴夏禮於英軍。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Prince Gong memorialized requesting that Parkes be returned to the British army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince Gong asked that Parkes be returned to the British.

sentences.zh: 薛煥奏劾馮子材赴援金壇，擁兵不進，致令城陷。

translations.literal: Xue Huan memorialized impeaching Feng Zicai for going to relieve Jintan yet holding his troops back without advancing, causing the city to fall.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Huan impeached Feng Zicai for stalling on the march to relieve Jintan and letting the city fall.

sentences.zh: 詔薄譴之。

translations.literal: An edict mildly rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: The court issued a mild rebuke.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，命勝保為欽差大臣，總統援軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renchen: Sheng Bao was made Imperial Commissioner with overall command of relief armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen day, Sheng Bao became Imperial Commissioner over relief forces.

sentences.zh: 敕恭親王奕訢照會英人，勿修城北砲台，速行議約。

translations.literal: Prince Gong Yixin was ordered to notify the English in writing not to repair the northern city batteries and to conclude the treaty quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Gong was told to notify the British not to rebuild the northern batteries and to hurry the treaty.

sentences.zh: 甲午，英使、法使入城。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the British and French envoys entered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the British and French envoys entered Beijing.

sentences.zh: 大學士彭蘊章、尚書許乃普以病乞免，許之。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Peng Yunzhang and Minister Xu Naipu begged leave for illness and were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yunzhang and Xu Naipu were allowed to retire for illness.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命慶廉、英桂兵駐直備調。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Qinglian and Ying Gui were ordered to station troops in Zhili for dispatch as needed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Qinglian and Ying Gui were posted in Zhili with troops on call.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賊陷寧國，周天受死之。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, rebels took Ningguo; Zhou Tianshou died in defense.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day rebels took Ningguo and Zhou Tianshou was killed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命左宗棠督辦浙江軍務。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Zuo Zongtang was ordered to supervise Zhejiang military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Zuo Zongtang was put in charge of Zhejiang operations.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，撫局成。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the pacification arrangements were concluded.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the peace settlement was completed.

sentences.zh: 恭親王奕訢奏請宣示中外，如約遵行。

translations.literal: Prince Gong Yixin memorialized requesting that it be proclaimed at home and abroad and carried out as agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Gong asked that the settlement be proclaimed at home and abroad and carried out as agreed.

sentences.zh: 許俄人駐烏蘇里、綏芬。

translations.literal: Russians were permitted to station at Ussuri and Suifen.
translations.idiomatic: Russia was allowed garrisons at Ussuri and Suifen.

sentences.zh: 停各省援兵。

translations.literal: Relief armies from the provinces were halted.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial relief armies were ordered to stand down.

sentences.zh: 敕英桂來京。

translations.literal: Ying Gui was ordered to come to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Gui was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 議西巡。

translations.literal: A western tour was discussed.
translations.idiomatic: The court discussed moving the court farther west.

sentences.zh: 戊申，李若珠奏克復江陰。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Li Ruozhu memorialized the recovery of Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Li Ruozhu reported the recapture of Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賊陷徽州，守城道員李元度棄城走。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, rebels took Huizhou; defending circuit intendant Li Yuandu abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day rebels took Huizhou and Li Yuandu fled.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，直隸、山東、河南賊匪並起，命僧格林沁討之。

translations.literal: On day guichou, bandits rose together in Zhili, Shandong, and Henan; Sengge Rinchen was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day bandits rose across Zhili, Shandong, and Henan, and Sengge Rinchen was sent against them.

sentences.zh: 庚申，恭親王奕訢奏洋人退至天津，籲請迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Prince Gong Yixin memorialized that the foreigners had withdrawn to Tianjin and pleaded for the imperial return.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Prince Gong reported the foreigners had withdrawn to Tianjin and asked the Emperor to return.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉朔，詔天氣漸寒，暫緩迴鑾。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon day xinyou: an edict said the weather was growing cold and the return to the capital was temporarily deferred.
translations.idiomatic: At the tenth-month new moon the court said cold weather required deferring the return to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以田興恕為貴州提督。

translations.literal: Tian Xingyu was made Guizhou Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Xingyu became Guizhou military governor.

sentences.zh: 予陣亡提督周天受、周天培世職，建祠予諡，附祀道員福咸等。

translations.literal: Hereditary offices were granted to the fallen military governors Zhou Tianshou and Zhou Tianpei; temples, posthumous titles, and attached sacrifice with Circuit Intendant Fu Xian and others were ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Fallen governors Zhou Tianshou and Zhou Tianpei received hereditary honors, temples, posthumous titles, and joint sacrifice with Fu Xian and others.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以劉源灝為雲貴總督，鄧爾恆為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Liu Yuanhao was made Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General and Deng Erheng Guizhou Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Liu Yuanhao took Yunnan-Guizhou and Deng Erheng Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，敕文謙、恆祺辦理通商事宜，吳廷棟督辦防務。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Wen Qian and Hengqi were ordered to handle trade affairs; Wu Tingdong was ordered to supervise defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wen Qian and Hengqi took trade affairs and Wu Tingdong defense.

sentences.zh: 以文安為湖南提督。

translations.literal: Wen An was made Hunan Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wen An became Hunan military governor.

sentences.zh: 以馮子材督辦鎮江軍務。

translations.literal: Feng Zicai was ordered to supervise Zhenjiang military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zicai was put in charge of operations at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，恭親王奕訢奏換俄人和約，請用御寶，從之。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Prince Gong Yixin memorialized exchanging the Russian treaty and requested use of the imperial seal; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Prince Gong's request to seal the revised Russian treaty was approved.

sentences.zh: 辛未，俄羅斯致槍砲。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Russia presented firearms.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Russia presented guns and cannon.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，敕樂斌、英桂回任。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Le Bin and Ying Gui were ordered to return to their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Le Bin and Ying Gui were told to resume their posts.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以嚴樹森為河南巡撫，毛昶熙督辦河南捻匪。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Yan Shusen was made Henan Governor and Mao Changxi was ordered to supervise Henan Nian bandit suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Yan Shusen took Henan and Mao Changxi the Nian suppression there.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命都興阿督辦江北軍務，李若珠副之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Du Xing'a was ordered to supervise Jiangbei military affairs, with Li Ruozhu as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Du Xing'a took Jiangbei command with Li Ruozhu as deputy.

sentences.zh: 以總兵田在田接辦徐、宿剿匪，淮徐道吳棠幫同辦理。

translations.literal: Brigade General Tian Zaitian was ordered to take over suppression of bandits in Xu and Su; Huai-Xu intendant Wu Tang was to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Zaitian took over Xu-Su suppression with Intendant Wu Tang assisting.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，勝保奏以大順廣道聯英專辦河防，准其奏報，從之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinmao: Sheng Bao memorialized that Dashunguangdao should ally with Britain to specialize in river defense; memorial reporting was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinmao day, Sheng Bao won approval to have Dashunguangdao ally with Britain for river defense.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，翁同書奏陳謹天戒，固邦本，收人才，練京營，爭形勢。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Weng Tonghe memorialized on revering Heaven's warnings, securing the state's foundation, gathering talent, drilling the Metropolitan Banner, and contesting strategic position.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Weng Tonghe urged heeding Heaven's warnings, strengthening the state, gathering talent, drilling the capital banners, and seizing strategic advantage.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「收人才一條，利少弊多。

translations.literal: The rescript said: "On gathering talent, the benefits are few and the harms many.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied: "Gathering talent does more harm than good.

sentences.zh: 餘留覽。

translations.literal: The rest is left for review."
translations.idiomatic: The rest may be reviewed."

sentences.zh: 」甲午，浙江賊陷新城、臨安、富陽。

translations.literal: " On day jiawu, Zhejiang rebels took Xincheng, Lin'an, and Fuyang.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiawu day rebels took Xincheng, Lin'an, and Fuyang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，王夢齡奏剿賊獲勝，三河肅清，並請節制黃開榜水師，從之。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Wang Mengling memorialized victory in suppressing rebels and the pacification of Sanhe, and also requested control over Huang Kaibang's naval force; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Wang Mengling reported victory at Sanhe and won control of Huang Kaibang's fleet.

sentences.zh: 庚子，曾國籓奏鮑超等克復黟縣。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Zeng Guofan memorialized that Bao Chao and others had recovered Yi county.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Zeng Guofan reported Bao Chao's recapture of Yi county.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，李若珠乞養親，以曾秉忠代之。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Li Ruozhu begged leave to care for his parents; Zeng Bingzhong replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Li Ruozhu retired to care for his parents and Zeng Bingzhong replaced him.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以杭州解嚴，優賚瑞昌、王有齡等。

translations.literal: On day guimao, because Hangzhou was relieved, Ruichang, Wang Youling, and others received special rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Ruichang, Wang Youling, and others were richly rewarded for the relief of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 瑞昌奏陳慶端力保浙疆，請加優獎。

translations.literal: Ruichang memorialized that Qing Duan had vigorously defended Zhejiang and requested added rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Ruichang asked extra honors for Qing Duan's defense of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「不分畛域，皆爾大吏分內之事。

translations.literal: The rescript said: "Without regard to boundaries, all are matters within your duty as great officials.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied: "Provincial boundaries do not limit a governor's duty.

sentences.zh: 甄敘督撫，出自朝旨，非汝所得擅請。

translations.literal: Commendation of governors and governors-general comes from court edict; it is not for you to request on your own authority."
translations.idiomatic: Rewards for governors come from the throne, not from your own petitions."

sentences.zh: 」戊申，命成琦會景惇查勘俄羅斯東界。

translations.literal: " On day wushen, Cheng Qi was ordered to join Jing Dun in surveying the eastern border with Russia.
translations.idiomatic: " On wushen day Cheng Qi was sent with Jing Dun to survey Russia's eastern border.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，浙軍張玉良攻復嚴州。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Zhejiang forces under Zhang Yuliang attacked and recovered Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Zhang Yuliang's Zhejiang force retook Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，官文、胡林翼奏陳玉成圖犯懷、桐，多隆阿會合李續宜迎剿，大敗之，殺賊萬餘。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Guan Wen and Hu Linyi memorialized that Chen Yucheng intended to attack Huai and Tong; Duolong'a joined Li Xuyi to meet and suppress them, inflicting a great defeat and killing more than ten thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Guan Wen and Hu Linyi reported Duolong'a and Li Xuyi had crushed Chen Yucheng's thrust toward Huai and Tong, killing over ten thousand rebels.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿賜黃馬褂，李續宜加二品銜。

translations.literal: Duolong'a was granted the yellow riding jacket; Li Xuyi was raised two ranks in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Duolong'a received the yellow jacket and Li Xuyi a two-rank promotion.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，命西凌阿、國瑞幫辦僧格林沁軍務。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinyou: Xiling'a and Guorui were ordered to assist in Sengge Rinchen's military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou day, Xiling'a and Guorui were assigned to Sengge Rinchen's staff.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命張亮基留辦雲南軍務。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Zhang Liangji was ordered to remain and handle Yunnan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Zhang Liangji was kept in Yunnan to manage operations.

sentences.zh: 己巳，始置總理各國通商事務衙門，命恭親王奕訢、桂良、文祥管理。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Office for the General Management of the Affairs of All Nations was first established; Prince Gong Yixin, Gui Liang, and Wen Xiang were ordered to administer it.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Zongli Yamen was established under Prince Gong, Gui Liang, and Wen Xiang.

sentences.zh: 以崇厚充三口通商大臣，薛煥兼辦上海等處通商事務。

translations.literal: Chonghou was appointed Minister for the Three Ports; Xue Huan was additionally ordered to handle trade affairs at Shanghai and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Chonghou became minister for the three treaty ports and Xue Huan took Shanghai trade affairs.

sentences.zh: 准旗人學習外國語言文字。

translations.literal: Bannermen were permitted to study foreign languages and writing.
translations.idiomatic: Bannermen were allowed to study foreign languages.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以田興恕為欽差大臣，督辦貴州軍務。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Tian Xingyu was made Imperial Commissioner to supervise Guizhou military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Tian Xingyu became Imperial Commissioner for Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，左宗棠奏督軍克復江西德興、安徽婺源，予三品京卿。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Zuo Zongtang memorialized that his supervised army had recovered Dexing in Jiangxi and Wuyuan in Anhui; he was granted third-rank capital official.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Zuo Zongtang reported the recapture of Dexing and Wuyuan and received third-rank capital rank.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以官文、周祖培為大學士，肅順協辦大學士，沈兆霖為戶部尚書，硃鳳標為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Guan Wen and Zhou Zupei were made Grand Secretaries; Su Shun was made cooperating grand secretary; Shen Zhaolin was made Minister of Revenue; Zhu Fengbiao was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Guan Wen and Zhou Zupei entered the Grand Secretariat, Su Shun as cooperating secretary, Shen Zhaolin Revenue, and Zhu Fengbiao War.

sentences.zh: 戊子，祫祭太廟。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the joint seasonal sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the court performed the joint sacrifice at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 是歲，免江蘇、浙江、安徽三省額賦逋賦，又直隸、山東、河南、江西、湖北、湖南、福建、廣西等省四百一州縣衛被災、被賊額賦有差。

translations.literal: That year, quota levies and arrears were remitted for Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Anhui; and for 401 prefectures, departments, counties, and garrisons in Zhili, Shandong, Henan, Jiangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Fujian, Guangxi, and other provinces, quota levies were remitted in differing degrees where there had been disaster or rebel depredation.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Anhui had taxes and arrears remitted, and 401 districts in eight provinces received partial relief where war or disaster had struck.

sentences.zh: 會計天下民數二萬六千零九十二萬四千六百七十五名口，存倉穀數五百二十三萬一千九百二十石四斗六升五合一勺。

translations.literal: The empire's population was reckoned at 260,924,675 persons; grain in storage totaled 5,231,920 piculs, 4 dou, 6 sheng, 5 ge, and 1 shao.
translations.idiomatic: The empire counted 260,924,675 people and 5,231,920-plus piculs of grain in store.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: Korea sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Korea presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一年辛酉，上在木蘭。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, xinyou, the Emperor was at Mulan.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 11, xinyou year, the Emperor was at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 春正月庚寅朔，上御綏成殿受賀。

translations.literal: Spring, first month, new moon day gengyin: the Emperor received congratulations in the Suicheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, at the first-month new moon, the Emperor received New Year homage in the Suicheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔二月十三日迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, an edict fixed the return to the capital on the thirteenth day of the second month.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the court set the return to Beijing for the thirteenth of the second month.

sentences.zh: 乙未，曾國籓奏楊載福剿賊，克都昌，解南陵圍。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Zeng Guofan memorialized that Yang Zaifu had suppressed rebels, taken Duchang, and lifted the siege of Nanling.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Zeng Guofan reported Yang Zaifu had taken Duchang and relieved Nanling.

sentences.zh: 田在田奏捻匪犯碭山，擊走之，加提督銜。

translations.literal: Tian Zaitian memorialized that Nian bandits attacked Dangshan and were driven off; he was given the military governor rank.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Zaitian reported beating off Nian bandits at Dangshan and received the military governor rank.

sentences.zh: 丙申，召翁同書來京，以李續宜為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Weng Tonghe was summoned to the capital; Li Xuyi was made Anhui Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Weng Tonghe was called to Beijing and Li Xuyi made Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以福濟為成都將軍。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Fu Qing was made Chengdu General.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Fu Qing became Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賊陷孝豐，杭州戒嚴。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, rebels took Xiaofeng; Hangzhou was placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day rebels took Xiaofeng and Hangzhou went on alert.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔：「紀年開秩，應予特赦，非常赦所不原者咸減除之。

translations.literal: On day renyin, an edict said: "As the reign year opens a new cycle, a special amnesty should be granted; what is not normally pardoned even in ordinary amnesties shall all be reduced or remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the court proclaimed a special amnesty for the new reign cycle, reducing even offenses outside ordinary amnesties.

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，左宗棠兵復饒州暨都梁。

translations.literal: " On day guimao, Zuo Zongtang's army recovered Raozhou and Duliang.
translations.idiomatic: " On guimao day Zuo Zongtang retook Raozhou and Duliang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，恆福以病免，以文煜為直隸總督，譚廷襄為山東巡撫，鄧爾恆為陝西巡撫，何冠英署貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Hengfu was relieved for illness; Wen Yu was made Zhili Governor-General; Tan Tingxiang Shandong Governor; Deng Erheng Shaanxi Governor; He Guanying acted as Guizhou Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Hengfu left for illness; Wen Yu took Zhili, Tan Tingxiang Shandong, Deng Erheng Shaanxi, and He Guanying acted at Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，僧格林沁奏捻匪竄入山東，派隊追剿，及於菏澤，失利。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Sengge Rinchen memorialized that Nian bandits had fled into Shandong; detachments were sent in pursuit and engaged them at Heze, with an unfavorable result.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Sengge Rinchen reported pursuing Nian bandits into Shandong and losing an engagement at Heze.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「僧格林沁督帶重兵，北地倚為屏障。

translations.literal: The rescript said: "Sengge Rinchen commands a heavy force on which the northern regions rely as their bulwark.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied: "Sengge Rinchen commands the great force the north relies on as its shield.

sentences.zh: 乃以飢疲之卒，追方張之寇，旁無援應，宜其敗也。

translations.literal: Yet with hungry and weary troops he pursued a rebel host at full strength, with no support on the flank; it was fitting that he should be defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he pursued a swelling enemy with exhausted men and no flank support; defeat was to be expected.

sentences.zh: 勇往有餘，未能持重。

translations.literal: He is bold to excess yet unable to hold steady weight.
translations.idiomatic: His daring outruns his steadiness.

sentences.zh: 尚其汰兵選將，扼要嚴防，謀定後動，勿再輕進。

translations.literal: You are still to cull troops and choose generals, hold choke points in strict defense, plan before moving, and do not advance lightly again.
translations.idiomatic: Cull troops, pick generals, hold the passes, plan first, and do not rush forward again.

sentences.zh: 」戊申，詔袁甲三等：「捻匪裹脅良民，未便概行誅戮，可剴切曉諭，設法解散。

translations.literal: On day wushen, an edict to Yuan Jiasan and others: "Nian bandits have coerced good people; they must not all be put to death without distinction. You should earnestly instruct and announce this and devise means to disband them.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Yuan Jiasan was told not to massacre coerced civilians among the Nian and to disband them by proclamation.

sentences.zh: 投誠者免罪，殺賊者敘功。

translations.literal: Those who surrender shall be pardoned; those who kill bandits shall be rewarded for merit.
translations.idiomatic: Surrender brought pardon; killing bandits brought merit.

sentences.zh: 並傳知李世忠一體招撫。

translations.literal: And communicate the same to Li Shizhong for joint surrender and pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shizhong was told to offer the same terms.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，貴州官軍克復獨山。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Guizhou government troops recovered Dushan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Guizhou troops retook Dushan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，翁同書奏陳撫練苗沛霖劫擾壽州，跋扈異常。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Weng Tongshu memorialized that the militia-trained Miao Peilin raided Shouzhou and was overbearingly abnormal.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Weng Tongshu reported Miao Peilin's militia raiding Shouzhou with outrageous arrogance.

sentences.zh: 詔李續宜酌辦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Xuyi to deliberate and handle it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xuyi was ordered to handle the matter.

sentences.zh: 河南捻匪竄擾東明、長垣。

translations.literal: Henan Nian bandits raided Dongming and Changyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Nian raiders struck Dongming and Changyuan.

sentences.zh: 二月己未朔，雲南官軍克復晉寧。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day jiwei, Yunnan government troops recovered Jinning.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jiwei new moon, Yunnan troops retook Jinning.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，復置奉天金州水師營。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Fengtian Jinzhou naval camp was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Fengtian's Jinzhou naval camp was restored.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔准山東抵還法國教堂地基，並敕直省遇有交涉，即行酌辦請旨，勿許推諉。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, an edict approved Shandong's return of French church land, and ordered all provinces that meet foreign affairs to deliberate, report, and seek instructions—shifting responsibility was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Shandong returned French church land with approval, and provinces were forbidden to shirk foreign-affairs cases.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，張玉良軍克復江山、常山。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Zhang Yuliang's army recovered Jiangshan and Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Zhang Yuliang retook Jiangshan and Changshan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，曾國籓奏左宗棠敗賊於景德鎮，鮑超敗賊於石門洋塘。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Zeng Guofan memorialized that Zuo Zongtang defeated bandits at Jingdezhen and Bao Chao defeated bandits at Shimen Yangtang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Zeng Guofan reported Zuo Zongtang's victory at Jingdezhen and Bao Chao's at Shimen Yangtang.

sentences.zh: 壬申，浙軍克復富陽。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Zhejiang troops recovered Fuyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Zhejiang forces retook Fuyang.

sentences.zh: 熱河朝陽盜匪陷城，命克興阿剿之。

translations.literal: Bandits in Chaoyang, Rehe, captured the city; Kexing'a was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Rehe Chaoyang bandits took the city; Kexing'a was sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 命明誼、明緒會勘俄界，英蘊、奎英辦理俄人通商。

translations.literal: Ming Yi and Ming Xu were ordered to survey the Russian border; Ying Yun and Kui Ying were to handle Russian trade.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Yi and Ming Xu surveyed the Russian border; Ying Yun and Kui Ying handled Russian trade.

sentences.zh: 捻匪撲汶河，副都統伊興阿、總兵滕家勝逆戰陣歿。

translations.literal: Nian bandits struck the Wen River; Vice Commander-in-Chief Yi Xing'a and Major General Teng Jiasheng met them in battle and died.
translations.idiomatic: Nian raiders hit the Wen River; Yi Xing'a and Teng Jiasheng died fighting them.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，陳玉成糾合捻匪由英山犯湖北蘄水，詔胡林翼回兵擊之。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Chen Yucheng gathered Nian bandits and from Yingshan invaded Qishui in Hubei; an edict ordered Hu Linyi to return troops and strike them.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Chen Yucheng led Nian forces from Yingshan into Hubei Qishui; Hu Linyi was ordered back to strike them.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔曰：「前經降旨，訂日迴鑾。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, an edict said: "An edict was earlier issued fixing a day for the return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, an edict said a return to the capital had been fixed.

sentences.zh: 旬日以來，體氣未復。

translations.literal: For more than ten days my bodily condition has not recovered.
translations.idiomatic: For ten days the Emperor's health had not recovered.

sentences.zh: 綏俟秋間再降諭旨。

translations.literal: So it will await autumn for a further edict.
translations.idiomatic: A further edict would wait until autumn.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，朝鮮國王遣使朝覲行在。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the King of Korea sent envoys to attend the court at the temporary palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Korea sent envoys to the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 溫諭止之，頒賜文綺、珍器，及其使臣。

translations.literal: A warm edict stopped them; brocade, precious vessels, and gifts were bestowed on them and their envoys.
translations.idiomatic: They were warmly told to stay home and were given brocade, treasures, and gifts.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔挑選兵丁演習俄國送到槍砲。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, an edict ordered selected soldiers drilled on firearms sent from Russia.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, troops were ordered to drill on Russian firearms.

sentences.zh: 甲申，裁撤黑龍江團丁歸農。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Heilongjiang militia levies were disbanded and returned to farming.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Heilongjiang militia were disbanded to farming.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑朔，詔派辦約大臣崇綸、崇厚給與全權便宜行事。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day jichou, treaty commissioners Chonglun and Chonghou were given full powers to act at convenience.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, jichou new moon, Chonglun and Chonghou received full treaty powers.

sentences.zh: 敕侍郎成琦赴興凱湖會勘俄人分界事宜。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Cheng Qi was ordered to go to Lake Xingkai to survey Russian boundary matters jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Qi was sent to Lake Xingkai to survey the Russian border.

sentences.zh: 予道員聯捷四品京卿，辦理河防。

translations.literal: Circuit Intendant Lian Jie was granted fourth-rank capital official and ordered to manage river defense.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Jie became a fourth-rank capital official in charge of river defense.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，恭親王奕訢請赴行在祗叩起居。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Prince Gong Yixin asked to go to the temporary residence to pay respects and inquire after the Emperor's health.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Prince Gong Yixin asked to attend the Emperor at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 上手詔答之曰：「別經半載，時思握手而談。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally replied by edict: "We have been apart half a year and I often think of speaking face to face.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied in his own hand: half a year apart, he longed to speak in person.

sentences.zh: 惟近日欬嗽不止，時有紅痰，尚須靜攝，未宜多言。
