translations.literal: Lately incessant coughing does not cease and there is sometimes bloody sputum; I still need quiet care and am not fit for much talk.
translations.idiomatic: Coughing and bloody sputum required quiet; he was not fit for much talk.

sentences.zh: 且俟秋間再為面話。

translations.literal: Wait until autumn for another face-to-face conversation.
translations.idiomatic: They would meet face to face in autumn.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，詔皇長子於四月七日入學，以李鴻藻充師傅。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, an edict ordered the Crown Prince to enter study on the seventh day of the fourth month, with Li Hongzao as tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Crown Prince was to begin study on the fourth month's seventh day under Li Hongzao.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，都興阿奏鎮、揚水師船隻年久損壞，請飭廣東購運紅單船應用，從之。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Du Xing'a memorialized that Zhen-Yang naval vessels were long damaged; he asked Guangdong to purchase and transport red-barque ships—approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Du Xing'a won approval to buy Guangdong red-barques for worn Zhen-Yang ships.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命勝保督辦直隸、山東剿匪。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Sheng Bao was ordered to supervise suppression of bandits in Zhili and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Sheng Bao took charge of bandit suppression in Zhili and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 以賈臻署安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Jia Zhen was made acting Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Zhen became acting Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，英、法兩國兵退出廣東省城。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, English and French troops withdrew from Guangzhou's provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Anglo-French forces left Guangzhou city.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以前大學士彭蘊章署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, former Grand Secretary Peng Yunzhang was made acting Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Peng Yunzhang acted as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，浙江賊陷海鹽、平湖、乍浦，副都統錫齡阿死之。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Zhejiang bandits took Haiyan, Pinghu, and Zhapu; Vice Commander-in-Chief Xiling'e died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Zhejiang bandits took Haiyan, Pinghu, and Zhapu; Xiling'e was killed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，廣西土匪陷太平府、養利州。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Guangxi native bandits took Taiping prefecture and Yangli subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Guangxi bandits took Taiping and Yangli.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未朔，嚴樹森奏賊犯汝寧，道員張曜擊走之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day jiwei, Yan Shusen memorialized that bandits attacked Runan and Circuit Intendant Zhang Yao drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, jiwei new moon, Yan Shusen reported Zhang Yao driving bandits from Runan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，山東捻匪、教匪連陷館陶七縣。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Shandong Nian and sect bandits together took seven counties including Guantao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Shandong Nian and sect rebels took seven counties including Guantao.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁入滕縣固守，詔勝保分兵援之。

translations.literal: Senggelinqin entered Teng county to hold fast; an edict ordered Sheng Bao to divide troops to aid him.
translations.idiomatic: Senggelinqin held Teng county; Sheng Bao was told to send reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔曰：「朕聞各處辦捐，有指捐、借捐、砲船捐、畝捐、米捐、饟捐、堤工捐、船捐、房捐、鹽捐、板捐、活捐，名目滋多，員司猥雜。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, an edict said: "We hear that everywhere donations are conducted—designated donation, loan donation, gunboat donation, per-mu donation, rice donation, army-pay donation, dike-work donation, boat donation, house donation, salt donation, plank donation, live donation—the names multiply and the clerks are confused.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Emperor denounced proliferating levy names from designated gifts to live taxes.

sentences.zh: 其實取民者多，歸公者寡。

translations.literal: In fact what is taken from the people is much and what reaches the public treasury is little.
translations.idiomatic: Little reached the treasury; most was taken from the people.

sentences.zh: 近年軍錡浩繁，不得已而藉資民力商力。

translations.literal: In recent years military funds are vast and we have had no choice but to borrow from popular and merchant strength.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy war costs had forced reliance on the people and merchants.

sentences.zh: 然必涓滴歸公，撙節動用，始得實濟。

translations.literal: Yet every drop must reach the public treasury and expenditure must be economical before there is real benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Funds had to reach the treasury and be spent frugally to do real good.

sentences.zh: 若似此徵求無藝，朘薄民生，尚復成何政體。

translations.literal: If exactions are boundless like this, draining the people's livelihood, what sort of government is this still?
translations.idiomatic: Boundless exactions that drained livelihoods were no government at all.

sentences.zh: 各大臣、督撫，尚其嚴密稽查，剔除奸蠹，以副朕意。

translations.literal: All grand ministers and governors-general, see that you rigorously investigate, root out corruption, and answer Our intent."
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and governors were ordered to investigate strictly and root out graft.

sentences.zh: 」乙亥，左宗棠敗賊於樂平。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Zuo Zongtang defeated bandits at Leping.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Zuo Zongtang beat bandits at Leping.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，山東教匪撲圍大名，聯捷擊走之。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Shandong sect bandits besieged Daming; Lian Jie drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Shandong sect rebels besieged Daming; Lian Jie repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 癸未，皖賊復竄浙江，陷常山、江山，進偪衢州。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Anhui bandits again raided Zhejiang, took Changshan and Jiangshan, and pressed on Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Anhui raiders retook Changshan and Jiangshan and threatened Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，田在田奏苗練犯符離，敕僧格林沁分兵援之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guisi, Tian Zaitian memorialized that Miao militia attacked Fuli; an edict ordered Senggelinqin to divide troops to aid.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, guisi, Tian Zaitian reported Miao militia at Fuli; Senggelinqin was told to detach troops.

sentences.zh: 甲午，鄧爾恆被戕於曲靖。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Deng Erheng was killed at Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Deng Erheng was murdered at Qujing.

sentences.zh: 飭劉源灝查辦。

translations.literal: Liu Yuanhao was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuanhao was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 以瑛棨為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Ying Qi was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Qi became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，勝保奏克復館陶。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Sheng Bao memorialized recovery of Guantao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Sheng Bao reported Guantao recovered.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命賈臻、李世忠幫辦袁甲三軍務。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Jia Zhen and Li Shizhong were ordered to assist in Yuan Jiasan's military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Jia Zhen and Li Shizhong were ordered to assist Yuan Jiasan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命多隆阿幫辦官文、胡林翼軍務。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Duolong'a was ordered to assist in the military affairs of Guan Wen and Hu Linyi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Duolong'a was ordered to assist Guan Wen and Hu Linyi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賊陷浙江壽昌、金華、龍游、湯谿、長興，進陷蘭谿、武義。

translations.literal: On day yisi, bandits took Zhejiang's Shouchang, Jinhua, Longyou, Tangxi, and Changxing, and advanced to take Lanxi and Wuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, bandits took Shouchang, Jinhua, Longyou, Tangxi, and Changxing and pressed Lanxi and Wuyi.

sentences.zh: 詔催左宗棠赴援。

translations.literal: An edict urgently ordered Zuo Zongtang to go to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang was urgently ordered to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day wuwu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, wuwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，曾國籓、胡林翼奏：「安慶省城自我軍長圍，逆酋陳玉成率黨回援安慶，於集賢關外赤岡嶺堅築四壘。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Zeng Guofan and Hu Linyi memorialized: "Since our army has long besieged Anqing city, the rebel chieftain Chen Yucheng led his faction to return and relieve Anqing, and at Chigang Ridge outside Jixian Pass firmly built four forts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Zeng Guofan and Hu Linyi reported Chen Yucheng relieving besieged Anqing with four forts at Chigang Ridge.

sentences.zh: 經鮑超、成大吉會合多隆阿馬隊奮力進剿，晝夜轟擊。

translations.literal: Bao Chao, Cheng Daji, and others joined Duolong'a's cavalry forces in strenuous advance and suppression, bombarding day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao, Cheng Daji, and Duolong'a's cavalry bombarded the forts day and night.

sentences.zh: 五月初一日，三壘俱降。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, three forts all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth month's first day, three forts surrendered.

sentences.zh: 釋去脅從，將長發老賊概行正法。

translations.literal: Coerced followers were released; long-haired old bandits were all executed according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Coerced men were freed; veteran long-haired rebels were executed.

sentences.zh: 其踞第一壘之賊劉滄琳，乘夜潛遁。

translations.literal: The bandit Liu Canglin who held the first fort fled by night in stealth.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Canglin, who held the first fort, fled by night.

sentences.zh: 經鮑超殲於馬踏石，餘為水師斬戮殆盡，並將劉滄琳驗明支解梟示。

translations.literal: Bao Chao destroyed him at Mata Stone; the remainder were nearly all beheaded by the naval force, and Liu Canglin was verified, dismembered, and displayed as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao killed Liu Canglin at Mata Stone; the navy finished the rest and his body was dismembered for display.

sentences.zh: 」得旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: The memorial received commendatory reply.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial won praise.

sentences.zh: 布魯斯亞國換約通商。

translations.literal: Prussia exchanged treaties and opened trade.
translations.idiomatic: Prussia concluded a treaty and opened trade.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，許俄人在庫倫、恰克圖通商。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Russians were allowed to trade at Kulun and Kyakhta.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Russians were allowed trade at Kulun and Kyakhta.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，欽天監奏八月初一日，日月合璧，五星聯珠。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Directorate of Astronomy reported that on the first day of the eighth month the sun and moon would join in brilliance and the five planets would align in a pearl.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, the Astronomical Bureau reported a sun-moon conjunction and five-planet alignment on the eighth month's first day.

sentences.zh: 得旨，不必宣付史館。

translations.literal: The memorial received reply: it need not be sent to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: The court said it need not go to the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賊陷浙江遂昌、松陽、永康。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, bandits took Zhejiang's Suichang, Songyang, and Yongkang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, bandits took Suichang, Songyang, and Yongkang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 丙子，回匪撲擾喀什噶爾。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Muslim rebels raided Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Muslim rebels raided Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 詔景廉赴阿克蘇防剿。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jing Lian to go to Aksu for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Lian was ordered to Aksu to defend and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，浙江官軍克復長興。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Zhejiang government troops recovered Changxing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Zhejiang troops retook Changxing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，詔每年秋間王公致祭兩陵，如遇山水漲發，可在途守候道路通時，即行前往。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dinghai, an edict ordered that every autumn princes and nobles perform sacrifice at the two mausoleums; if rivers and mountains are in flood they may wait on the road until the way is clear, then proceed at once.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, dinghai, princes were told to sacrifice at the two mausoleums each autumn, waiting on flooded roads if needed.

sentences.zh: 屆期不到，由守護之貝勒、公等行禮。

translations.literal: If the date arrives and they are not present, guardian beiles and dukes and the like shall perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Guardian beiles and dukes would perform the rites if princes could not arrive.

sentences.zh: 甲午，曾國籓奏收復安徽徽州。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Zeng Guofan memorialized recovery of Anhui Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Zeng Guofan reported Huizhou recovered.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，予四川陣亡侍衛昭勇侯楊炘建祠。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, a temple was granted to Yang Xin, Inner Palace Guard and Marquis Zhaoyong, who died in battle in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, a temple was granted to Marquis Zhaoyong Yang Xin, killed in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上不豫。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上大漸，召王大臣承寫硃諭，立皇長子為皇太子。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor grew gravely ill; princes and ministers were summoned to write vermilion rescripts, and the eldest imperial son was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor worsened; ministers wrote vermilion rescripts and the eldest son became Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上崩於行宮，年三十一。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor died at the traveling palace, aged thirty-one.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor died at the traveling palace, aged thirty-one.

sentences.zh: 十月，奉移梓宮至京。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the coffin was escorted to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the coffin was brought to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月，恭上尊諡。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the posthumous honorific title was respectfully offered.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the posthumous title was conferred.

sentences.zh: 同治四年九月，葬定陵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of Tongzhi 4, burial at Ding Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4, month 9, he was buried at Ding Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 論曰：文宗遭陽九之運，躬明夷之會。

translations.literal: The commentators say: Wenzong met the yang-nine fate and personally endured the mingyi ordeal.
translations.idiomatic: The annalists say Wenzong met calamity and personally bore dark times.

sentences.zh: 外強要盟，內孽競作，奄忽一紀，遂無一日之安。

translations.literal: Foreign powers pressed for treaties and internal disorders competed; in the blink of an eye one cycle passed without a single day's peace.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign coercion and internal revolt left not one peaceful day in a dozen years.

sentences.zh: 而能任賢擢材，洞觀肆應。

translations.literal: Yet he was able to employ worthies and promote talent, seeing clearly and responding broadly.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he employed worthies, promoted talent, and responded with broad vision.

sentences.zh: 賦民首杜煩苛，治軍慎持馭索。

translations.literal: In taxing the people he first cut vexatious exactions; in governing the army he carefully held the reins.
translations.idiomatic: He curbed harsh levies on the people and held the army with steady reins.

sentences.zh: 輔弼充位，悉出廟算。

translations.literal: Assistants filled their posts, all stemming from the temple calculations.
translations.idiomatic: His ministers filled their posts, all chosen by statecraft from the temple.

sentences.zh: 鄉使假年御宇，安有後來之伏患哉？

translations.literal: Had he been granted full years on the throne, how could there have been the calamities that came after?
translations.idiomatic: Had he ruled a full span of years, how could later disasters have followed?
